title: Client Success Manager - US Engineering Projects (Part-Time)
description:
About the Company:



Suarez Assistant is an early stage staffing and engineering support company based in Miami, Florida. The company places remote professionals and engineering talent into United States firms, with a current focus on supporting Florida engineering and construction companies on commercial building projects. The team is small and the company is growing account by account. This seat reports directly to the founder.



Job Description:



The Client Success Manager is the first person a United States engineering client speaks with. The role owns the client conversation from the first call: pulling out the full picture of the project, understanding what the firm is actually struggling with, and turning that conversation into a clear written scope the production team can execute against. The work is closer to consulting than to administration. The strongest people in this seat leave a call knowing more about the client's business than the client expected to share, and come back with ideas nobody asked for.



Responsibilities of the role:



Run discovery and scoping calls with United States engineering and construction firms.

Draw out the full requirements of a project during the conversation itself.

Produce a clear written scope after every client call.

Ask the questions that surface problems the client has not named.

Hand documented scopes to the production team and follow the work to delivery.

Join calls with the engineers assigned to client projects.

Bring new angles, offers and selling points to the founder without being asked.

Work alongside the lead generation seat to qualify incoming firms.



Required Experience and Qualifications:



Two or more years working directly with United States based clients.

Proven experience running client calls without reading from a script.

Working knowledge of engineering, construction or another technical service business.

Ability to explain technical work in plain language to a non technical client.

Fluent spoken English, clearly delivered, with minimal filler.

Experience documenting requirements, scopes of work or project notes.

Reliable high speed internet and a quiet environment for client calls.

Available during United States Eastern business hours.



Preferred Skills:



Freelance or agency background owning client relationships directly.

Exposure to MEP engineering, BIM, drafting, estimating or permitting.

Background in sales discovery, recruiting intake or account management.

Familiarity with CRM and project management software.



Personality:



Extroverted and comfortable leading a conversation.

Confident speaking with senior people.

Proactive, brings ideas without being prompted.

Curious about how a client's business makes money.

Comfortable inside an early stage company.

Takes ownership without being managed.



Software and Tools:



Google Workspace, Manatal, Notion, Slack, WhatsApp, Zoom, Google Meet. Training will be provided on the company's specific systems and software.



Schedule:



This role starts part time at 10 to 15 hours per week, worked during United States Eastern business hours. title: Self-Storage Call Center Rep + Outbound Sales (AI Lead Generation) - US Eastern Hours - Uncapped Commission
description:
Full-Time | Work From Home | Long-Term Position

Base Pay: $7/hr + commissions + 10% of deals you source

Work Hours (US Eastern Time): Monday-Friday 10:30 AM - 6:30 PM, Saturday 1:00 - 3:00 PM



ABOUT US

We are a U.S.-based company operating 2 self-storage facilities, and we use AI every day to work faster and smarter. We're looking for a motivated rep to run our inbound call center and, between inbound calls, drive outbound sales by using AI to find residential and commercial leads and then calling, texting, and
ing them.



Call center commissions are easy to earn. Outbound deals are where the big money is. And for the right person, this role grows: the owner will personally train you to take on more of the business over time.



YOUR DAILY TASKS



Inbound Self-Storage (first priority)

- Answer inbound calls from potential and current tenants

- Provide unit availability, pricing, and features, and close rentals

- Handle billing questions and payments

- Coordinate with on-site staff (maintenance, lockouts, appointments)

- Log all calls in our CRM



Outbound Sales (whenever you are not on inbound)

- Use Claude and Claude for Chrome to find and scrape residential and commercial leads

- Reach leads by phone, text, and

- You choose your focus: residential leads are easier to close with smaller commissions; commercial leads are harder to close with bigger commissions

- Make 12-20 outbound calls per day, adjusted for how busy inbound is that day

- Follow up until each lead is closed or ruled out, and log everything in the CRM



GROW WITH US - TRAINED BY THE OWNER

As you prove yourself, you will be trained to take over more of the business, including:

- Self-storage operations tasks

- Business acquisitions: helping research, contact, and evaluate businesses we are looking to buy

We want someone who wants to learn how businesses are bought and run, not just work shifts.



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- Excellent spoken and written English (C1/C2)

- Outbound calling or sales experience

- Consistent: you make your outbound calls every day, not only when it's slow

- Comfortable using AI tools. Must have access to Claude and Claude for Chrome

- Fast, reliable internet (minimum 180 Mbps) and a quiet workspace

- Experience with CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or similar)

- Organized and detail-oriented with documents and follow-ups

- Willing to use Hubstaff time tracking

- Must sign an NDA



NICE TO HAVE

- Conversational Spanish (may be useful in the future)

- Real estate or appointment-setting experience



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Base pay: $7/hour

- Commissions on call center sales. Our current rep earned about $18,000 last year. Your commissions depend on your own sales.

- 10% of the commissions we collect on deals you source. Just 1-2 closed deals a year typically pays $1,800-$10,000 on top of your base.

- 80 hours of paid time off per year

- 7 paid U.S. holidays

- Long-term position with growth opportunities



HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: To prove you read this job post carefully, your SUBJECT LINE must include:

1. The two AI tools this job requires you to have access to

2. The number of outbound calls expected per day



(Applications without this in the subject line will not be reviewed. It helps us filter out mass applications.)



Send the following in one shareable link (Google Drive or similar):

1. Your resume

2. A 60-second recording of how you would open a cold call to a business owner, including how you would handle "I'm not interested"

3. Your internet speed test (speedtest.net)

4. One example of how you have used AI (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to save time at work



PS: Please follow the application format exactly. Showing that you can follow instructions and use these tools tells us you can handle the job and pay attention to detail.

title: Loan Processor
description:
Loan Processor Job Description



• Conduct detailed serviceability checks to confirm applicants can meet repayment obligations, using relevant calculators and tools.

• Check loan scenarios against individual lender credit policies to confirm eligibility and identify potential issues before proceeding.

• Research and compare suitable lender products, interest rates, and policies to identify the best-fit options for each client's circumstances.

• Evaluate the financial position of loan applicants to determine borrowing capacity, analysing income, expenses, and existing debt obligations.

• Collect all required documents from loan applicants, including income statements, credit reports, and identification documents, and verify their authenticity and completeness.

• Prepare loan proposals presenting suitable lender options based on the client's situation and lender policies, and ensure all proposals are reviewed with the broker.

• Ensure all documents are accurate, complete, and meet lender requirements prior to lodgement.

• Input client and loan data accurately into CRM systems and submit applications to lenders via the appropriate online portals.

• Act as the central point of contact for brokers, clients, and lenders throughout the application process, providing timely progress updates and addressing queries accurately.

• Follow up with lenders and/or clients via phone or email for updates and outstanding requirements.

• Coordinate with underwriters, brokers, and internal tea
mbers to resolve any issues arising during assessment or processing.

• Continuously develop and maintain knowledge of lender policies, products, and credit criteria through training and self-study.

• Follow up all cases from formal approval through to settlement, including checking loan documents upon issuance and following up on outstanding settlement conditions.

• Ensure the outgoing financier (OFI) is ready for settlement where applicable (refinances).

• Advise clients on funds required to complete settlement, and liaise with all relevant parties — solicitors, lenders, and agents — to ensure files are ready.

• Notify clients once settlement is booked, send settlement breakdowns, and complete the settlement checklist in the system.

• Set up post-settlement action plans and support clients with ongoing loan maintenance enquiries and requests.

• Follow up with clients every six months, handle loan change requests, and apply and confirm cash rebates.

• Conduct birthday and annual reviews, including follow-up on fixed rate expiries.

• Manage construction progress drawdowns: collect and follow up on construction document checklists, follow up on commencement letters, and track construction progress through to completion.



Qualifications:

• Minimum 2–3 years of Australian mortgage broking or lending experience.

• Demonstrated experience with Australian Mortgage CRM platforms (e.g., Mercury, MyCRM, Salestrekker, Flex)

• Strong understanding of lender credit policies, serviceability requirements, and loan structures.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and document management.

• High level of written and spoken English communication skills.

• Analytical mindset with strong numeracy skills.

• Excellent problem-solving ability and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

• Ability to manage multiple files simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills and a client-first approach.

title: Virtual Math & ELA Teacher (K-8) — PRC-Licensed, Remote
description:
Thrive Alliance is a U.S.-based K-8 tutoring company built around a clear, measurable outcome: one full grade level of academic improvement in 12 weeks, delivered through structured, data-driven instruction on the MobyMax platform. We’re expanding our teaching team and hiring PRC-licensed teachers for remote Math and English Language Arts instruction



All instruction runs through MobyMax. Diagnostic placement, skill targets, and mastery assessments are generated by the platform based on each student’s ongoing performance data, and every lesson you teach is platform-guided rather than independently planned — you won’t be building lesson plans from scratch.



This is a stable, recurring position. Your caseload builds over time — starting small and growing toward a full caseload of 16-24 students — with full training provided before you begin.



Class time and schedule



Classes run from 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Thursday. Teachers choose their own hours inside that range. The minimum commitment is four hours a day and the maximum is six. Because the range is exactly six hours, a six hour day means the full range with no gaps. That comes to 16 to 24 teaching hours per week. Fridays and weekends are not scheduled.



Compensation



Pay is $4.00 USD for each hour taught, sent by Wise every two weeks on a fixed date. Four hours a day comes to approximately $277 per month and six hours a day to approximately $416. A bonus of $200 USD is paid when 80 percent or more of a teacher's students gain a full grade level within a twelve week cycle.



What we provide:

• Full training on MobyMax and our instructional system

• A structured curriculum — no lesson planning from scratch

• A dedicated, consistent caseload rather than rotating one-off sessions





Requirements:

• Active PRC teaching license (LET passer)

• Prior teaching or tutoring experience with K-8 students

• Strong spoken and written English

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace for live video instruction



Our hiring process is straightforward: a short written pre-screen, Interview, license verification, and a brief subject-area placement assessment.



To apply



Provide your PRC license number. State the maximum number of hours you can teach between 3:00 PM and 9:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Thursday, and which hours those are. Begin your response with the word Alliance to confirm you have read the full posting.



Job type: Independent contractor. 



Work location: Remote.

Work Schedule: To be determined based on the selected candidate and practice needs

Salary: Negotiable based on experience and qualifications

Anticipated Start Date: October 15–30, 2026



About the Position

A growing U.S.-based psychiatric mental health private practice is seeking a dependable, professional, organized, and motivated Virtual Medical Assistant (VMA).

This position will initially be part-time, with the opportunity to transition to full-time employment for the right person. I am looking for someone who wants to develop a long-term working relationship with the practice and can eventually become an important part of its daily operations and growth.

The ideal candidate has a medical or healthcare background, communicates very well in English, is comfortable working with patients, and can assist with both clinical administrative and general practice responsibilities.

Previous experience working with a psychiatrist, psychiatric nurse practitioner, mental health practice, or U.S.-based healthcare provider is strongly preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate who is willing to learn.

The work schedule will be determined based on the selected candidate's availability, experience, and the needs of the practice. If the position transitions to full-time, preference will be given to someone who can make this practice their primary employment commitment.



Primary Responsibilities

Patient Communication and Scheduling

• Answer incoming patient calls professionally, accurately, and compassionately.

• Monitor voi
 and missed calls.

• Return routine patient calls and messages within 24 business hours.

• Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments.

• Follow up with prospective new patients.

• Assist new patients with the intake and scheduling process.

• Follow up on incoming referrals.

• Contact patients regarding outstanding balances when instructed.

• Route clinical questions and urgent concerns appropriately to the provider.

• Maintain professional and empathetic communication with patients and families.



Clinical and Documentation Support

• Assist with preparing patient charts before psychiatric evaluations and follow-up appointments.

• Help prepare clinical note templates and organize information for provider review.

• Assist with clinical documentation preparation under provider direction.

• Review charts for missing information or documentation.

• Organize psychiatric screening questionnaires and results.

• Assist with preparing patient education and aftercare documents.

• Upload and organize outside medical records.

• Request medical records from primary care providers, hospitals, therapists, pharmacies, and other healthcare 



organizations when authorized.

• Assist with tracking laboratory orders and outstanding laboratory results.

• Upload and organize laboratory reports.

• Route laboratory results and other clinical information to the provider for review.

• Assist with tracking medication refill requests and other patient requests for provider review.

The Virtual Medical Assistant will not independently diagnose patients, interpret laboratory results, prescribe medications, change treatment plans, or provide medical advice. All clinical decisions remain the responsibility of the licensed provider.



Medication Prior Authorizations

A significant responsibility of this position will be assisting with medication prior authorizations.



Responsibilities may include:

• Preparing and submitting medication prior authorizations under provider direction.

• Following up on pending prior authorizations.

• Tracking approvals and denials.

• Obtaining necessary supporting documentation.

• Communicating with insurance companies and pharmacies regarding authorization issues.

• Assisting with documentation needed for appeals.

• Maintaining an organized system for outstanding prior authorizations.



Experience with CoverMyMeds is strongly preferred.

Referral Management and Practice Growth

I am looking for someone who can also help support the continued growth of the practice.



Responsibilities may include:

• Following up promptly with prospective new patients.

• Following up on referrals.

• Conducting professional outreach to primary care offices, therapy practices, psychologists, medical clinics, and other 

potential referral sources.

• Providing approved information about the services offered by the practice.

• Maintaining an organized list of referral contacts and outreach activities.

• Helping maintain relationships with referral sources.

• Assisting with patient onboarding and retention.

• Helping keep online practice profiles accurate and up to date.

• Assisting with other appropriate practice-growth projects.



Online Practice Platforms

Experience with any of the following platforms is highly desirable:

• Zocdoc

• Headway

• Alma

• Psychology Today

• CoverMyMeds

• OptiMantra EHR

• Ooma

Applicants are not required to have experience with every platform. Training can be provided to the right candidate.

Ooma Phone System



The practice uses Ooma for business telephone services.

Experience with Ooma is preferred but not required. The selected candidate must be willing and able to learn and use the Ooma system for practice-related telephone communication.

Responsibilities may include:

• Making and receiving patient calls through Ooma.

• Monitoring voi
 and missed calls.

• Returning appropriate patient calls.

• Maintaining professional telephone etiquette.

• Protecting patient confidentiality during telephone communication.



The candidate must be able to download and reliably operate the required Ooma application/software on an approved device.



Billing and Coding Support

Basic knowledge of U.S. medical billing and coding is preferred.

Responsibilities may include:

• Assisting with basic insurance-related administrative issues.

• Communicating with the practice's billing team regarding patient billing concerns.

• Following up on unresolved billing issues.

• Contacting patients regarding outstanding balances when instructed.

• Assisting with insurance eligibility and benefits verification when needed.

• Helping coordinate communication between patients, the provider, and the billing team.



Familiarity with psychiatric CPT and ICD-10 coding is a plus.

Administrative Support

Additional responsibilities may include:

• Preparing and formatting documents.

• Creating reports.

• Creating and maintaining spreadsheets.

• Preparing presentations.

• Creating patient handouts and educational materials.

• Creating or updating practice flyers.

• Organizing administrative files.

• Maintaining task lists and follow-up lists.

• Assisting with administrative correspondence.

• Helping organize provider and practice administrative responsibilities.

• Assisting with other projects as the practice grows.



Social Media and Marketing Support



Depending on the candidate's skills and experience, responsibilities may also include:

• Assisting with the practice's social media accounts.

• Creating professional mental health educational content.

• Creating and scheduling Instagram and
 posts.

• Creating simple graphics, flyers, and promotional materials.

• Assisting with community outreach and practice marketing.

Good with website and SEO



Experience with Canva or similar design software is a plus.

Required Qualifications

• Must have a medical or healthcare background.

• Strong understanding of basic medical terminology.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S.-based patients.

• Strong computer and technology skills.

• Ability and willingness to learn new healthcare software.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to maintain patient confidentiality.

• Ability to follow written procedures and instructions.

• Ability to work independently after appropriate training.



Preferred Qualifications

The following are preferred but not necessarily required:

• Registered Nurse, nursing graduate, medical student, or other healthcare professional.

• Previous Virtual Medical Assistant experience.

• Psychiatry or behavioral health experience.

• Experience working with a U.S.-based healthcare practice.

• Medication prior authorization experience.

• CoverMyMeds experience.

• Medical billing or coding experience.

• Experience working with laboratory reports.

• EHR/EMR experience.

• Experience with OptiMantra.

• Experience with Ooma.

• Experience with Zocdoc, Headway, Alma, or Psychology Today.

C2-level English proficiency is strongly preferred.

Candidates who have less experience may still be considered if they have a strong medical background, excellent English, professionalism, good computer skills, and a genuine desire to learn.

Personal Qualities



The ideal candidate should be:

• Honest and trustworthy

• Reliable and accountable

• Organized and detail-oriented

• Professional

• Compassionate and empathetic

• Patient when communicating with psychiatric patients

• Motivated and willing to learn

• Comfortable receiving constructive feedback

• Able to manage multiple responsibilities

• Able to recognize when an issue needs to be escalated to the provider

• Proactive about completing assigned tasks and following up on unfinished work

• Interested in a long-term position and growing with the practice



HIPAA and Patient Confidentiality

Because this position involves access to confidential patient health information, the selected candidate must maintain strict patient confidentiality and comply with the practice's privacy and security requirements.

The selected candidate will be expected to:

• Follow HIPAA and practice privacy/security policies.

• Use only approved systems for patient information.

• Maintain a private and secure work environment.

• Never improperly copy, photograph, download, store, or share patient information.

• Complete HIPAA/privacy training if required.

• Sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and confidentiality agreement.



Background Check

The selected candidate must be willing to provide an NBI Clearance or local police/background clearance if requested.

Technical Requirements

Because this is a remote healthcare position, reliable technology and internet service are essential.

The candidate must have:

• A reliable laptop or desktop computer suitable for daily professional use.

• Reliable high-speed internet/Wi-Fi.

• Internet capable of reliably supporting EHR access, Ooma telephone calls, and Zoom video meetings.

• A professional-quality headset with microphone.

• Webcam or integrated camera.

• A quiet, private, and professional workspace suitable for confidential patient calls.

• Ability to download and operate Ooma and other required practice applications.

• Reliable Zoom connection for video meetings with the provider.

• Backup internet access is strongly preferred.

• Backup power is strongly preferred, especially for candidates living in areas with frequent power interruptions.



Candidates selected for an interview may be asked to demonstrate their internet connection, Zoom/video quality, computer specifications, headset, and workspace setup.

Meetings and Communication

The candidate must be available for regular communication with the provider.

Weekly video meetings may be required, and the candidate should be comfortable participating in meetings with their camera on.



Good communication is extremely important. The VMA will be expected to communicate promptly when there is a problem, when clarification is needed, or when an assigned task cannot be completed.

Part-Time to Full-Time Opportunity

This position will initially be part-time, with the possibility of becoming full-time based on practice growth, performance, and mutual fit.

The opportunity for full-time employment will be based on factors such as:

• Reliability and attendance

• Quality and accuracy of work

• Communication

• Ability to follow through on assignments

• Ability to work independently

• Patient service

• Organizational skills

• Initiative

• Ability to support the growth and efficiency of the practice

• Long-term commitment

For the right candidate, the goal is to develop this into a stable, long-term position with increasing responsibilities as the practice grows.



Application Timeline

Applications will be reviewed as they are received.

Candidates selected for final interviews are expected to be contacted by approximately October 5, 2026.

The anticipated start date is October 15–30, 2026, depending on the selected candidate's experience and training needs.

Salary is negotiable based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated skills.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted and valued long-term member of a growing psychiatric practice.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

- Experience working at a creative agency or with multiple DTC brands is a major plus

- Strong portfolio of static ads that showcase smart design choices and platform-savvy visuals

- Ability to think critically about what makes an ad convert, not just what looks good

- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills in a fast-paced remote environment



Perks & Benefits:

- Work-from-home flexibility: collaborate remotely from anywhere

- Creative freedom: your ideas are heard and tested, not boxed in

- We cover subscriptions for the tools you need: Figma, Adobe, and more

title: Former Resilia.shop Team Member / E-commerce Consultant
description:
## Former Resilia.shop Team Member / E-commerce Operations Consultant



We are looking for someone who has previously worked directly with **Resilia.shop**, either as a VA, media buyer, creative strategist, copywriter, editor, marketer, operations team member, agency partner, or contractor.



This is a **one-time paid consulting/research opportunity**.



Our goal is to better understand how a successful e-commerce organization like Resilia structures and operates its marketing team.



We are especially interested in learning about:



* Internal team structure and responsibilities

* Media buying workflow

*
 Ads testing processes

* Creative strategy and creative production workflow

* How briefs are created and communicated

* Copywriting process

* How media buyers, creative strategists, editors, and copywriters work together

* Campaign structure and testing methodology

* How winning ads are identified and scaled

* KPIs and performance metrics the team focuses on

* Creative volume and production cadence

* Research processes

* Competitor research

* Internal communication and project-management structure

* SOPs, systems, and processes used by the team

* General operational structure of the e-commerce business



We are looking for someone who had **real firsthand experience working with the company**, not someone who has simply researched the brand online.



### Verification



You should be able to provide reasonable proof that you previously worked with Resilia.shop, such as:



* Previous job/contract records

* Screenshots showing your former role or participation in the team

* Previous work produced for the company

* Other reasonable evidence of your involvement



Please remove or hide confidential information belonging to the company or other employees.



**We are not requesting passwords, account credentials, unauthorized access to company systems, private customer data, or confidential/proprietary documents that you are not permitted to share.**



### Compensation



This is a paid opportunity.



Expected compensation: **$150–$300+ depending on your role, experience, and how much useful operational knowledge you can provide.**



If you had a senior role or extensive involvement with the media buying / creative strategy side of the company, we can discuss higher compensation.



The engagement would typically involve:



1. A detailed written questionnaire

2. A 60–90 minute call

3. Optional follow-up questions



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. What role you had with Resilia.shop

2. How long you worked with them

3. Which departments/processes you were involved with

4. What areas you can explain in detail

5. Proof that you previously worked with the company

6. Your requested compensation for the consultation



Please start your application with **“RESILIA”** so we know you read the entire job post.

title: Paid Media Analyst - Retail Media
description:
Paid Media Analyst - Retail Media



Location: Philippines, Remote

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:30am–5:30pm U.S. Eastern/Central business hours

Compensation: $2,200 USD per month



About the Role:



Workspark is looking for an experienced Paid Media Analyst - Retail Media to join the media team of an established U.S. marketing agency.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys digging into campaign data, understanding what is driving performance, and turning those insights into smart recommendations and optimizations.



You’ll support a large multi-brand client across several retail media platforms, working on reporting, optimization, budget pacing, testing, campaign builds, and client communication.



What You Will Do:

- Pull and analyze retail media performance reports

- Turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations

- Build, launch, and optimize campaigns

- Manage bids, budgets, pacing, targeting, and campaign settings

- Identify and recommend testing and optimization opportunities

- Review retailer- and product-level performance

- Use Excel to organize and analyze data from multiple sources

- Prepare reporting and explain what happened, why it happened, and what should happen next

- Participate in client calls when needed



What We Are Looking For:

- Hands-on retail media experience

- Experience with at least one major retail media platform

- Walmart Connect and/or Instacart Ads strongly preferred

- Amazon Sponsored Products / Sponsored Brands or other retail media experience also considered

- Experience building and optimizing campaigns directly

- Strong understanding of budgets, pacing, bidding, targeting, testing, and reporting

- Strong Excel skills, including VLOOKUP and pivot tables

- Ability to independently analyze performance and make recommendations

- Strong spoken and written English

- Comfortable participating in client conversations

You do not need experience in every retail media platform to apply. Strong retail media fundamentals and analytical ability matter more than checking every platform box.



Nice to Have:

- SKAI experience

- Experience managing complex or high-volume retailer portfolios

- Experience across multiple retail media platforms

- U.S. agency or client experience



You Will Do Well Here If You:

- Enjoy finding the story behind campaign performance

- Can explain why you are recommending a change

- Work independently and take ownership of your work

- Communicate early when you have questions or see a potential issue



What Workspark Provides:

- $2,200 USD per month

- 100% remote work

- Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave after probation

- Regular employee check-ins and ongoing Workspark support

- Opportunity to work directly with an established U.S. marketing agency



How to Apply: 

Please submit your resume and a short voice recording or video, answering:

1 - Which retail media platforms have you personally worked in?

2 - Tell us about a campaign where you analyzed performance and recommended or made a change.

3 - How have you used VLOOKUPs and pivot tables in your work?

4 - Are you comfortable working full-time during U.S. Eastern/Central business hours and participating in client calls?

title: Content Creator Feedback Manager (Review TikTok, Reels and YT Shorts) — $1,000–$1,200/month + Bonuses
description:
Salary: Start at $800 a month + performance-based bonuses (TOTAL: $1,000–$1,200 a month once trained)

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Flexible schedule: Choose your own hours, as long as you show up for the daily meeting (MANDATORY)

- Stable income: Long-term role with regular, on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel -before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair—only approve content that meets quality standards



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Sustainable hours with no graveyard shifts.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form to apply: 
/to/O40RINeW



Important note: Put "CFM" + [Your Name & Family Name] in the "Name" field in the form.



P.S. Once hired for this position, you will be hired and contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC

title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients

We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:

title: Senior Video Editor — Fashion, Creator & Brand Content
description:
Senior Video Editor — Fashion, Creator & Brand Content

Location: Remote — Philippines Schedule: Part-time to start (~10–15 hrs/week), expanding with project volume and performance Compensation: $7–$12 USD/hour, set by experience and the strength of your portfolio See our work: 
work





About the role

Bellaura is an early-stage technology and media company building a platform for creators and creative professionals. We produce content with models, photographers, designers, influencers, artists, brands, events, and luxury properties.



We're hiring one dedicated video editor to turn raw footage into finished work that feels intentional, cinematic, and professionally produced.



This is not a general VA role, and it isn't a CapCut-template role. We need an editor who can take a disorganized folder of footage, understand the audience and the aesthetic, and independently build something good — then explain why it works.



The right person becomes a long-term member of our media team and takes ownership of increasingly important projects as we grow.

About the pay range

We want to be direct about this, because vague compensation wastes everyone's time.



$7/hour is for a capable editor who is still building range and needs some creative direction.



$12/hour is for an editor whose reel makes the decision easy — consistent taste, clean audio, confident color, and the judgment to make a piece land without being told how.



Where you fall is d
 by your portfolio and your experience, not by negotiation. And it cuts both ways: if you come in near the top of the range, we will expect that standard on every delivery — not on your best week. We would rather pay well for reliable excellence than pay less and spend our time managing quality.



If your work is genuinely above this band, tell us. Show us why and we'll have the conversation.

What you'll do

Review and organize footage, select the strongest moments, and build a clear story or sequence

Edit short-form social content, reels, event recaps, interviews, fashion films, behind-the-scenes, and promotional pieces

Build compelling openings, intentional pacing, and endings that land

Edit and mix dialogue, music, sound effects, and ambient audio

Perform professional color correction and grading

Create accurate captions, titles, motion graphics, and simple visual effects

Sync multicamera footage and external audio

Reframe and optimize for vertical, horizontal, and platform-specific delivery

Follow creative direction while contributing your own editorial recommendations

Incorporate feedback quickly with clean version control

Keep project files, media, exports, and archives organized

Run final QC before delivery

What you need

A portfolio of consistently high-quality work. This is the primary thing we evaluate.

Significant professional video-editing experience

Strong command of a professional editing and color workflow. We work in DaVinci Resolve and prefer editors who do too — but a strong Premiere or Final Cut editor willing to work in Resolve is welcome to apply. Your judgment matters more than your software.

Real color-correction and grading ability

The ability to clean, mix, and balance dialogue, music, and effects

Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, composition, and viewer retention

Experience with both short-form and longer-form content

Strong written and spoken English — you'll be identifying moments in English-language footage, writing captions, and discussing revisions directly

A computer, internet connection, and storage that can reliably handle large media files

The ability to hold a quality bar across multiple active projects and firm deadlines



Strongly preferred: fashion and editorial, beauty and lifestyle, luxury brands, creator and influencer content, events and nightlife, founder-led interviews, commercial advertising, or music and performance content.



We also produce real-estate and luxury-property media for brand clients, so experience there is a real plus.



Experience with Fusion, After Effects, Photoshop, professional audio workflows, proxy workflows, and remote review platforms is valuable.

The quality bar

We're looking for more than technically correct cuts. Your portfolio should show:



Strong selection of moments and performances

Intentional pacing rather than reflexive fast cutting

Clean, professional audio

Consistent, tasteful color

Effective use of music and sound design

Restraint with transitions and effects

An understanding of premium brand aesthetics

The ability to create emotion, energy, or narrative out of raw footage



Templates, effects, and AI tools can support the process. They shouldn't replace editorial judgment. If you use AI in your workflow, just tell us how — we use it too.

How we work

Remote, flexible hours — but deadlines and scheduled reviews are firm commitments

You'll work directly with the founder and the media team

You may use finished Bellaura work in your own reel, with attribution

Finalists are invited to a short paid editing trial — $75 USD for roughly 3–4 hours, using footage we supply. Paid on delivery whether or not we move forward.





How to apply

Keep it focused. We would rather read something specific than something long.



Send us:



Your reel or portfolio link

Three to five examples that best represent your work

Your location and time zone, weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected hourly rate

Your primary editing, color, audio, and motion-graphics software



Then answer these two questions:



1. Pick three of your strongest edits and tell us exactly what you contributed to each.



For each one:



The client, brand, or type of project

Whether you edited from raw footage or inherited an existing timeline

What you personally handled — story, editing, color, sound, captions, graphics, delivery

Roughly how much raw footage, and the final length

The turnaround time

Any measurable result, if you have it — we know editors often don't



We're checking whether your actual responsibilities match the portfolio you send. Be honest about what was yours and what was the team's; it counts in your favor, not against you.



2. Describe your setup and how you'd handle receiving 100GB+ of footage.



Upload and download speeds, storage, how you'd use proxies, and what a realistic turnaround looks like on your connection. Two or three sentences is plenty.



We'll cover workflow, color pipeline, and creative approach in the interview.

WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY

Source candidates across OLJ, Hiry, RemotelyX, Remote Latinas, and X

Find verified work/personal emails using 
 and run outreach sequences

Join and build presence in communities where our target roles hang out, and recruit from them

Screen every candidate against the role scorecard we give you, with written notes

Keep a clean pipeline tracker (Notion/Sheets) — the founder only ever sees your top 3–5 per role

Report weekly: outreach sent, reply rate, candidates added, shortlist status



KPIs (we track these weekly)



15–20 Looms/day, 25%+ reply rate

30+ qualified candidates/month

title: Limousine / Black-Car Dispatcher (Live Trip Dispatch, WhatsApp + Google Sheets) - Tri-State NYC Experience Preferred
description:
Empire Black Truck is a fast-paced limousine and black-car transportation company serving the New York Tri-State area. Trips are posted in WhatsApp groups throughout the day and can be claimed by another company within seconds, so our dispatchers have to stay focused, react quickly, and make fast but accurate decisions.



This is a live-operations role. If you enjoy fast decisions, constant coordination and keeping every trip and every dollar accounted for, you will do well here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1) Claim jobs fast, and only the right ones

- Monitor multiple WhatsApp groups where transportation jobs are posted all day.

- Before accepting a job, immediately check our drivers' live locations, current assignments and upcoming schedules to confirm we can cover it.

- Accept and claim jobs within seconds when we can cover them.



2) Assign and confirm

- Assign or pre-book the appropriate driver for each accepted job.

- Send the complete trip information to the driver and confirm the driver received and acknowledged it.

- Check for scheduling conflicts and prevent double bookings.



3) Monitor every active trip

- Track each trip in real time: driver on location, passenger on board, trip completed.

- If a driver is late, unresponsive or has an issue, act immediately: contact the driver, update the appropriate person, and arrange backup coverage when needed.

- Handle airport pickups, flight delays and last-minute schedule changes calmly.



4) Keep the tracking sheet perfect

Every job must be entered into our Google Sheets tracker with:

- Trip date and time

- Pickup and drop-off locations

- Passenger information

- Assigned driver

- Company that provided the job, and the specific dispatcher who sent it

- Total job amount, driver pay, expected profit

- Payment terms, due date, and payment status (paid, pending or late)

This is how we know exactly who gave us each job and who we need to follow up with for payment, so accuracy is not optional.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required

- Previous dispatch or live-operations experience in a fast-paced, last-mile environment.

- Excellent spoken and written English; you will be communicating with drivers, affiliates and clients constantly.

- Strong internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) with a backup connection, plus a backup power source. You must be reachable at all times during your shift.

- Comfortable working U.S. Eastern Time hours, including early mornings, evenings or weekends depending on the shift assigned.

- Confident with WhatsApp (groups, voice notes, quick replies) and Google Sheets (data entry, filters, formulas at a basic level).

- Calm under pressure, extremely organized, and able to make quick decisions without waiting to be told.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in limousine, black-car, taxi/rideshare, NEMT, airport transportation, courier, or food-delivery dispatch.

- Working knowledge of the New York Tri-State area: JFK, LGA, EWR, Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Westchester, Long Island, New Jersey and Connecticut - including typical drive times and traffic patterns.

- Experience dispatching from affiliate networks or job-posting groups where trips are claimed first-come, first-served.

- Familiarity with limo/black-car software or booking platforms.



Please note: 3PL trucking, truckload scheduling and HVAC dispatch experience can be helpful, but those industries operate very differently from limousine and taxi dispatch. If your background is only in those areas, please explain clearly in your application how you would handle live passenger transportation, airport pickups and jobs that must be claimed within seconds.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply with the subject line: BLACK CAR DISPATCHER - [YOUR NAME]



In your application, answer all of the following. Applications that do not answer every question will not be reviewed.

1. Describe your dispatch experience. What industry, how many drivers/trips per day, and what tools did you use?

2. Have you dispatched passenger transportation (limo, black car, taxi, NEMT, airport)? Give one specific example of a problem trip and how you solved it.

3. A trip is posted in a WhatsApp group: JFK pickup at 6:00 PM today, drop-off in Midtown Manhattan. Walk us through, step by step, exactly what you check and do in the first 60 seconds.

4. Attach a screenshot of a speed test (speedtest.net) taken on the connection you would use for work, and tell us your backup internet and backup power setup.

5. What hours are you available in U.S. Eastern Time?

6. How familiar are you with the NYC Tri-State area? Roughly how long is JFK to Midtown at 5:00 PM on a weekday?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid live-dispatch trial (WhatsApp + Google Sheets) before hiring.

title: AI Specialist & Marketing Manager
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a proactive, creative, and technology-driven AI & Marketing Manager to oversee the company’s marketing, lead generation, branding, content, and artificial-intelligence systems.



This person will use AI and automation to help the company operate more efficiently, attract more buyers, sellers, and agents, and maintain consistent communication with its database. The ideal candidate is not simply a task-taker. We are looking for someone who identifies opportunities, recommends improvements, tests new ideas, and takes ownership of results.



Primary Responsibilities



Artificial Intelligence and Automation



The AI & Marketing Manager will research, implement, and manage AI tools that improve marketing, lead generation, recruiting, client communication, and daily operations. This person will build AI-assisted workflows for social media,
 marketing, listing promotion, recruiting, follow-up, market updates, and database nurturing.



The manager will create reusable prompts, templates, and systems for agents and staff while identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated without sacrificing service or personalization. This role will connect approved tools with Follow Up Boss, websites, advertising platforms, calendars,
 systems, and other company technology.



The manager will monitor all automations to ensure leads and clients receive accurate, timely, and appropriate communication. This person will train agents and staff on the proper use of AI tools and maintain an organized library of prompts, templates, marketing assets, and operating procedures.



The manager will also protect confidential client and company information, prevent sensitive information from being entered into unapproved public AI platforms, and review AI-generated content for accuracy, brand consistency, Fair Housing compliance, and professional quality before publication.



Marketing Management



The AI & Marketing Manager will develop and manage annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing calendars. This person will create and execute campaigns designed to generate buyer, seller, recruiting, referral, and investment leads.



The manager will oversee marketing for Coming Soon, Just Listed, Open House, Under Contract, Just Sold, Deal of the Week, and price-improvement campaigns. Responsibilities will include coordinating professional photography, video, drone photography, floor plans, virtual staging, brochures, postcards, property websites, and social media content.



The manager will ensure every listing receives a consistent, high-quality marketing launch. This person will create and manage
 newsletters, database campaigns, market updates, client events, and past-client outreach.



The role will also maintain consistent branding across the website, social media, presentations, print materials, signs,
 campaigns, and advertising. The manager will oversee relationships with photographers, videographers, printers, designers, and other vendors while tracking marketing expenses and evaluating return on investment.



Content and Social Media



The manager will create, edit, schedule, and publish content across Instagram,
, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and other approved platforms. Content will include short-form videos, educational material, property tours, testimonials, agent spotlights, recruiting content, and local-market features.



This person will repurpose long-form content into multiple videos, posts,
s, articles, and graphics. The manager will maintain a consistent posting schedule and recognizable brand voice, monitor comments and messages, and promptly route leads into Follow Up Boss.



The manager will track engagement, audience growth, inquiries, and appointments generated from content while staying current on platform changes, emerging trends, and effective real-estate marketing practices.



Lead Generation and Advertising



The manager will oversee or coordinate Google, Meta, YouTube, retargeting, and other digital advertising campaigns. This person will create landing pages, lead magnets, forms, and automated follow-up campaigns.



Campaigns will target homeowners, expired listings, FSBOs, absentee owners, investors, renters, first-time buyers, luxury clients, and prospective agents. The manager will monitor cost per lead, lead quality, conversion rates, and return on advertising spend.



This person will test audiences, headlines, creative materials, landing pages, and follow-up sequences. The manager will coordinate with agents and inside-sales staff to ensure leads receive immediate and consistent follow-up. Underperforming campaigns will be identified and improved based on measurable data.



CRM and Database Marketing



The manager will work inside Follow Up Boss to maintain tags, action plans, smart lists, campaigns, and lead-routing systems. The database will be segmented by client type, location, timeline, lead source, price range, and level of motivation.



The manager will create long-term nurture campaigns for buyers, sellers, past clients, investors, recruits, and referral partners. This person will monitor lead-response times, follow-up completion, database engagement, and appointments generated.



The manager will ensure marketing leads are properly entered, assigned, tagged, and tracked while working with leadership to improve lead-conversion systems and reporting.



Recruiting and Staff Support



The manager will create recruiting campaigns for new, experienced, part-time, and referral agents. This person will develop agent success stories, culture videos, presentations, landing pages, advertisements, and recruiting follow-up campaigns.



The manager will promote training, meetings, accomplishments, closings, community involvement, and events. Agents will receive approved social media templates, listing materials, presentations, and marketing resources.



The manager will also help agents develop professional biographies, videos,
 campaigns, and personal branding that remain consistent with the company’s overall standards. Periodic AI and marketing training will be provided to agents and staff.



Performance Expectations and KPIs



Success in this role will be measured by the number and quality of buyer, seller, recruiting, and referral leads generated; appointments and closed business attributable to marketing; cost per lead; and return on advertising spend.



Additional performance measures will include the speed and consistency of listing launches, database growth,
 engagement, reactivation of older leads, social media reach, follower growth, inbound inquiries, website traffic, landing-page conversion rates, Google Business Profile activity, and review growth.



The role will also be evaluated based on the percentage of leads properly entered, tagged, assigned, and nurtured; the number of useful AI and automation systems implemented; administrative hours eliminated through improved systems; accuracy and timeliness of marketing deliverables; and agent adoption of approved AI and marketing tools.



The manager will provide leadership with a concise weekly report covering completed projects, active campaigns, measurable results, challenges, recommendations, and priorities for the following week.



Required Qualifications



Candidates should have experience in digital marketing, content creation, marketing operations, automation, or a related field. They must possess strong working knowledge of modern AI tools and demonstrate an ability to learn new platforms quickly.



The position requires experience with social media management,
 marketing, graphic design, and video editing. Candidates must have excellent writing, editing, organization, and project-management skills, along with the ability to analyze marketing data and explain results clearly.



The successful candidate will demonstrate strong attention to detail, a commitment to accuracy, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines without constant supervision. This person must be proactive, comfortable receiving feedback, willing to test new approaches, and accountable for measurable results.



Candidates must also understand confidentiality, cybersecurity, copyright, advertising regulations, privacy requirements, and Fair Housing compliance.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate thinks like an owner rather than waiting to be told every next step. This person uses AI to improve human performance without replacing professional judgment or personal relationships.



The right individual balances creativity with data and measurable outcomes, works quickly without sacrificing accuracy, and understands that marketing must generate opportunities—not merely produce attractive content.



This person is resourceful, organized, curious, dependable, comfortable taking initiative, and consistently asks how a process can be improved, automated, measured, or turned into additional business.



Equal Opportunity



The company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining marketing practices consistent with all applicable Fair Housing, anti-discrimination, advertising, privacy, and real-estate regulations.

title: Commercial Conveyancing Paralegal (AU-Experience REQUIRED)
description:
We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Commercial Conveyancing Paralegal to manage and support end-to-end commercial property transactions.



In this role, you will work closely with senior property lawyers on a wide range of conveyancing matters, including commercial acquisitions and sales, multi-lot/mixed-use developments, business assets, FIRB-related property transactions, and complex title dealings. You will be responsible for driving files forward from initial contract review through to PEXA workspace management and final settlement.



Key Responsibilities:

- End-to-End Transaction Management: Prepare, manage, and settle commercial property files (acquisitions, dispositions, and off-the-plan/development matters) from initial contract review to post-settlement compliance.

- Contract & Due Diligence Support: Assist lawyers with review of contracts, special conditions, seller disclosure packs (including compliance with QLD Seller Disclosure Scheme requirements, body corporate disclosure, Form 2/Form 33/34 requirements, etc.), and title search analysis.

- Property Searches & Inquiries: Order and analyse due diligence searches (rates, land tax, water, planning/zoning, body corporate, contamination, and regulatory registries).

- Financial & Settlement Calculations: Draft, review, and finalize settlement statements, transfer duty calculations, tax adjustments, and payout figures.

- PEXA Workspace Management: Prepare, build, coordinate, and execute electronic settlements using PEXA, ensuring seamless alignment with financial institutions, counterparty legal teams, and State Revenue Offices.

- Client & Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear, proactive, and transparent communication with clients, real estate agents, brokers, financiers, and counterparties to ensure key dates and conditions (finance, due diligence, settlement) are strictly tracked and met.

- Leasing & Business Transaction Assistance: Assist with ancillary property matters, including commercial lease executions, license agreements, and business asset purchases/sales as required.

- File & Regulatory Compliance: Conduct Verification of Identity (VOI) processes, Foreign Investment Review Board (FIRB) application administrative tasks, and ensure complete file compliance.







Skills & Qualifications:

- Solid experience 2-3 years in ideally Queensland commercial real estate and commercial leasing matters

- Drafting experience in deeds, leases, licences, and relevant commercial real estate documents;

Experience in commercial real estate transactions;

- Interstate experience in commercial real estate is a bonus but not necessity.

- Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with PEXA, duty portals (e.g., QRO Online / Duties Online), practice management software, and electronic legal workflows.

- Legal Knowledge: Sound understanding of Queensland conveyancing procedures, statutory seller disclosure regimes, body corporate frameworks, and commercial land transaction requirements.

- Commercial Mindset: Ability to balance technical accuracy with practical efficiency, maintaining high attention to detail while prioritizing high-volume workflow deadlines.

- Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, aligned with a modern, clear, and client-centric approach.

- Interpersonal & Cultural Alignment: Proactive, collaborative team player with strong problem-solving skills and a commitment to integrity, efficiency, and exceptional client care.
