description:
WHO WE ARE



We're a fast-growing US DTC home fragrance brand (Texas-based, sold on Shopify + Checkout Champ, Meta ads as the main engine). Single hero product, thousands of orders, US 3PL in Miami, manufacturer in China, and a founder who needs to get out of operations completely so he can focus on growth.



THE OPPORTUNITY



If you're currently an Assistant Head of Ops, Deputy Ops Manager, or #2 in the ops team at a big e-commerce brand — this is your opportunity to take the main position. You'll own the entire backend, report directly to the founder, and build the ops function as we scale.



MISSION OF THE ROLE



Run the entire backend of the business so the founder never has to touch operations. Nothing runs out of stock, nothing ships late, no vendor sits waiting on an answer, and every number is tracked.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN (everything backend — full delegation)



Inventory & forecasting — build and own the demand forecast; we never stock out again (we lost sales this fall because two scents hit zero — your job is that this never repeats)

3PL management — daily relationship with our Miami fulfillment center: receiving, ship times, error rates, billing

China manufacturing — manage our OEM factory: production timelines on large orders (20,000+ units), QC, freight forwarding, landed cost tracking

Supplier management — fragrance compound supplier, packaging, and any new vendor sourcing and negotiation

Order flow & CX oversight — refunds, disputes/chargebacks (we have a vendor for this — you manage them), shipping issues, and our support automation

Systems & SOPs — document every process; build the ops playbook from scratch

Weekly reporting — inventory position, fulfillment metrics, landed costs, and cash tied up in stock, reported to the founder every Monday



HARD REQUIREMENTS — do not apply without these



Previous experience as Head of Ops, Ops Manager, or Assistant/Deputy Head of Ops at an 8 or 9-figure e-commerce brand (you will be asked for the brand name, revenue range, and a reference)

Have personally managed a China manufacturer + Western 3PL combination

Have built or run an inventory forecasting system (you'll be asked to walk us through one you built — screen share)

Fluent written and spoken English

Shopify experience required; Checkout Champ / subscription apps a plus



APPLICATION — answer ALL of these (applications missing any answer are auto-rejected)



Name the 8-9 figure brand(s) you did ops for, your exact title, and roughly what monthly order volume you handled.

What were you hired to do in that role, and what did you actually accomplish? Give numbers (stockout rate, ship times, cost savings).

Describe a time production or fulfillment went badly wrong. What happened, what did you do, what changed after?

Walk me through the forecasting sheet or system you built: what inputs, how far out, how you handled a demand spike.

What will your last boss say about you when we call them? (We will call them.)

Your salary expectation and earliest start date.



Put the word SUNDAY at the top of your application so we know you read the whole post.

WHAT THIS IS



We are an international personal and business development company. Our founder, Chris Howard, takes one-to-one sessions with people from our community, and we need someone to fill his calendar.



You are not cold-calling strangers and you are not selling anything. Every person on your list has already been part of our world - they have bought something, joined something, or asked us for something. You are calling to give them a set of free gifts and to invite them to a free fifty-minute session with Chris. There is nothing to buy on your call, no card taken, no price mentioned.



We call it the gift department, and that is genuinely what it is. But be clear-eyed: this is a targets role. If you want quiet admin work, this is not it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH DAY



- Around 100 outbound calls, from a dialer we provide, working a list that is already loaded, cleaned and sorted for you.

- Book 5 appointments a day. That is the job. You keep dialing until you have five, and on a good day you will get there in well under 100 calls.

- Book them live, on the phone - into a calendar link, while the person is still talking to you. Never "I'll send you a link."

- Log every call with its outcome and a one-line note in the person's own words.

- Send us five numbers at the end of each shift: dials, conversations, gifts given, appointments booked, and anyone who asked not to be called again.



THE HOURS



Our first lists are American, so you work US hours from home. Two windows work, and you choose:



- 10:00pm - 2:00am Manila time. This is the American working day - 7am in Los Angeles, 10am in New York. Most people prefer this one.

- 7:00am - 11:00am Manila time. This is the American evening of the day before.



Five days a week. Weekends are yours.



WHAT YOU GET FROM US



- CloudTalk, with your own US phone number - so the people you call see a local number.

- A list of 1,670 warm contacts, already tagged and split into days. You never have to d
 who to call: you filter one tag and there are your hundred people, with a line on each card saying why they are on the list.

- A complete 13-page script, written to be spoken, including what to do when it goes to voi
 and how to answer the objections you will actually hear.

- A written setup sheet, step by step, so your first day is not guesswork.

- Training on the system before you dial anyone real - practice calls and a test booking first. Nobody is thrown in.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Superb spoken English. Not "good enough" - superb. An American or Australian should never have to ask you to repeat yourself, and should never be thinking about your accent instead of what you are saying. This is the first thing we screen and most applicants will not pass it.

- Genuine excitement about what you are giving away. You are handing people something real and free. If that does not land in your voice, the call does not work, and no script fixes it. We would rather have someone thrilled about the gift with less experience than a polished caller who sounds flat.

- Real outbound calling experience. Appointment setting, telemarketing or a call centre. Tell us what you dialled, how many a day, and what you booked.

- A quiet place to work and a proper headset. This matters more than people expect: you will be on calls for four hours straight, and background noise loses appointments. Please do not apply if your home setup cannot support this - we would rather know now.

- Reliable internet. A dropped call at the moment of booking is a lost booking.

- Someone who likes people. The whole job is being the good news on the other end of the phone.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience booking for a coach, consultant or seminar company.

- Familiarity with CloudTalk, Calendly, or any CRM.

- An interest in personal development - our callers who care about the material book more.



THE MONEY, PLAINLY



- $50 USD per day, for five days a week.

- Plus 5% of the cash we actually collect on any sale that comes from a session you booked. Our programs run into the thousands, so one sale can be worth more than a week's pay.

- The 5% is paid after the money has landed and the refund window has closed, and it comes back off if a sale is refunded. It is paid on sales - not on bookings and not on people showing up.

- It is the rule for this position, written down, not a private arrangement.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short voice recording - two parts, two minutes total. First, tell us about a time you booked appointments by phone. Then read this out loud as if you were saying it to someone on a call: "Chris has put together something he calls The Gift of Change, and honestly it's really cool. There are four parts to it - and the fourth part is a call with him, where he gives you a fifth."



We are listening for two things: whether an American would understand you effortlessly, and whether you sound like you mean it. (This is the first thing we open. A written application with no recording will not be read.)



2. What you dialled before: the product, the daily call volume, and what you booked.



3. Your internet speed, and confirmation you have a quiet room and a headset.



4. Which of the two calling windows you want.



We are hiring immediately and want someone dialing within the week.

title: Virtual Assistant/Operations Mangaer
description:
## Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator



1080X Media is a fast-growing real estate media company producing premium photography, video, drone, floor plans and social media content for high-end real estate agents and agencies.



We’re looking for a highly organised, proactive **Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator** to help manage the day-to-day operations of the business and support our continued growth.



This is not just a basic admin role. You will become an important part of the business and help coordinate clients, photographers, videographers, editors and future team members.



### Key Responsibilities



* Manage daily admin and operational tasks

* Help organise bookings, shoots, schedules and team availability

* Communicate with photographers, videographers, editors and contractors

* Ensure jobs are progressing and deliverables are completed on time

* Follow up team members when work is overdue or needs revisions

* Help coordinate photo and video editing workflows

* Keep track of upcoming shoots, completed jobs and outstanding work

* Organise files, folders, project information and internal systems

* Assist with client communication and general enquiries

* Help prepare job information, briefs and instructions for the team

* Keep internal systems, spreadsheets and databases organised and up to date

* Assist with invoicing, basic bookkeeping/admin and following up outstanding items where required

* Help improve systems, workflows and standard operating procedures as the company grows



### Recruitment & Team Management



A major part of this position will be helping us grow our team.



You will be responsible for:



* Finding photographers, videographers, editors, virtual assistants and other contractors

* Posting job advertisements across relevant platforms

* Searching for suitable candidates directly

* Reviewing applications, portfolios and resumes

* Shortlisting the strongest candidates

* Conducting initial screening and communication with applicants

* Organising interviews and trial tasks

* Following up applicants

* Maintaining a database of potential future team members

* Assisting with onboarding new staff and contractors

* Helping monitor team performance, reliability and availability



You should be comfortable actively searching for talented people rather than simply waiting for applications to arrive.



### What We’re Looking For



We want someone who is:



* Extremely organised

* Reliable and consistent

* Fast at responding and following up

* Proactive and able to solve problems independently

* Confident communicating with clients and team members

* Comfortable managing multiple jobs at once

* Strong with Google Drive, Google Sheets,
 and online systems

* Comfortable learning new software quickly

* Good at researching and finding people online

* Detail-focused and able to spot mistakes

* Fluent in written and spoken English



Experience working with a **real estate media company, photography/video company, creative agency or production business** would be highly regarded.



Experience with recruitment, hiring freelancers or managing remote workers would also be a major advantage.



### Ideal Personality



We’re looking for someone who doesn’t need to be constantly told what to do.



If you notice that something hasn’t been completed, you follow it up.



If we need another editor, photographer or team member, you begin searching.



If a workflow could be improved, you suggest a better way to handle it.



The goal of this role is to help keep the business organised and allow the owner to spend less time managing small operational tasks and more time growing the company and producing high-quality work.



### About 1080X Media



1080X Media specialises in premium real estate marketing across the Gold Coast, working with high-end agents and properties.



Our work includes:



* Real estate photography

* Cinematic property videos

* Drone photography and video

* Social media reels

* Floor plans

* Luxury property marketing content



We are continuing to grow our team and client base, so there is significant opportunity for this role to grow into a larger operations or management position over time.



### Role



**Position:** Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator

**Work Type:** Remote

**Hours:** Initially flexible / part-time with potential to grow into full-time

**Industry:** Real Estate Media / Photography / Video Production



When applying, please include:



* A short introduction about yourself

* Your previous VA / operations experience

* Any recruitment or hiring experience

* Software and systems you are comfortable using

* Your availability

* Your expected hourly or monthly rate

* Examples of similar companies or teams you have supported

title: Business Development & Marketing Specialist – Healthcare
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Business Hours



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month



ABOUT RAVORA HEALTH



Ravora Health is a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice providing psychiatric evaluation, medication management, ADHD treatment, and care for conditions such as anxiety and depression.



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Business Development & Marketing Specialist to help us grow our patient base, develop relationships with healthcare referral partners, and execute marketing and growth projects.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys research, outreach, relationship building, marketing, and solving problems.



You will work directly with Ravora Health leadership and will be given meaningful projects to own.



We are looking for someone who can take an objective, figure out what needs to be done, organize the project, execute it, follow up, and report the results.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



1. HEALTHCARE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



A major responsibility will be helping Ravora Health build relationships with healthcare organizations that may refer patients to us.



Potential referral partners include:



* Primary care offices

* Therapy and counseling practices

* Psychologists

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Colleges and universities

* Other healthcare professionals



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding the appropriate decision-makers and contacts

* Collecting accurate phone numbers and
 addresses

* Researching services and accepted insurance plans

* Calling and
ing healthcare offices

* Introducing Ravora Health and our services

* Explaining our accepted insurance plans and referral process

* Learning how potential partners currently handle psychiatry referrals

* Scheduling meetings when appropriate

* Following up with contacts

* Maintaining long-term relationships



This is relationship-focused business development, not high-volume call-center telemarketing.



2. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH



You will help identify new opportunities for Ravora Health.



This may include:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Researching healthcare organizations

* Identifying decision-makers

* Researching competitors

* Finding community organizations

* Researching local businesses and employers

* Finding potential referral sources

* Identifying marketing opportunities

* Researching new patient-acquisition channels



We want someone who is very comfortable researching online and turning information into an organized action plan.



3. REFERRAL & CONTACT DATABASE MANAGEMENT



You will help create and maintain an organized database or CRM containing information such as:



* Organization name

* Contact person

* Phone

*

* Location

* Providers

* Accepted insurance

* Services offered

* Previous communication

* Relationship status

* Last contact

* Follow-up date

* Referrals generated



You will help make sure opportunities do not get forgotten and relationships are followed up consistently.



4. DIGITAL MARKETING & PATIENT ACQUISITION



You will also assist with marketing projects designed to bring new patients to Ravora Health.



Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY



We strongly encourage the use of AI and modern technology.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Google Workspace

* Project-management tools

* Automation tools



We want someone who looks for ways to use technology to make research, outreach, organization, and marketing more efficient.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you have experience in areas such as:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Marketing

* Healthcare

* Client relations

* Account management

* Partnership development

* Outreach

* Digital marketing

* Google Ads

* CRM management

* Project coordination

* Sales development



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare company is a strong advantage but is not required.



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Confidence speaking professionally on the phone

* Strong research skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Good follow-up habits

* Professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Comfort with outbound outreach

* Ability to learn new tools quickly

* Ability to manage several projects

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S. healthcare offices during U.S. business hours.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are not searching for someone who already knows everything.



We are searching for someone who is:



* Resourceful

* Reliable

* Organized

* Curious

* Comfortable taking initiative

* Strong at communication

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to take ownership of assignments



If we give you a goal, we want you to be able to research it, create a plan, execute it, follow up, and show us what happened.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



Hours: 40 hours per week



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month depending on experience and skill level.



Because a significant part of this position involves communicating with U.S. healthcare offices, you must be available during a meaningful portion of U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term role.



Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance, reliability, project ownership, and overall contribution.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



RAVORA GROWTH



Then include the following:



1. INTRODUCTION



Tell us briefly about your background and why this position interests you.



2. RESUME



Please include your current resume or CV.



3. VOICE RECORDING



Please provide a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself.



A major part of this role involves professional communication with U.S. healthcare offices, so spoken English is important.



4. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us about any experience you have with:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Healthcare

* Marketing

* Client outreach

* Google Ads

* CRM systems

* Project coordination



5. PROJECT OWNERSHIP



Tell us about one project where you were given a goal but not detailed step-by-step instructions.



What was the goal?



What did you do?



What was the result?



6. SHORT CASE STUDY



Imagine Ravora Health asks you:



"We want to build relationships with local therapy practices and primary care offices that could refer psychiatric patients to us."



Briefly explain how you would begin this project.



We are especially interested in how you would:



* Find potential partners

* D
 which organizations to prioritize

* Contact them

* Track your outreach

* Follow up

* Measure results



7. AI TOOLS



Tell us which AI tools you currently use and give us one example of how you have used AI to complete work more efficiently.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Ravora Health and become an important member of our business development and marketing team.

title: PREY CORPUS — Secondary Operations Coordinator
description:
Position: Secondary Operations Coordinator

Location: Remote — Philippines

Type: Part-time / On-demand

Hours: Approximately 10–15 hours per week, depending on workload

Pay: ₱100–₱400 per task, depending on scope and complexity



⸻



About PREY CORPUS



PREY CORPUS is a growing remote gaming-services business working with customers and gaming Contractors across multiple platforms.



We’re currently looking for a Secondary Operations Coordinator to join our Operations team.



This is a trusted coordination position, not simply a general support role.



The successful applicant will work alongside our Primary Operations Coordinator and provide additional operational coverage when needed.



⸻



🎯 About the Role



As Secondary Operations Coordinator, you will help keep day-to-day operations organized and provide coverage when the Primary Operations Coordinator is unavailable.



You should be comfortable handling multiple tasks, communicating with customers and Contractors, tracking deadlines, and solving routine problems independently.



You will be expected to follow our internal procedures and maintain professional communication.



⸻



🛠️ Main Responsibilities



Customer & Order Support

	•	Assist with incoming customer orders.

	•	Review customer requirements.

	•	Communicate with customers when necessary.

	•	Identify unclear or unusual requests.

	•	Escalate issues that require management decisions.



Contractor Coordination

	•	Communicate with Contractors about assigned work.

	•	Provide clear instructions and updates.

	•	Track progress and deadlines.

	•	Follow up when updates or completed work are missing.

	•	Help resolve routine Contractor questions or issues.



Operations Management

	•	Assist with managing ongoing tasks and orders.

	•	Keep records accurate and organized.

	•	Monitor deadlines and important follow-ups.

	•	Help maintain smooth communication between customers and Contractors.

	•	Provide operational coverage when the Primary Coordinator is unavailable.



Completion & Quality Checks

	•	Review submitted work and required proof.

	•	Confirm that assigned requirements have been completed.

	•	Identify missing or unclear information.

	•	Escalate issues when something requires further review.



Team Support

	•	Work closely with the Primary Operations Coordinator.

	•	Coordinate with other Operations staff when necessary.

	•	Help improve internal workflows when you identify something that could work better.

	•	Follow established company procedures.



⸻



🧠 What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is:

	•	Reliable — follows through on responsibilities.

	•	Organized — can manage multiple tasks without losing track.

	•	Proactive — notices problems and communicates them early.

	•	Professional — communicates respectfully with customers and team members.

	•	Detail-oriented — understands that small mistakes can cause larger problems.

	•	Independent — can handle routine situations without needing constant supervision.

	•	Good at communication — provides clear and useful updates.

	•	Trustworthy — understands the importance of confidential business and customer information.

	•	Adaptable — comfortable learning new systems and procedures.



⸻



🎮 Gaming Experience



Gaming experience is useful, particularly experience with:

title: Sales & Account Executive Assistant
description:
Sales & Account Executive Assistant

Full-Time | Remote | Genumark



*ABOUT THIS ROLE:



Genumark is looking for a highly organized, proactive Sales & Account Executive Assistant to work directly alongside an experienced Account Director with over 18 years of experience in the branded merchandise industry (Kyle Nichols). 



This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. You’ll become an important part of the sales process—helping manage client communication, quoting, follow-up, sales opportunities and day-to-day organization.



We move quickly, work on a wide variety of projects, and value people who take ownership, communicate well and figure things out.



*WHAT YOU WILL DO:



- Client Communication: Respond quickly to client
s, gather missing information and make sure clients receive timely, professional responses.

- Quoting: Gather pricing and product information, prepare quotes in
 and CommonSku, and create drafts for review.

- Inbox Management: Help manage and organize the Account Director’s inbox using our
 GPS system, making sure important sales
s are prioritized and nothing gets missed.

- Sales & Opportunity Management: Capture new sales leads, maintain the sales to-do list and help prioritize opportunities based on deadlines, key clients and potential job value.

- Follow-Up: Proactively follow up with clients, suppliers and internal team members to keep opportunities moving.

- Scheduling: Coordinate meetings, calendar requests and day-to-day priorities.

- Referral Program & Gifting: Help manage our client referral program and coordinate client gifts.

- Marketing & Content: Work with our marketing team to draft social content using established style and messaging guidelines, prepare posts for approval and coordinate posting.

- Travel: Research and coordinate flights, hotels and other business travel.

- Team Coordination: Work closely with our creative and production teams as projects move from sales into execution.



The role is designed around taking increasing ownership of the sales process after the initial strategy and creative direction have been established.



*WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills

- Highly organized with excellent attention to detail

- Comfortable communicating directly with clients

- Strong follow-up and task-management skills

- Confident learning new software and systems

- Resourceful and able to solve problems independently

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities

- Proactive, you see what needs to happen and help move it forward

- An interest in brands, apparel, design, marketing or merchandise



Experience in sales support, account management, customer service or executive assistance is a strong asset.



Experience with CommonSku, CRM systems, quoting software, Microsoft Outlook/Office, project management tools  and the promotional products industry.



*WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:



Clients receive fast, professional responses. Quotes and follow-ups move quickly. The inbox stays organized. New opportunities are captured and prioritized. Important deadlines don't get missed.



Most importantly, you increasingly become someone the Account Director can trust to take ownership and keep things moving without needing constant direction.



That aligns with how we've structured the position internally: the new hire owns quoting and sales follow-up, with success measured by fast responses, accurate quotes and continued momentum.



*WHY YOU WILL LOVE GENUMARK:



Genumark is one of North America’s leading branded merchandise companies. We work with great brands to create custom merchandise, apparel and programs that people actually want to use and wear.



We’re a certified B Corp, an ASI Top 40 distributor and one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies.



You’ll work directly with experienced sales, creative and production professionals and get exposure to a wide range of brands, products and projects.



This is a long-term, full-time position with an opportunity to learn the business, take on more responsibility and grow with the team.



*INTERESTED?



Send us a short introduction telling us about yourself, your relevant experience and why you think you’d be a good fit.



Keep it simple. We’d rather have a conversation than read a long cover letter.

title: Personal Brand Video Editor & Social Media Manager
description:
# Personal Brand Video Editor & Social Media Manager



I’m looking for a creative, reliable **Video Editor & Social Media Manager** to help grow and elevate my personal brand across **TikTok and Instagram**\.



My content is centered around **lifestyle, travel, experiences, wellness/fitness, and storytelling**\. I’m looking for someone who can take my raw footage and ideas and turn them into engaging, polished content while also helping me build a recognizable and cohesive personal brand\.



This is **not just a video editing position**\. I want someone who understands social media, personal branding, audience growth, storytelling, and how to make a page feel intentional\.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



- Edit short\-form videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels

- Edit primarily using **CapCut**

- Turn raw footage, talking\-head clips, voiceovers, and B\-roll into engaging videos

- Create strong hooks and maintain viewer interest throughout the video

- Add captions, text overlays, transitions, sound effects, music, and other elements when appropriate

- Understand pacing and know when a video needs fast cuts versus when the content needs room to breathe

- Help create a **consistent editing style** so my content becomes recognizable

- Help organize content into recurring series and content themes

- Maintain a cohesive and aesthetically pleasing Instagram/TikTok presence

- Recommend content ideas based on my personal brand

- Help increase brand awareness, engagement, and followers organically

- Identify opportunities to repurpose existing footage/content

- Stay aware of relevant social media trends without making every piece of content feel trend\-dependent

- Review content performance and recommend adjustments based on what is working



## The Type of Editor I’m Looking For



I do **not** want every video to feel overly edited or like an advertisement\.



I want content that feels **personal, natural, entertaining, relatable, and story\-driven**, but still polished\.



For example, my travel content may include:



**Hook → talking\-head clip → B\-roll → voiceover/storytelling → on\-screen text → pattern interrupts → payoff → CTA or teaser for the next video**



Other videos may be simpler lifestyle content with music, clean cuts, natural moments, and minimal text\.



The editor should understand the difference and know how to edit based on the purpose of the content\.



I want someone who can help turn everyday experiences into content people actually want to watch\.



## Personal Brand Goals



The goal is to build a page where someone can immediately understand **who I am, what my content is about, and why they should follow me**\.



My brand is about getting out, experiencing life, moving your body, traveling, trying new things, and sharing the real story along the way\.



I want to build:



- Stronger brand recognition

- A cohesive social media presence

- More engaging storytelling

- Increased followers and engagement

- Repeatable content series

- A community that connects with my personality and experiences

- A personal brand that can eventually attract aligned partnerships and opportunities



## Before Applying — Review My Profile



Please review my current social media profile before applying\.



I do **not** want a generic application\.



After reviewing my page, tell me:



1. What do you think is currently working?

2. What would you change or improve?

3. What would you do to make my personal brand more recognizable?

4. How would you make my page more cohesive?

5. What content or series would you recommend?

6. What would you do during your first 30 days to help elevate the page?



I’m looking for someone who can bring **strategy and ideas**, not just wait for me to tell them exactly what to do\.



## Requirements



- Strong short\-form video editing portfolio

- **Proficient in CapCut**

- Experience editing TikTok and Instagram Reels

- Strong understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, storytelling, captions, and B\-roll

- Good eye for aesthetics and personal branding

- Understanding of social media growth and content strategy

- Able to take feedback and make revisions

- Organized and dependable

- Able to meet deadlines

- Comfortable contributing creative ideas

- Excellent attention to detail



**Important:** If you submit portfolio examples through Google Drive, please make sure viewing permissions are already enabled before sending the link\. I will not request access to portfolios with restricted permissions\.



## How to Apply



Please include:



- A short introduction

- Your experience with video editing and social media management

- Links to **3–5 examples of your BEST short\-form edits**

- At least one example of a **personal brand, lifestyle, travel, vlog, or storytelling video** you have edited

- Your experience using CapCut

- Your assessment of my current 
 and what you would do to improve it

- Your availability

- Your rate



### Editing Example / Style I’m Looking For



For a travel or experience video, I may provide:



**Raw footage:**

Talking\-head clips \+ destination footage \+ activities \+ food \+ transportation \+ random B\-roll



**What I expect back:**

A polished 30–60 second Reel/TikTok with a strong opening hook, intentional pacing, clean captions, B\-roll placed strategically over the story, music and sound effects where appropriate, and an ending that gives the viewer a reason to engage or watch the next video\.



I want the final video to feel like **a story—not a collection of random clips\.**



Please include the phrase **“IN MOTION”** somewhere in your application so I know you read the full job description

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – U.S. Law Firms
description:
Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – U.S. Law Firms



We ares looking for an experienced, confident Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to contact attorneys and law firms throughout the United States.



This is a performance-based position with commission and appointment bonuses. We will provide the leads, calling lists, scripts, training, and sales materials.



About Us



We help law firms grow their practices through services including:



Google Business Profile optimization

Google Ads

Local SEO

Law firm website development and redesign

Online marketing and lead generation



The owner has practiced law in Beverly Hills, California for approximately 17 years before moving into law firm marketing.



We understand attorneys because we have been on their side of the desk.



Our initial focus will be primarily on bankruptcy attorneys, with additional practice areas being added later.



Your Primary Job



Your job is NOT to sell complicated marketing services over the telephone.



Your primary responsibility is to:



Call attorneys and law firms from lists that we provide.

Get through receptionists and gatekeepers.

Speak directly with attorneys or decision-makers whenever possible.

Give a short introduction to us.

Determine whether the attorney is interested in discussing ways to bring additional clients into their practice.

Schedule qualified appointments directly on our calendar.

Keep accurate notes regarding each conversation and follow-up.

Follow up with prospects when appropriate.



Once an attorney agrees to an appointment, we will handle the consultation and closing process.



Example of the Type of Call You Will Make



You may say something similar to:



“Hi, I'm calling for Joh Doe. John practiced bankruptcy law in Beverly Hills for about 17 years and now works specifically with law firms to help them bring in additional clients. He asked me to reach out to a few bankruptcy attorneys in your area. Would you have a few minutes this week to speak with him?”



You will receive additional scripts, responses to common objections, and training.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



Extremely comfortable making outbound cold calls.

Fluent in spoken English.

Easy for U.S. clients to understand over the telephone.

Professional and confident speaking with attorneys.

Comfortable dealing with receptionists and gatekeepers.

Persistent without being aggressive.

Friendly, conversational, and natural on the phone.

Able to think quickly instead of simply reading a script word-for-word.

Comfortable handling objections such as:

“We're not interested.”

“We already have a marketing company.”

“Send me an
.”

“The attorney isn't available.”

“We don't need any more clients.”

Organized and able to maintain accurate call notes.

Reliable and able to work independently.

Motivated by performance-based compensation.

Required Skills



Required:



Excellent spoken English

Previous cold-calling experience

Previous appointment-setting experience

Strong telephone communication skills

Ability to communicate professionally with U.S. businesses

Experience getting past gatekeepers

Ability to handle objections

Basic computer skills

Reliable high-speed internet

Quality headset and quiet work environment

Ability to work during U.S. business hours



Preferred but not required:



B2B cold-calling experience

Experience calling attorneys, accountants, doctors, or other professionals

Experience selling marketing, advertising, SEO, websites, Google Ads, or similar services

Experience using a CRM

Experience scheduling appointments through Calendly or similar systems

Previous experience calling U.S. businesses

Compensation



This is a performance-based position.



Compensation may include:



Payment for qualified appointments that actually attend their scheduled consultation.

Additional commission for each law firm that becomes a paying client.

Additional performance incentives may be available for top performers.



Our services can include an initial setup fee plus ongoing monthly management, so successful callers have the opportunity to earn meaningful commissions.



There is no predetermined limit on how many qualified appointments you can generate.



Leads Are Provided



You will NOT be required to find your own leads.



We provide lists of attorneys and law firms for you to contact.



Initially, you will primarily contact bankruptcy attorneys throughout the United States.



Work Schedule



You must be available to make calls during normal U.S. business hours.



Because you will be calling law offices, the majority of calling will take place Monday through Friday during the attorneys' local business hours.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team if the relationship works well.



Performance Expectations



We care about results, not simply the number of calls made.



We will monitor:



Calls completed

Decision-makers reached

Conversations with attorneys

Qualified appointments scheduled

Appointment show rate

New clients generated



Quality appointments are more important than simply filling the calendar with people who have no genuine interest.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. Briefly describe your cold-calling experience.



Tell us what types of businesses or individuals you have called and approximately how long you have been cold calling.



2. Tell us about your appointment-setting experience.



What were you selling or promoting, and approximately how many appointments were you expected to schedule?



3. Describe your experience getting past gatekeepers.



Law firms frequently have receptionists or assistants screening calls. Tell us how you normally approach this situation.



4. Send a voice recording.



This is REQUIRED.



Please submit a 60–90 second recording introducing yourself and then pretend that you are calling a bankruptcy attorney using the following scenario:



“You are calling on behalf of our marketing office. The owner practiced bankruptcy law in Beverly Hills for approximately 17 years and now helps law firms bring in additional clients. Your goal is to get the attorney interested enough to schedule a short conversation.”



Do NOT simply read this description word-for-word. We want to hear how you naturally communicate on the telephone.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.



Important



We are NOT looking for someone who sounds like they are reading from a call-center script.



We want someone who can have a natural conversation with an attorney, build curiosity, handle objections professionally, and get the attorney to agree to a short conversation with our owner.



If you are confident on the telephone, competitive, persistent, and comfortable speaking with U.S. attorneys and business owners, we would like to hear from you.

title: Real Estate Lead Manager
description:
Lead Manager – U.S. Real Estate Investment Company

FULL-TIME | REMOTE – PHILIPPINES | $19,000–$24,000 USD EXPECTED ANNUAL COMPENSATION

$265 USD/WEEK BASE PAY + 1% COMMISSION

About the Company

My Easy Offer is a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in nationwide novation and wholesale real estate transactions. We work directly with motivated homeowners throughout the United States who have expressed interest in selling their properties.

We are hiring a full-time Lead Manager based in the Philippines to become the first point of contact for new seller leads entering our CRM.

Expected Total Compensation: $19,000–$24,000 USD Per Year

This position includes a $265 USD weekly base salary PLUS 1% commission on the net assignment fee from qualifying deals that successfully close.

This is a long-term, performance-driven position with significant commission potential for someone who is excellent on the phone, competitive, dependable, personable, and motivated to produce results.

The Role

Our company purchases inbound seller leads from homeowners who have expressed interest in receiving a cash offer for their property. These leads automatically enter our CRM, and speed-to-lead is one of the most important parts of this position.

When a new lead enters the system, your goal is to call that homeowner within 30 seconds whenever possible.

Your job is to start a natural conversation, understand the homeowner's situation, gather the information necessary to evaluate the opportunity, and determine whether the lead could potentially become a real estate deal.

When you identify a qualified opportunity, your objective is to schedule a phone appointment between the homeowner and our Sales Manager.

You are not responsible for negotiating or closing the final real estate transaction. Your responsibility is to make contact, build rapport, qualify and follow up with leads, identify potential opportunities, and get qualified homeowners onto the Sales Manager's calendar.

This Is a Heavy Phone Position

Candidates should understand from the beginning that this is a high-volume calling position.

You will be expected to make a minimum of 300 phone dials per working day.

A significant portion of your workday will be spent making calls, speaking with homeowners, following up with existing leads, attempting to reach unresponsive leads, updating the CRM, and setting appointments.

If you do not enjoy being on the phone for a large portion of the day, this position will not be a good fit.

We are looking for someone who can maintain a high level of call activity every day while still having friendly, natural, and productive conversations when homeowners answer.

What You'll Be Doing

• The condition of the property

• Repairs, renovations, or updates the property may need

• Why the homeowner wants to sell

• Their desired timeline for selling

• Their asking price or price expectations

• Their level of motivation

• Any circumstances that could affect the sale

• Other information needed to determine whether the property could be a potential deal

• Consistently following up with leads who do not initially answer or are not yet ready to sell

• Entering detailed and accurate CRM notes after conversations and follow-up attempts

What Makes a Great Lead Manager

We do not want someone who simply reads questions from a script. We want someone who knows how to talk to people.

You should be able to make homeowners feel comfortable, build rapport quickly, listen carefully, ask intelligent follow-up questions, and keep the conversation moving naturally.

Some homeowners may be friendly and eager to sell. Others may be skeptical, frustrated, emotional, distracted, or unsure about what they want to do. A great Lead Manager knows how to adjust to different personalities while remaining friendly, professional, and focused on gathering the information needed to determine whether an opportunity exists.

Compensation & Earning Potential

EXPECTED TOTAL ANNUAL COMPENSATION: $19,000–$24,000 USD

Base Pay: $265 USD per week

Commission: 1% of the net assignment fee on qualifying deals that successfully close.

The $19,000–$24,000 USD expected annual compensation includes base pay plus expected commissions based on successful performance in the position.

This is a performance-driven role. Your earning potential increases as you become better at contacting leads quickly, uncovering seller motivation, qualifying opportunities, following up consistently, and setting quality appointments that ultimately result in closed transactions.

Required Work Schedule

This is a 44-hour-per-week position operating according to U.S. Eastern Time (ET).

Monday: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM ET

Tuesday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

Wednesday: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM ET

Thursday: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM ET

Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

Saturday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM ET

Total: 44 hours per week

Applicants in the Philippines must be comfortable working these hours regardless of the corresponding local time. Because new leads must be contacted immediately, punctuality and consistent availability during all scheduled hours are mandatory.

Performance Expectations

• Minimum 300 phone dials per working day

• Speed-to-lead, with the goal of calling new leads within 30 seconds

• Contact rate and number of meaningful seller conversations

• Quality and completeness of CRM notes

• Follow-up consistency

• Number of qualified appointments scheduled

• Appointment show rate

• Quality of opportunities passed to the Sales Manager

• Deals generated from qualified appointments

• Overall reliability and attendance

Non-Negotiable Requirements

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Clear, highly understandable spoken English with minimal accent

• Excellent phone communication skills

• Ability to hold friendly, natural conversations without sounding scripted

• Strong listening and questioning skills

• Confidence speaking with U.S. homeowners

• Strong attention to detail and accurate CRM note-taking

• Ability and willingness to make 300+ phone dials per day

• Ability to handle rejection and continue calling with a positive attitude

• Reliable high-speed internet

• Reliable electricity and an appropriate backup solution for outages

• A reliable smartphone

• A quality computer with at least 12 GB of RAM

• A quality headset/microphone

• A quiet, professional work environment suitable for phone calls

• Availability to work the complete U.S. Eastern Time schedule

Exclusive Full-Time Position

This must be your only job.

We will not hire applicants who are currently working another job or who intend to work another job while employed in this position.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team and dedicate their complete professional attention to this role. During scheduled working hours, you are expected to be completely available and focused on My Easy Offer.

Preferred Experience

Previous experience in U.S. real estate, real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, novations, lead management, appointment setting, inside sales, outbound calling, call centers, or other phone-based sales positions is highly desirable.

Previous real estate experience is preferred but is not mandatory for an exceptional candidate who has strong phone skills, excellent English, and the ability to learn quickly.

Who We're Looking For

We are not looking for someone who simply wants another remote VA position. We are looking for someone who wants to become an exceptional Lead Manager and build a long-term position with our company.

The ideal candidate is friendly, competitive, coachable, persistent, organized, confident, dependable, and naturally good at talking to people.

You should be comfortable hearing "no" repeatedly without becoming discouraged. You should enjoy chasing opportunities, following up, talking with different personalities, and figuring out what is really motivating a homeowner to sell.

Most importantly, you should understand that speed, consistency, conversations, and qualified appointments drive results.

If you're excellent on the phone, communicate extremely well in English, enjoy sales, can handle a high-volume calling environment, and want your performance to directly impact how much money you earn, we want to hear from you.

Position Summary

Company My Easy Offer

Website 

Industry U.S. Real Estate Investment

Position Lead Manager

Location Remote – Philippines

Employment Full-Time, Exclusive

Schedule 44 Hours Per Week

Minimum Call Volume 300 Dials Per Day

Time Zone U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

Base Pay $265 USD Per Week

Commission 1% of Net Assignment Fee on Qualifying Closed Deals

Expected Total Compensation $19,000–$24,000 USD Per Year

title: Real Estate Data and SMS VA
description:
B. Johnson Land Group is an active real estate investment company specializing in off-market land acquisitions. We are launching a high-volume direct-to-owner marketing campaign and are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and fast-moving Virtual Assistant to manage our daily data loading and text messaging inbox.



This is a stable, long-term full-time position.



## Compensation & Benefits:



* Base Salary: $800 per month

* Performance Incentives: 1% commission profit split per closed transaction 

* Milestone Volume Bonus: An additional $150 cash bonus for every month our team clears 5 or more closed transactions



## Daily Responsibilities:



* Daily List Segmenting: Download raw property lists from our system, delete unnecessary tax/junk data columns, and clean the formatting headers inside Excel/Google Sheets.

* Skip-Tracing Pipeline: Upload daily 2,500-row data batches into our Deal Machine account to append owner contact details.

* Campaign Management: Load skip-traced files into Smarter Contact and launch our daily text blasts at our standard paced rate of 312 messages per hour.

* Replying to Texts: Actively monitor the Smarter Contact texting inbox, archive opt-outs, and manually text back our pre-calculated cash offers to interested landowners and some offer comping for select offers. (You will be trained on comping)

* Internal Routing: The exact second a seller accepts an offer or provides a reasonable counter-offer, you will click a single button to webhook the file straight to our phone sales closer's queue.

* Contract Delivery: Fill out our standard 2-page land agreement template inside our CRM with the final price and text the signature link to the seller when signaled by our sales closer.



## Requirements:



* Proven experience managing SMS text marketing campaigns for real estate investors (experience with Smarter Contact or Launch Control is highly preferred).

* Strong data organization skills with complete proficiency in Microsoft Google Sheets (list cleaning, column mapping, and basic formulas).

* Exceptional written English skills with the ability to text property owners professionally, clearly, and quickly.

* High reliability and the ability to work independently using our company SOP guidelines.



## Corporate Structure & Communication Boundaries:

Our company operates on a structured, asynchronous workflow. The principal owner is completely unavailable for live calls or instant text replies during the daytime hours due to other corporate project commitments.

All technical questions, data hurdles, or underwriting exceptions will be dropped into our designated team Slack channels. The owner logs in to review logs, answer all questions, and clear pipeline files daily starting at 5:00 PM Pacific / 8:00 PM Eastern. You must be comfortable managing your dashboard tasks independently during your shift using our training guides.

## To Apply:

Please reply to this posting with a brief summary of your real estate SMS marketing experience, a list of the specific texting platforms you have previously operated and if you are available to work full time M-F 9-5 EST.

title: META ADS | UGC, VSL & AI VIDEO EDITOR
description:
We're hiring an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, keeps people watching, builds desire, and gets them to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time, remote role (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for an editor who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a strong instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Experienced Fashion Dropshipping Support — On-Call for Peak Days ($3.50/hr)

- If you say yes, you work minimum 3 hours 

- Paid weekly at $3.50 per hour



💼 What you'll do

- Respond to customer emails in Help Scout — professional, friendly, on time

- Handle WISMO, delivery delays, returns, cancellations and sizing questions

- Escalate anything you are not sure about instead of guessing

- Working closely with the teamleader



What makes this easier than your last job: most tickets already have a draft reply and the order facts prepared when you open them. You check it, adjust it, send it. You are not digging through five systems for every email.



✅ Requirements (Must-Have)

- Minimum 2 years of customer support experience in a fashion dropshipping store Shopify based

- You have worked for a store doing at least $100,000 per month in revenue. You do not need to name the company — we will ask about volume and ticket load

- Experience with returns, sizing questions and delivery issues in fashion e-commerce

- Fluent English 

- Hands-on with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk) and with Shopify admin

- Strong in Google Sheets

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, backup power, and a quiet place to work

- You reply to a shift request within 15 minutes, first one responds will get start working

- Individual applicants only — no agencies, no teams under one account



⭐ Nice to Have

Experience with Cwill or Chinese tracking systems

Familiar with EU consumer rules

Able to work night shifts (Philippines time)



🎁 What We Offer

- $3.50 per hour, minimum 3 hours per call-out, paid weekly

- Full freedom to decline a shift 

- Clear written procedures and prepared drafts, so you are never guessing

- A fast team with short lines — you talk directly to the team leader, not to three layers

- The people who perform well in this pool are the first we consider for a permanent full-time position



📩 How to Apply

Reply to this post and include:



- A video introduction — who you are, what you are good at, and why this fits you as well as answering the underneath questions

- Your answers to these six questions, in order:

1. What was the monthly revenue range of the largest store you supported — under €100k, €100k–€250k, €250k–€500k, or above €500k? How many tickets per day did you handle, and how big was the support team?

2. Which helpdesk and which store platform did you work in, and for how long?

3. A customer emails on day 9 of a 12-day delivery window: "Where is my order? This is ridiculous, I want my money back." Tracking shows the parcel left the sorting center in the destination country two days ago. Write the exact reply you would send in your response (you don’t have to include this question in your video introduction)

4. What is the last thing you check before you press send on any reply?

5. Which hours (Philippine time) are you realistically available at short notice?

6. Do you currently have other clients? How many hours per week are you already committed to?



You do not need to name the company you worked for — we care about scale and volume, not names.



❗ Apply only if you:

- Have 2+ years of experience in fashion dropshipping support

- Worked for a store doing $100k+ per month

- Can work a minimum of 3 hours per call-out

- Are fluent in English

- Can reply to a shift request within a short time

- Are applying as an individual, not through an agency



This first round stays open for 24 hours only. After that we move forward with the people who responded within the deadline. So if this is you — don't wait.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Remote Recruitment Coordinator to support and manage the day-to-day recruitment process for our growing U.S.-based organization.

We operate multiple locations across the United States and are continuously hiring for a variety of positions. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our recruitment pipeline — making sure every open position is actively advertised, applications are reviewed promptly, and qualified candidates are identified and passed to the appropriate hiring manager.

Key Responsibilities

Job Posting & Sourcing

Maintain an up-to-date list of all open positions across our locations.

Post and regularly refresh positions across platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn,
, relevant
 Groups, and other recruiting channels.

Candidate Screening

Serve as the first point of review for incoming applications and resumes.

Review resumes against the requirements and qualifications provided for each position.

Identify strong candidates and filter out applicants who do not meet the basic requirements.

When required, conduct brief initial screening calls to confirm experience, availability, communication skills, compensation expectations, and overall fit.

Present hiring managers with a shortlist of qualified candidates rather than large volumes of unfiltered applications.

Recruitment Pipeline Management

Track candidates through each stage of the hiring process.

Follow up internally to ensure qualified candidates are reviewed quickly.

Keep management updated on hiring activity, candidate volume, and positions that require additional attention.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, recruitment coordination, or candidate sourcing.

Experience recruiting for U.S.-based companies is strongly preferred.

Strong experience with Indeed and LinkedIn.

Experience sourcing candidates through
, online communities, and other recruiting channels.

Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Strong judgment when reviewing resumes and evaluating candidate fit.

Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple open positions simultaneously.

Proactive and able to work independently without needing constant direction.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, recruitment trackers, and online recruiting platforms.

Reliable, responsive, and detail-oriented.

Medical spas / aesthetics

Healthcare

Beauty & wellness

Sales

Front desk / customer service

Estheticians and service providers

Medical or clinical positions

Multi-location businesses

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means that management always has a clear picture of what positions are open, every position is actively being advertised, applications are reviewed quickly, and hiring managers receive a manageable shortlist of strong candidates.

We are the placement company, not the practice itself. If you pass screening and interviews, you complete our free eye care training (60+ hours) and earn our Virtual Assistant Certificate. WHAT YOU WILL DO

VIRTUAL RECEPTIONIST



Answering patient calls,
s and messages

Scheduling, confirming and rescheduling appointments

Patient recalls and answering questions about eye care services



ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT



Verifying vision and medical insurance and gathering patient information

Updating patient chart records

Fax and file management, orders and other back office tasks



VIRTUAL SCRIBE



Live scribing during patient exams

Accurate, confidential chart documentation in the practice's EHR



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Once placed: full time hours at $7.00 USD per hour, on U.S. clinic hours (night shift in the Philippines)

A long term placement with one U.S. practice, rather than rotating between clients

Free specialized eye care training, with no fees at any stage

Fully remote work from your own home



REQUIREMENTS



Experience as a virtual assistant for a U.S. optometry or ophthalmology practice

Bachelor's degree, with proof of education

Philippine citizen, residing in the Philippines

Excellent spoken and written English

Strong computer skills and the ability to multitask across systems

A reliable computer, stable internet and a quiet home workspace

Available full time for U.S. business hours, which are night shifts in the Philippines

Highly organized, professional and patient focused



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



Practice management and EHR systems such as RevolutionEHR, Eyefinity, OfficeMate, CrystalPM, MaximEyes or Compulink

Vision plan verification and prior authorizations with VSP, EyeMed or Davis Vision

Patient recalls, contact lens and eyeglass orders, and optical support

Applications are submitted on our website. To find it, search Google for "eye care works apply" and open the careers page, then choose Apply.

title: Patient Care Coordinator — US Medical Clinics (Phone / Appointment Setting)
description:
APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VOICE RECORDING WILL NOT BE VIEWED OR LOOKED AT.



Schedule: US Eastern hours (late evening / overnight Philippine time)

Paid: Weekly, every Sunday, via Wise



About the role



We run patient acquisition for regenerative medicine clinics across the United States — stem cell, PRP and exosome therapy. Real clinics, real doctors, treatments that cost patients $5,000–$15,000.



Your job is one thing: get people who enquire online into a chair in front of a doctor.



When a patient submits a form, you call them within minutes. You find out what's wrong with them, whether we can help, and you book them into a free in-person consultation. Then you make sure they actually turn up.



This is not chat support. This is not data entry. You will be on the phone with Americans, most of them aged 50–75, many of them in pain and nervous about spending money. They need to trust you in the first fifteen seconds.



What you'll do



Call new patient enquiries within 5 minutes of them coming in

Qualify them properly — condition, history, timeline, ability to pay

Book them into the clinic's calendar

Confirm and re-confirm appointments so they show up

Work leads that didn't answer the first time (most bookings come from call 4–8, not call 1)

Log everything accurately in our CRM



What we need



2+ years on the phone with US customers — BPO, call centre, appointment setting, healthcare, insurance or sales

English that an American will not have to strain to understand. Clear, warm, unhurried

Genuinely comfortable making 80–120 calls in a shift

A quiet room, a headset, and a stable connection — plus a backup plan for brownouts and internet outages

Someone who takes correction well. Your calls will be reviewed and you'll be coached on them



What we don't need



General VAs looking for a light admin job

Anyone who needs to be chased to make calls

Anyone who can't or won't work the US schedule long-term



Why this pays above market



$7/hour is high for this market and we know it. We pay it because we want people who stay, who get good, and who treat this as a career rather than a stopgap. Our top coordinators go on to lead teams. In return we expect performance, and we measure it: speed to call, booking rate, show-up rate.



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, applications that miss any step are deleted unread



Put PATIENT-COORD-2026 in your subject line.



Record a voice message, 2–3 minutes, using Vocaroo or Loom. Send the link. In it:



Introduce yourself and tell us the US accounts you've worked on



Then role-play this: you're calling Margaret, 64, who filled in a form about knee pain last night and hasn't spoken to anyone yet. 



Your goal is to book her into a free consultation this week. Just start the call and run it as you would for real.



Tell us in two sentences: what's the hardest objection you've ever handled on a call, and what did you say?



Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test, and tell us what your backup is when the power or internet goes down.



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed. We hire on how you sound, not how you write.

⚠️ READ THIS FIRST: applications without a voice recording are deleted unread. No exceptions. Instructions at the bottom.



The role



You call people in the US who've enquired about stem cell and PRP therapy for chronic pain. Mostly aged 50–75, told by a surgeon their only option is a knee replacement. Treatments cost $5k–$15k.



Your job: get them on the phone fast, build trust, and book them in to see the doctor.



Pay



$7/hour base



Hours: 33/week — 5 hrs/day Mon–Fri plus one 8-hour weekend day. US Eastern hours. Paid weekly via Wise.



You need



2+ years phone sales to US customers (any industry)

English an American doesn't have to strain to understand

Comfortable with 80–120 dials a shift

Coachable — your calls get reviewed

Quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup for outages



Don't apply if you want an admin job with "sales" in the title, or you can't commit to US hours long-term.



HOW TO APPLY



Subject line: SALES-REP-2026

Voice recording, 2–3 minutes (Vocaroo or Loom link). Do this role-play cold, no script: You're calling Frank, 67. Knee pain, enquired four days ago, ignored three calls. He picks up and says: "I've already spent twelve grand on injections that did nothing. Is this the same thing?" Go. Handle it and book him.



Your best month in phone sales — what was the number, what were you selling?



Internet speed test screenshot.

title: 100+ Properties - STR Ops and Comms, Claims, Cleaner & Maintenance Coordination
description:

You’ll be responsible for keeping operations running smoothly—coordinating with cleaners and maintenance, ensuring documentation is complete, managing inventory and restocks, and providing reliable support so guests enjoy seamless stays.



Key Responsibilities

Coordinate cleaner schedules and follow up to confirm all cleans are completed



Call or message cleaners as needed to ensure timeliness and quality



Review, track, and request proper documentation from cleaners, ensuring all submissions are complete and accurate



Identify and rectify cleaning issues quickly, coordinating re-cleans when necessary



Manage battery changes, troubleshoot small operational issues, and escalate maintenance requests when needed



Coordinate with maintenance teams and track follow-ups to completion



Oversee inventory tracking, restocking, and ordering for supplies and consumables



Keep all task boards, tickets, and operational documentation updated and accurate



Make independent, sound decisions when issues arise, balancing company policies with guest satisfaction



Requirements
