Strong understanding of property management, cleaner coordination, and guest experience



Excellent customer service instincts with proven ability to de-escalate and resolve issues



Exceptional written and verbal communication skills



Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in follow-through



Comfortable managing multiple properties and priorities simultaneously



Preferred Tools Experience



Hostaway PMS (or similar tools like Hospitable, Guesty, etc.)



OTAs (Airbnb, Vrbo, 
)



Slack, OpenPhone, Amazon, Ring, Schlage, Turno



Experience with review management, claims handling, and guest follow-up



To Apply



Please start your application with:



Total years of STR experience



Platforms and tools you’ve used



Number of properties you’ve managed or supported



Brief overview of your daily tasks in previous roles



We’re only considering applicants who follow these instructions. If you’re sharp, dependable, and passionate about guest experience and operational excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
About the Role



4Throws is a growing US based ecommerce company specializing in track and field equipment. We are looking for a highly experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with our CEO and help him stay organized, focused, and effective.



This is not an entry level virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone intelligent, resourceful, organized, and confident who can think independently and take ownership of their responsibilities.



The ideal candidate has significant experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive and understands how to anticipate needs, prioritize competing responsibilities, and solve problems without needing constant direction.



Responsibilities



• Manage and organize the CEO's calendar, meetings, priorities, and follow ups

• Help manage
 and executive communications

• Keep track of important projects, deadlines, and commitments

• Follow up with managers and team members to ensure tasks are completed

• Prepare meeting notes, agendas, documents, reports, and research

• Research problems and present clear recommendations to the CEO

• Coordinate travel, appointments, vendors, and other executive needs

• Assist with recruiting, onboarding, employee documentation, and other HR responsibilities when needed

• Maintain highly confidential company and employee information

• Help improve processes and organization throughout the company

• Handle additional executive and administrative responsibilities as needed



Who We Are Looking For



• At least 5 years of professional experience

• Significant experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Executive Assistant, or similar role

• Experience directly supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Extremely organized and detail oriented

• Strong critical thinking and problem solving abilities

• Able to work independently and make good decisions

• Comfortable taking initiative rather than waiting for instructions

• Excellent research and communication skills

• Experience working with US based companies preferred

• HR or recruiting experience is a strong plus

• Experience with Google Workspace, ClickUp, Slack or similar business tools

• Comfortable learning new technology and using AI tools



Schedule



Full time, 40 hours per week. This position will require regular availability during US business hours.



How to Apply



Please send us a short introduction explaining your experience directly supporting CEOs or senior executives. Include how many years you have worked as an Executive Assistant and the types of responsibilities you handled.



Also answer this question:



Your CEO gives you a task that you have never done before and is unavailable for the next four hours. What would you do?



Please include the word Javelin in the subject line of your application so we know you read the entire job posting.

title: Senior Executive Assistant to Founder — Operations & AI-Enabled Support
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote, Philippines | Compensation Negotiable



WHO YOU WILL SUPPORT

James is a US-based entrepreneur, retired Navy Public Affairs Officer, licensed pastor, and father of eight. He leads an evangelical Christian content and app development company supporting Biblical education, small businesses, and ministry initiatives.

He is a creative, fast-thinking founder who works in bursts—sharing substantial ideas and direction before returning to creative work or recharging.

He needs a trusted right-hand person who captures his thinking, anticipates needs, protects his attention, and follows work through to completion.

We value Biblical integrity, family, direct communication, and long-term relationships. We want this position to support your professional growth and life goals, too.



THE ROLE: EXECUTIVE SUPPORT FIRST

You are James’s executive support partner—not our AI engineer.

Your primary responsibility is to make James more effective and keep his commitments, communications, and projects moving without constant reminders.

You will use our approximately 50 functioning AI agents to help research, draft, organize, and execute work. You will learn to delegate effectively to them, check results, and improve instructions and procedures.

Think: highly capable executive assistant with business judgment and AI fluency—not developer seeking an engineering position.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Understand and Support James

Learn his priorities, preferences, relationships, and decision-making style.

Capture voice notes, conversations, and messages without losing important details.

Turn idea downloads into priorities, next steps, and completed work.

Distinguish new ideas from approved commitments.

Anticipate needs and prepare information before he asks.



Protect His Time and Attention



Manage calendar priorities, inbox triage, meeting preparation, and follow-ups.

Handle routine requests within agreed authority.

Get answers and coordinate actions without making James the middleman.

Protect creative time while escalating genuinely important issues.

Bring concise recommendations—not problems without context.



Drive Execution Using People and AI



Maintain tasks, deadlines, and accountability in ClickUp.

Delegate suitable work to existing agents and human specialists.

Review outputs for accuracy, completeness, and usefulness.

Improve instructions, checklists, and repeatable workflows.

Coordinate content, app, and client projects; involve technical specialists when needed.

Report clearly: completed, next, blocked, decision needed.



Success means less chasing for James and more dependable completion—not more software built.



THE PERSON WE NEED

Experienced in executive support, founder support, or hands-on business coordination.

Strong educational foundation; bachelor’s degree preferred, with substantial equivalent experience considered.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Direct, concise, warm, and confident communication.

Strong judgment: knows when to act, clarify, challenge, or escalate.

Strategic enough to understand the goal; disciplined enough to finish the details.

Comfortable with changing priorities and routine administrative follow-through.

Resourceful with AI tools and willing to learn rapidly.

Honest about mistakes and careful with confidential information.



Coding, agent development, and software engineering are not required. Technical ability is welcome, but it cannot replace excellent executive support.

This is not the right position if your primary interest is building software rather than supporting a founder.



FAITH AND CULTURE

Our work is explicitly evangelical Christian and Bible-centered, including Biblical content and ministry-related projects.

We value personal understanding of the gospel, thoughtful engagement with Scripture, humility, service, and lived integrity—not religious vocabulary alone.

Please answer the faith questions honestly, in your own words. No private or painful disclosures are needed.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION

Compensation negotiable based on capability and experience.

Typical core coverage: 8:00 AM–2:00 PM US Eastern Time.

Remaining agreed hours generally self-directed.

Occasional schedule changes or weekend coverage by arrangement.

Flexibility works both ways; be responsive when James is collaborating during agreed coverage.

This is not unpaid, round-the-clock availability.

This must be your primary professional commitment—not a second job worked around another employer.

Reliable internet, a suitable workspace, and backup connectivity are required.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Subject line: JAMES’S RIGHT HAND — [Your Full Name]

2. Attach your résumé and one relevant work sample with confidential details removed.

3. Answer all 12 questions below, using the same numbering. Keep most answers to 2–4 sentences.

4. Disclose any AI assistance with your application. Your experience and beliefs must be your own.

5. End with: “The first thing I would want to learn about James is…” and complete the sentence.

6. Include your WhatsApp number so we can reach you



Shortlisted applicants will complete an interview and a paid executive-support exercise—not a coding test.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. Executive-support background: Who have you supported, what did you own, and what could they reliably stop worrying about because you handled it? Include relevant education.

2. Anticipation: Describe a time you identified and handled a leader’s need before being asked. How did you know whether to act or seek approval?

3. Working style: Which energizes you more: supporting one leader closely, coordinating projects, or building technical systems? Which parts of this position would require deliberate discipline?

4. Capturing direction: James sends 20 minutes of voice notes covering five projects, then becomes unavailable. What do you do first, what can proceed, and what needs clarification?

5. Protecting attention: A client wants an update, a teammate needs approval, and someone requests a meeting during James’s creative time. How do you handle the requests? Include a sample update to James of no more than 60 words.

6. Judgment and accountability: Describe a mistake or missed commitment and how you handled it. What would you say if James added a new priority that endangered existing commitments?

7. Using AI to finish work: Give a real example of using AI for an administrative or business task. Explain your instructions, how you checked the output, and what you would do if the agent repeatedly missed important details.

8. Organization and follow-through: Describe a tracking system, checklist, or procedure you improved. How did it prevent missed work or reduce the leader’s involvement?

9. Personal faith: Describe your Christian background and faith today. How do Scripture, prayer, and participation in a church or Christian community shape your ordinary life?

10. Gospel understanding: In your own words, what is the gospel of Jesus Christ? How do grace, faith, salvation, and good works relate? Include one or two relevant Bible references.

11. Biblical judgment: What authority does Scripture have when it challenges your preferences? How would you handle AI-generated Biblical content that sounds persuasive but appears to misuse a passage?

12. Practical fit: State your requested compensation, start date, current work commitments, schedule availability, and internet/power backup arrangements. What would help you build a successful long-term working relationship with James?

title: Creator & Affiliate Outreach Specialist – Textile Brand
description:
Creator & Affiliate Outreach Specialist



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | $600 USD/month



KIKI is a fast-growing U.S. fashion fabric company, and we are aggressively expanding our Creator & Affiliate Program.



We are looking for one exceptional person to help us identify, contact, recruit, and build relationships with high-quality creators and influencers.



This is not a basic VA position and it is not a mass-outreach job.



Your job is not simply to send as many messages as possible. Your job is to find the right people, understand them, communicate with them naturally, and bring strong creators into the KIKI Creator Program. 



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



You will:



* Research fashion, sewing, cosplay, DIY, design, lifestyle, fashion designers, custom designers and other relevant creators

* Identify creators who genuinely fit the KIKI brand

* Analyze their content, audience, engagement, style, and potential

* Personally reach out through Instagram, TikTok, email, or other channels

* Write personalized outreach instead of copy-and-paste messages

* Follow up consistently

* Answer questions and handle objections

* Qualify interested creators

* Help onboard strong creators into our affiliate program

* Keep track of outreach, responses, applications, and results

* Continuously improve outreach based on performance





Your performance will eventually be measured by:



Creator quality → response rate → qualified creators recruited → affiliates activated → affiliates generating sales → revenue generated. 



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



This role requires very strong judgment and communication skills.



You should be able to look at an Instagram or TikTok account and quickly understand:



* Is this creator actually a good fit for KIKI?

* Does her audience match our customer?

* Is her engagement real?

* Does she actually influence her audience?

* What would make her interested in KIKI?

* What should we emphasize when contacting her?

* How should we communicate with her?

* Should the approach feel feminine, casual, professional, playful, fashion-forward, premium, etc.? 



Most of the creators we communicate with are women in fashion, sewing, design, cosplay, and creative industries.



Because of this, you must have a natural understanding of:



Fashion. Aesthetics. Style. Social media. Female-focused communication. Brand presentation.



We need someone who understands how to communicate woman-to-woman / human-to-human, rather than sounding like a corporate salesperson.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



Do not apply if your experience is mainly:



* Generic customer support

* Data entry

* Mass cold emailing

* Copy-and-paste outreach

* Sending hundreds of identical DMs

* Following instructions without being able to make decisions independently



Customer service experience is useful, but customer service alone is not enough.



We need someone who can think, research, judge, communicate, persuade, and make decisions independently. 



Strong written English is mandatory.



Experience in any of these areas is highly preferred:



Influencer outreach, creator partnerships, affiliate marketing, social media, fashion, beauty, ecommerce, PR, sales, relationship management, or customer communication.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



This is a performance-based role.



We do not care about someone being "busy" for eight hours.



We care about results.



The first 30 days will be a paid performance trial.



Compensation: $600 USD/month full-time.



Additional bonuses and salary increase may be added based on measurable performance. It all depends on you.



IMPORTANT — HOW TO APPLY



We expect many applications.



If you do not follow every instruction below, your application will not be reviewed.



At the very top of your application, write:



KIKI CREATOR TEAM



If this phrase is missing, the application will automatically be rejected. 



1. INTRODUCE YOURSELF



Write a short, casual introduction.



We do not want a professional cover letter.



Write the way you would naturally communicate with another person.



If your introduction sounds extremely corporate, robotic, or obviously AI-generated, we will not continue reviewing the application.



2. TELL US ABOUT YOUR RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us specifically about any experience you have with:



* Influencer outreach

* Creator partnerships

* Affiliate marketing

* Sales

* Fashion

* Social media

* Customer relationships

* Ecommerce

* PR



Be honest.



If you do not have direct experience in one of these areas, say so. Lack of direct affiliate experience will not disqualify you if you demonstrate exceptional judgment and communication skills.



3. FIND 5 POTENTIAL KIKI CREATORS



Find 5 real Instagram or TikTok creators who you believe could become strong KIKI affiliates.



For each one, provide:



Creator username:

Platform:

Why you selected her: 1–2 sentences.



We care significantly more about why you selected someone than follower count.



4. WRITE AN OUTREACH MESSAGE



Choose one of the five creators.



Write the exact first message you would personally send her on behalf of KIKI.



Do not write generic outreach such as:



“Hi! We love your content! We’d love to collaborate. Join our affiliate program and earn 10%.”



That would not meet our standard. 



Our communication with creators should feel:



Warm. Casual. Personal. Natural. Friendly. Human.



KIKI CREATOR PROGRAM — CONTEXT FOR YOUR TEST



Before completing the next section, you need to understand what you would actually be offering creators.



KIKI is a U.S. fashion fabric brand serving:



* Sewing enthusiasts

* Fashion designers

* Costume makers

* Cosplayers

* Small fashion brands

* DIY creators

* Other creative customers



The primary goal of your outreach is to recruit strong creators into the KIKI Creator Program. 



You should not pitch every creator the same way.



A sewing creator with 8,000 highly engaged followers might require a completely different approach from a general fashion creator with 100,000 followers.



Your job is to understand the person before d
 how to approach her.



LEVEL ONE — AFFILIATE



Everyone starts here.



Affiliates receive:



* 10% commission on eligible referred sales

* 10% off for their audience on their first KIKI purchase

* Their own personal affiliate link

* Their own discount code

* Access to Win Your Fabric Back

* $100 KIKI store credit after reaching $2,000 in lifetime referred sales



Joining the affiliate program is free. 



WIN YOUR FABRIC BACK



A creator may purchase at least $80 of KIKI fabric.



If she then generates $300 in referred sales within 30 days after receiving the fabric, she receives $80 back as KIKI fabric credit.



This is optional.



It gives creators an opportunity to earn their initial fabric investment back instead of KIKI automatically sending free fabric to every new affiliate. 



LEVEL TWO — PROVEN AFFILIATE



A creator becomes a Proven Affiliate after generating:



$8,000–$24,999 in referred sales during a rolling 90-day period.



They receive:



* Everything from Affiliate level

* $250 KIKI fabric credit when they first reach $8,000

* Occasional surprise fabric gifts

* More opportunities to receive fabric and create content 



LEVEL THREE — KIKI AMBASSADOR



A creator becomes a KIKI Ambassador after generating:



$25,000+ in referred sales during a rolling 90-day period.



Ambassadors receive:



* 15% commission

* Monthly KIKI fabric credit while qualifying

* Early access to new fabric launches

* Surprise fabric gifts and packages

* Direct communication with the KIKI team

* Support, ideas, and feedback designed to help their content perform better 



Creator levels are based on their previous 90 days of performance.



Creators can move up as their sales increase and may move down if performance decreases.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



You are not simply sending affiliate invitations.



Before contacting a creator, we expect you to think about:



* Who is this creator?

* What does she make?

* Who follows her?

* Why does her audience trust her?

* Does she already sew or use fabric?

* Which KIKI products could fit her content?

* What would genuinely interest her about our program?

* Which program benefit should you emphasize?

* What communication style fits her personality?

* Is she commercially valuable?

* Is she even worth contacting?



We want the creator to feel:



“They actually looked at my content.”



Not:



“This company sent the same message to 5,000 people.” 



APPLICANT TEST



For each scenario below, tell us:



1. Would you contact this person? Why or why not?

2. What would be your main hook?

3. Which part of the KIKI program would you emphasize?

4. Write the exact first message you would send.

5. If appropriate, write a follow-up message.



We want different approaches for different people.



SCENARIO 1 — SEWING MICRO-CREATOR



She has 9,000 Instagram followers.



She makes her own dresses and regularly posts sewing tutorials.



Her Reels typically receive 5,000–20,000 views.



Her followers frequently ask where she purchases her fabrics.



Her aesthetic is feminine and polished.



How would you approach her? 



SCENARIO 2 — LARGE FASHION CREATOR



She has 180,000 followers and produces beautiful fashion content and photography.



However, she rarely sews.



She mainly styles finished clothing and occasionally talks about independent designers.



Would you pursue her for the KIKI Affiliate Program?



If yes, explain your approach.



If no, explain why. 



SCENARIO 3 — COSPLAY CREATOR



She has 38,000 TikTok followers.



She creates elaborate costumes and frequently shows her construction process.



Some of her videos receive more than 300,000 views.



Her communication and content style is colorful, energetic, casual, and fun.



Write an outreach message that fits her personality and audience, rather than sounding like a corporate email. 



SCENARIO 4 — SMALL FASHION DESIGNER



She has 14,000 followers and owns a small clothing brand.



She regularly purchases fabric because she makes and sells dresses.



She doesn’t create many sewing tutorials, but her followers are interested in fashion entrepreneurship and garment design.



How would you position the KIKI Creator Program to her? 



SCENARIO 5 — CREATOR ASKS FOR FREE FABRIC



You contact a sewing creator with 45,000 highly engaged followers.



She replies:



“I would love to collaborate! Can you send me 10 yards of fabric for free and I can post something?”



KIKI does not automatically provide free fabric to new affiliates.



Write your response.



Your goal is to maintain her interest and explain the opportunity without sounding cheap, defensive, robotic, or dismissive. 



SCENARIO 6 — SHE DOESN’T LIKE AFFILIATE PROGRAMS



The creator replies:



“Thank you, but I normally don’t do affiliate links.”



Write your response.



Do not aggressively pressure her.



Show us how you would continue the conversation and determine whether there might still be an opportunity. 



SCENARIO 7 — NO RESPONSE



You find a creator who appears to be an excellent fit for KIKI.



You send your first message.



Five days later, she has not responded.



Write:



Follow-Up #1



Follow-Up #2



Then tell us when you would stop contacting her and why. 



SCENARIO 8 — WHO WOULD YOU PRIORITIZE?



You only have enough time to contact two creators today.



Creator A

250,000 followers

0.5% engagement

General fashion



Creator B

18,000 followers

6% engagement

Sewing and dressmaking



Creator C

70,000 followers

3% engagement

Beauty and lifestyle



Creator D

11,000 followers

8% engagement

Cosplay and costume construction



Choose only two.



Explain why you chose them and why you did not prioritize the other two. 



WHAT WE ARE EVALUATING



There is no single perfect answer.



We are evaluating your:



* Judgment

* Taste

* Research ability

* Communication skills

* Persuasion

* Attention to detail

* Understanding of creators

* Understanding of female-focused communication

* Ability to personalize

* Commercial judgment

* Ability to build relationships

* Ability to think independently



We care much less about whether your English sounds perfectly formal.



We care much more about whether you understand people.



Do not use generic AI-generated answers. Even if eventually you can use of course. Now we want to see your personal judgement.



If every message sounds identical, overly polished, corporate, or disconnected from the person described, your application will not move forward.

title: Creative Growth Strategist | Part-Time Remote
description:
About VibeKast



VibeKast is building audience infrastructure for premium film and television, helping filmmakers activate audiences earlier through curated membership, access, participation, experiences, and community. By building audience during development, filmmakers can generate early revenue, demonstrate demand, and create greater leverage toward financing, marketing, and distribution.



Our immediate growth priority is reaching established filmmakers and producers with serious projects for whom this kind of audience infrastructure can create meaningful strategic value.



The Role



We’re looking for a sharp, curious Creative Growth Strategist to own the creative side of that challenge.



This is not a traditional social media manager or graphic designer role. We need someone who can deeply investigate an audience, understand what makes them tick, uncover the insight, develop the idea, create premium work, and connect that work to action.



You do not need to come from film and television. You do need to be willing to study independent filmmakers and producers until you understand their world, psychology, priorities, pressures, decision-making, and what earns their attention and trust.



VibeKast is also developing a founder-led marketing strategy. You’ll work directly with our Founder/CEO to identify ideas, stories, perspectives, and conversations that can become compelling content and campaigns while helping build a VibeKast brand that can scale beyond its founder.



We don’t want someone who waits for creative briefs. We want someone who researches, thinks, brings ideas, creates excellent work, and learns from what happens.



What You’ll Own



* Research filmmakers and producers to understand their psychology, priorities, objections, language, behaviors, and decision-making.

* Develop original campaign concepts, hooks, messaging, and creative specifically for VibeKast.

* Help develop and execute a founder-led content and marketing strategy.

* Write compelling copy for
, landing pages, social, ads, outreach, campaigns, and calls to action.

* Create polished visual assets and establish a practical VibeKast brand kit and template system that maintains a premium and consistent visual standard.

* Connect creative to a clear journey: audience insight → idea → creative → CTA → action.

* Develop
 and nurture content that moves qualified prospects forward.

* Develop social and community strategies that create relationships, participation, and qualified interest, not simply followers.

* Identify communities, partnerships, events, conversations, and channels that could put VibeKast in front of the right people.

* Work with our Growth Systems & Automation operator, who owns the technical funnel, CRM, automations, tracking, and optimization.

* Review performance and use what we learn to improve the next creative experiment.

* Create short-form video when that’s in your skill set, or effectively brief and manage a video editor.



What We’re Looking For



This is a premium, high-consideration B2B marketing challenge. We need someone who understands that earning the attention and trust of established producers requires a different level of thinking than generating inexpensive consumer leads.



You should have strong visual taste, excellent copywriting ability, an understanding of psychology and marketing, strong concept and campaign-development skills, and the instinct to research what you don’t know rather than make assumptions.



You should understand how design, copy, CTA, and conversion work together and be able to generate ideas independently, challenge weak ideas, and care about performance as much as aesthetics.



Experience marketing high-value B2B services, premium offerings, professional services, or other high-consideration purchases is especially relevant.



Templates are absolutely fine. Generic-looking work isn’t.



Video editing is a strong plus. If editing isn’t your strength, you should have enough visual and storytelling judgment to effectively direct an editor.



What Success Looks Like



You’re not waiting for us to tell you what to post.



You’re learning the business and audience and coming to the table with: I noticed this. I researched it. Here’s the opportunity. Here’s the idea. Here’s what I created. Here’s what happened. Here’s what I think we should try next.



Compensation



$600–$800 USD/month, part-time



There is opportunity for compensation and responsibility to grow as VibeKast grows.



To Apply



No generic cover letter is necessary.



We use AI ourselves and value it as a tool, but we’re interested in your thinking, taste, curiosity, and point of view. A specific answer that sounds like you is much more valuable than a polished generic one.



1. Study VibeKast before answering. Who do you believe we’re trying to reach right now? What would you need to understand about their psychology, priorities, objections, and decision-making before marketing to them? Tell us how you would research and find them, not just what you assume about them.



2. Give us one original idea for getting the attention of the filmmakers or producers VibeKast should be reaching. Walk us through the insight → concept → creative execution → CTA → what happens after they respond. Please don’t give us a generic social media campaign.



3. Show us 2–3 pieces of your strongest creative work. For each, tell us who it was for, what you wanted the audience to do, what you personally created, and why you made those creative choices. Include performance results when available.



4. Show us one piece of marketing or creative work you think is exceptional that you did NOT create. Tell us specifically why you think it works.



5. Tell us about something you created that didn’t work as expected. How did you know? What did you learn, and what did you change?



6. Tell us about the highest-value or highest-consideration product or service you’ve marketed. Who was the buyer, what made the decision difficult, and what did you learn about earning their attention and trust?



7. Tell us about your video capabilities. If you edit, send 1–2 examples of your strongest work. If you don’t, tell us briefly about your experience directing or managing video editors.

title: Short-Form Content Creator + Social Media Growth Strategist
description:
Short-Form Content Creator + Social Media Growth Strategist



IMPORTANT: This application requires 20 OnlineJobs.ph points.

We intentionally set the application cost at 20 points because we are looking for candidates who have read the entire posting and genuinely believe they are a strong fit. Please do not spend your points if you cannot provide the portfolio and performance examples requested below.



NO AGENCIES.

We are hiring one individual directly. Please do not apply on behalf of an agency, outsourcing company, team, or another person. We want to communicate and work directly with the person who will actually be creating the content.



Instagram + TikTok | Vintage Furniture + Interiors



We are a vintage and contemporary furniture company based in Los Angeles looking for a seriously creative social media person in the Philippines who understands internet culture, design, interiors, fashion, music, humor, and what makes people stop scrolling.



This is not a basic Social Media Manager job.



We are not looking for someone whose main skill is scheduling posts, making Canva graphics, or writing generic captions.



We want someone who can look at raw footage of a strange vintage chair, an incredible sofa, a styled room, a customer in the store, a delivery, or something happening behind the scenes and immediately think:



“I know how to turn this into content.”



You should understand TikTok and Instagram Reels deeply — hooks, pacing, editing, storytelling, trends, music, text overlays, retention, shares, saves, comments, and why certain videos take off while others disappear.



Our style is vintage, eclectic, editorial, slightly weird, design-forward, colorful, and culturally aware.



Think less “furniture store social media” and more fashion/design/media brand that happens to sell furniture.



What You’ll Do



You’ll take raw videos and photos from our team and turn them into strong short-form content for TikTok and Instagram Reels.



You’ll also:



* Create original TikTok and Instagram Reel concepts

* Develop strong hooks that stop the scroll immediately

* Edit short-form video

* Write text overlays, captions, and CTAs

* Choose music and audio when appropriate

* Create recurring content series

* Tell our team what footage you need us to shoot

* Adapt content differently for TikTok versus Instagram when needed

* Follow trends without making the brand feel like it is desperately chasing trends

* Understand TikTok-native humor, storytelling, editing, and pacing

* Review performance and identify what should be repeated, changed, or dropped

* Track views, watch time, shares, saves, comments, follows, profile visits, and website traffic

* Identify organic posts that are strong enough to put advertising money behind

* Study furniture, interiors, fashion, vintage, art, architecture, and lifestyle accounts for opportunities

* Test new ideas constantly



Eventually, we want you coming to us saying:



“Here are the three things I think we should shoot this week.”



Not waiting for us to tell you exactly what to post.



What We Are NOT Looking For



We are not hiring someone simply to:



* schedule posts

* make graphics

* repost content

* follow a content calendar someone else creates

* write generic captions

* copy whatever is trending



We want a creative thinker who understands why content works.



You MUST Have



A portfolio of short-form content you personally helped create.



More importantly, we want proof of performance.



Show us examples where your content performed significantly better than the account normally performs.



For example:



An account normally gets 2,000–5,000 views and a video you created reached 75,000 or 200,000.



That interests us much more than someone saying they worked on an account with 2 million followers.



We want to know exactly what YOU did.



Did you create the concept?



The hook?



The edit?



The text?



The music?



The caption?



The posting strategy?



The creative direction?



Tell us.



The Person We’re Looking For



You probably spend a lot of time on TikTok and Instagram.



That’s a good thing.



You notice things online before everyone else starts copying them.



You understand why something feels cool versus why something feels like an advertisement.



You can be funny without trying too hard.



You understand aesthetics, but you also understand that pretty does not automatically mean viral.



Sometimes the strangest object in the store will make better content than the most expensive piece.



You have opinions.



You have taste.



You experiment.



And you pay attention to numbers.



Experience with any of these is a plus:



Vintage furniture

Interior design

Fashion

Art

Architecture

Music

Lifestyle brands

TikTok growth

Instagram growth

UGC

Editorial content

Short-form storytelling

E-commerce



Hours + Pay



Approximately 20 hours per week to start



$7–$9 USD per hour depending on experience and portfolio



We will begin with a 2-week paid trial.



If it is a great fit, this can become a permanent role with additional hours and potential performance bonuses.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send us a generic application.



Start your application with:



I KNOW WHY PEOPLE STOP SCROLLING



Then send us:



1. Links to 3 TikToks or Instagram Reels you personally worked on

2. Screenshots of analytics whenever possible

3. What the account normally averaged versus what your content achieved

4. Exactly what you personally did on each piece of content

5. Links to TikTok or Instagram accounts you have helped grow



Then answer these two questions:



1. What do you think most furniture and interior-design brands are doing wrong on social media right now?



2. If we gave you the exact same raw Sunbeam video, what would you do differently with it on TikTok versus Instagram Reels?



Please do not answer with AI-generated generic advice. We want to hear how you actually think.



Paid Creative Test



Final candidates will receive the same raw Sunbeam footage and complete a small paid creative test.



You’ll create one piece of short-form content including:



* Hook

* Edit

* On-screen text

* Music/audio

* Caption

* CTA



Then briefly tell us why you made those choices and what you would test next if the video underperformed.



Before applying:

This application costs 20 points. Please read everything carefully before applying. Individual applicants only — absolutely no agencies.

title: Web Developer – Framer, Meta Tracking & Shopify
description:
# Web Developer – Framer, Meta Tracking & Shopify



Location: Philippines – Remote

Type: Independent Contractor

Hours: Project-based / ad hoc

Compensation: Hourly - please provide your expected hourly rate



## About Us



We're a UK performance marketing agency specialising in Meta advertising and performance creative for DTC e-commerce brands.



We're looking for a technically capable web developer who can help us with our existing Framer website and, importantly, properly implement and troubleshoot our website tracking.



This isn't a role for someone who has simply installed a Meta Pixel before.



We need someone who understands how website tracking actually works and can investigate problems, diagnose what's wrong and implement the correct solution.



Initially, we have a specific project that needs completing. If you're good at what you do, there is potential for further website and landing-page work with us on an ongoing basis.



## What you'll be working on



Your initial work will involve:



* Making changes and updates to an existing Framer website

* Reviewing our current Meta Pixel and tracking implementation

* Diagnosing tracking issues rather than simply following installation instructions

* Implementing and/or fixing Meta Conversions API (CAPI)

* Ensuring browser and server-side events are configured correctly

* Handling event deduplication where required

* Testing events and confirming that data is being received correctly within Meta Events Manager

* Configuring and troubleshooting Google Tag Manager where required

* Working with GA4 and related website analytics/tracking

* Investigating discrepancies or problems with conversion tracking

* Implementing custom code or scripts where necessary



We don't need you to be the world's leading Framer developer. The website already exists, and initially we mainly need someone comfortable making changes to it.



Your technical understanding of tracking, integrations and web development is more important.



## What we're looking for



You should have genuine hands-on experience with:



* Meta Pixel

* Meta Conversions API

* Meta Events Manager

* Browser-side and server-side tracking

* Event configuration and troubleshooting

* Event deduplication

* Google Tag Manager

* GA4

* Framer

* HTML, CSS and JavaScript where required for implementation or troubleshooting



Most importantly, you need to be capable of diagnosing problems independently.



If an event isn't firing correctly, we don't want someone who immediately needs instructions telling them what to change. We want someone who can investigate the implementation, work out what is happening, test potential solutions and fix it properly.



## Shopify experience is a big plus



We also build landing pages for e-commerce brands, so experience with Shopify development would be particularly useful.



If you understand Shopify themes, Liquid, custom landing pages, tracking implementations and integrations within Shopify, please tell us about this in your application.



There is potential for a longer-term working relationship with the right person, particularly if you can support both development and tracking work across Framer and Shopify.



## Working arrangement



This is initially an ad-hoc, project-based independent contractor position, not a fixed 40-hour-per-week role.



We're not concerned about exactly when you work. You can manage your own working hours, provided communication is reliable and agreed work is completed within the required timeframe.



You will need your own suitable computer and a reliable internet connection.



As an independent contractor based in the Philippines, you will be responsible for your own local taxes, registrations and BIR obligations where applicable.



## How to apply



Please don't send us a generic application telling us that you're a hardworking web developer.



Instead, send us:



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant development and ad tracking experience.

2. Examples of websites/projects you've personally worked on.

3. Details of your experience with Meta Pixel and Conversions API, including an example of a tracking problem you've personally diagnosed or fixed.

4. Details of your experience with Framer.

5. Details of any Shopify development experience you have.

6. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

7. Your general availability over the next few weeks.



Please include the word **TARTAN** somewhere in your application so we know you've read the full job post.



We're much more interested in evidence that you can actually do the work than a long CV or generic cover letter.

title: Facebook Ads | AI Video Generation & Editing
description:
We're hiring an AI video maker and editor who understands one thing: an ad is not judged by how nice it looks. It is judged by whether it stops the scroll, keeps people watching, makes them want the product, and gets them to act.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the health supplement niche. Paid social is one of our main growth channels, so video creative is not "content" to us. It is one of the biggest drivers of the entire business.



This is a full-time role (40 hours per week) creating high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. It suits someone who is comfortable with direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused work.



WHAT YOU'LL CREATE AND EDIT

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars built from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs using scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives made with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos that grab attention fast and drive purchases

- UGC-style creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and right for the platform

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer sales videos built on education and direct-response structure

- Variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about beautiful visuals. We want someone who understands how ads work. Your videos should:

- Stop people within the first 1 to 3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Hold attention with captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Get the benefits across quickly and clearly

- Build trust with reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Lead the viewer toward a click or a purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, and turn them into a polished ad that is ready for testing. When there is no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU

- Have edited video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have produced real creatives with AI tools, not just experimented with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can turn out multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow a reference without copying it blindly

- Have good instincts for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Take feedback well and iterate fast

- Care whether your videos perform, not only whether they look good



Creative that sells does not mean ugly or low quality. It means every editing choice supports the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- HeyGen: creating avatars from photos and animating them realistically

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



IDEALLY YOU ALSO HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus points if you have worked in the health supplement niche.



YOUR DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives to different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Working with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT YOU GET

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand that is scaling aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we want someone who knows how to make ads that get attention, build trust, and convert. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Full-Time Video Editor for 7 Figures Supplement Brand
description:
About Us

We're a fast-growing DTC brand in the health supplement space, scaling with performance-driven creatives. Every ad we launch is backed by data and crafted to convert.



We're looking for a video editor who not only edits but also thinks like a marketer - someone who wants to grow, push limits, and create winning ads at scale.



The Role

We're hiring a Video Editor who can consistently produce high-converting Meta video ads (30–120s). This is a long-term, remote role with a starting salary of $4/hour, which increases if the hit rate is on target. Performance bonuses will also be introduced in the 2nd month.



What You'll Do

- Edit high-converting ads for Meta & Google (30–120s)

- Apply strong hooks, pacing, captions, and transitions

- Work with UGC, b-roll, and AI-generated content (Higgsfield, Heygen, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, Kling, Seedance and VEO3)

- Test UGC-style videos, TikTok-style ads, AI visuals, and VSLs

- Analyze performance data & iterate quickly based on KPIs (hook rate, hold rate, CVR)

- Collaborate closely with the Creative Manager + other editors to push volume

- Source raw footage & voiceovers to bring concepts to life

- Experiment with new formats, trends, and storytelling angles



You Need

- Experience editing performance-driven Meta ads (UGC/direct response)

- Proven portfolio of short-form, direct response ads

- Strong creative eye and ability to deliver 15 ad concepts per week

- Understanding of marketing psychology, hooks, and consumer behavior

- Hunger to grow — willing to test, fail, and iterate fast



What You'll Get

- Base salary: $4 per hour (starting salary that increases if performance is on target) + performance bonuses

- Fully remote role

- Direct collaboration with high-performing editors, strategists and Founder

- Managed under a dedicated Creative Manager who oversees editors and strategy



How to Apply

Start your application with the word HOOK so we know you read the full post.



Then send us the following:



1. Your proven paid-ad work

Send 3–5 individual ads that you personally edited and that actually ran as paid ads.



For each ad, include:

- A link to the final creative

- What product/brand it was for

- What parts of the creative you were responsible for

- How much involvement you had beyond editing, if any



Please do not send only a showreel.



2. Performance evidence

For the ads above, send screenshots from Meta Ads Manager showing the actual performance of the creatives.



Where available, we'd like to see metrics such as:



- Spend

- CTR

- CPC

- CPM

- CPA / Cost per Purchase

- ROAS

- Hook rate / 3-second view rate

- Hold rate or other retention metrics



We understand that not every client gives editors access to all performance data. You may blur client names, account IDs, revenue figures, or other sensitive information.



We mainly want to verify that you have experience producing creatives that were genuinely used and tested with paid traffic.



3. Describe your editing workflow

Briefly explain how you normally go from receiving a creative brief to delivering the finished ad.



For example:

Brief → assets → footage sourcing → rough cut → voiceover → captions → B-roll → sound design → final polish → export → revisions



We want to understand how you actually work, not just see the end result.



4. Tell us which tools you use

List the tools you regularly use for:



- Video editing

- Motion graphics

- Captions

- B-roll / stock footage

- AI video

- AI images

- Voiceovers

- Audio / sound effects

- Asset organization



We’re particularly interested in editors who are comfortable combining traditional editing with modern AI tools.

title: Paralegal
description:
This position will support ARC’s Legal & Compliance function and credit restoration operations by conducting legal and regulatory research, reviewing consumer credit-report matters, preparing and organizing dispute-related documentation, assisting with CFPB complaint matters, maintaining compliance records, and supporting counsel and executive leadership with legal and regulatory projects.



The ideal candidate understands that credit restoration is a highly regulated consumer-services environment and can distinguish between ordinary credit-report inaccuracies, furnisher disputes, consumer reporting agency disputes, identity-theft issues, mixed-file concerns, reinvestigation matters, and potential statutory compliance issues.



Key Responsibilities:

Legal & Regulatory Support: Conduct research concerning applicable Texas and federal laws and regulations affecting ARC’s operations, with particular emphasis on the Fair Credit Reporting Act, Credit Repair Organizations Act (“CROA”), applicable Texas consumer and credit-services laws, and CFPB regulations and guidance. Monitor relevant regulatory developments and assist Legal & Compliance with maintaining current policies, procedures, forms, disclosures, and internal compliance materials.



Credit Report Review & Dispute Support: Review consumer credit reports and supporting documentation for potentially inaccurate, incomplete, duplicated, obsolete, mixed, or otherwise disputed information. Assist with preparing fact-specific dispute correspondence and supporting documentation for consumer reporting agencies and furnishers while maintaining complete records of submissions, responses, supporting evidence, and deadlines.



FCRA Matters: Demonstrate working knowledge of the FCRA and its application to consumer reporting, permissible purposes, accuracy, reinvestigation procedures, furnisher responsibilities, identity-theft information, adverse-action issues, and consumer rights. Assist counsel or authorized management in researching and documenting potential FCRA-related compliance matters.



CFPB Complaint Support: Assist with preparing, organizing, submitting, and tracking consumer complaints through appropriate CFPB processes when authorized and appropriate. Maintain supporting documentation, monitor company responses and deadlines, and help ensure that complaints accurately state the consumer's factual circumstances without exaggeration or unsupported legal conclusions.



Credit Restoration Compliance: Review ARC credit restoration workflows for adherence to applicable contractual, disclosure, cancellation, advertising, payment, recordkeeping, and consumer-protection requirements. Help ensure personnel do not make prohibited or misleading representations concerning credit-score increases, deletion of accurate information, guaranteed results, financing eligibility, or timeframes.



Case & Document Management: Maintain organized electronic matter files, chronologies, correspondence, dispute results, regulatory complaints, client authorizations, supporting records, and internal notes. Track material dates, responses, deadlines, and follow-up requirements through ARC's designated systems.



Legal Drafting: Assist with drafting correspondence, memoranda, factual summaries, chronologies, notices, internal compliance documents, policies, procedures, and other materials under appropriate attorney or management supervision. Proofread legal and business documents for accuracy, consistency, grammar, citations, and professional presentation.

Internal Compliance Support: Work collaboratively with ARC's Legal & Compliance, Operations, Credit Restoration, and executive teams. Assist with internal compliance reviews, personnel training materials, quality-control procedures, and escalation of matters presenting potential legal or regulatory risk.



Required Qualifications:

The successful candidate should possess paralegal experience or equivalent substantive legal-support experience, strong familiarity with Texas and federal legal research, and meaningful knowledge of the FCRA and consumer credit reporting. Experience handling credit-report disputes, credit restoration matters, CFPB complaints, consumer financial services, or regulatory compliance is strongly preferred.



Candidates must demonstrate excellent legal research, analytical, drafting, proofreading, and organizational skills; the ability to handle confidential consumer and company information; meticulous attention to documentation and deadlines; sound professional judgment; and proficiency with electronic document-management and business software.



A paralegal certificate, associate's degree, bachelor's degree, or comparable legal training is preferred. Experience supporting attorneys in consumer law, financial services, credit reporting, regulatory compliance, or civil litigation is highly desirable.

Preferred Knowledge



Particularly valuable experience includes familiarity with 15 U.S.C. § 1681 et seq. (FCRA), CROA, CFPB consumer-complaint procedures, consumer reporting agencies, furnishers, credit-report reinvestigations, identity-theft disputes, credit-report documentation, Texas consumer-protection requirements, and federal civil litigation procedures.



Professional Standards:

ARC expects this position to exercise exceptional discretion, accuracy, professionalism, and integrity. The Paralegal must understand the distinction between providing authorized legal-support services and independently practicing law and must escalate matters requiring legal advice, attorney judgment, or representation to appropriately licensed counsel.

The position requires the ability to work independently while maintaining clear communication with management, meet deadlines consistently, protect confidential and personally identifiable information, and produce work that reflects ARC's standard of professional, first-class service.



About Apollo & Rose Capital Inc.:

Apollo & Rose Capital Inc. provides financial and business services designed to help individuals and businesses strengthen their financial position and move toward their objectives. ARC's service platform includes credit restoration, bookkeeping and financial services, financing solutions, and related business services. title: Operations Specialist GoHighLevel Expert
description:
Apollo & Rose Capital Inc. (“ARC”) is seeking a highly skilled, systems-oriented Operations Specialist — GoHighLevel Expert to support the development, administration, optimization, and day-to-day operation of ARC’s technology and client-management infrastructure.



This position will serve as an internal GoHighLevel (“GHL”) subject-matter expert, responsible for ensuring that ARC’s CRM, pipelines, workflows, automations, client portals, forms, calendars, communications, integrations, and reporting systems operate accurately and efficiently across the organization.



The ideal candidate combines advanced GoHighLevel technical knowledge with strong operational judgment. This is not simply a CRM data-entry position. The Operations Specialist will be expected to build, troubleshoot, optimize, document, and continuously improve ARC’s operational systems while supporting Sales, Operations, Finance, Credit Restoration, Bookkeeping, Financing, Real Estate, and executive leadership.



Key Responsibilities:

GoHighLevel Administration & Development: Serve as a primary administrator and technical resource for ARC’s GoHighLevel environment. Build, configure, maintain, and optimize pipelines, opportunities, workflows, triggers, automations, forms, surveys, calendars, custom fields, tags, templates, dashboards, user permissions, and related CRM functionality.

Workflow & Automation Management: Design and maintain automated workflows that move clients and prospects efficiently through ARC’s business processes. Develop automations for lead assignment, appointment scheduling, follow-ups, internal notifications, document requests, onboarding, status changes, client communications, task creation, and Sales-to-Operations handoffs.



Pipeline Architecture: Build and maintain clearly defined pipelines for ARC’s individual service divisions, including Credit Restoration, Bookkeeping & Financial Services, Personal & Business Financing, and Real Estate Financing. Ensure opportunity stages accurately reflect each client's position within the applicable business process.



Client Portal Administration: Assist with the implementation and ongoing administration of ARC client portals. Ensure clients have appropriate access to documents, statements, communications, forms, service information, and other authorized materials while maintaining separation and confidentiality between individual client accounts.



Sales-to-Operations Handoff: Establish reliable processes for transferring closed or qualified opportunities from Sales to Operations. Confirm that required client information, agreements, documents, payments, notes, service selections, and assigned personnel are properly documented before operational fulfillment begins.



Lead Management & Distribution: Configure and monitor lead-routing systems to ensure new opportunities are promptly assigned to the appropriate salesperson, department, or manager. Identify unworked leads, stalled opportunities, missed follow-ups, and other pipeline deficiencies requiring management attention.



Payment & Integration Support: Assist with the configuration and operational maintenance of approved payment processors and third-party integrations connected to GoHighLevel. Coordinate with management and authorized vendors when troubleshooting integrations, API connections, payment workflows, calendars, communications, or other connected systems.

CRM Data Integrity: Maintain high standards for CRM accuracy and completeness. Regularly review records for duplicate contacts, incorrect pipeline placement, missing information, outdated opportunity statuses, inconsistent tags, incomplete notes, and other data-quality issues.



Reporting & Performance Dashboards: Develop and maintain operational dashboards and reports that allow leadership to evaluate lead volume, response times, appointments, conversion activity, pipeline value, closed business, follow-up performance, client onboarding, and other key performance indicators.



Testing & Quality Assurance: Test new workflows, automations, forms, pipelines, integrations, payment processes, and client-facing systems before deployment. Perform end-to-end testing to identify broken links, incorrect triggers, duplicate communications, routing failures, permission issues, or other operational defects.



Troubleshooting & Technical Support: Investigate and resolve GoHighLevel-related issues reported by ARC personnel. Determine whether problems arise from configuration, user behavior, automation logic, permissions, integrations, or third-party systems and coordinate escalation when necessary.



Standard Operating Procedures: Develop and maintain clear SOPs, process maps, system documentation, troubleshooting guides, and training materials for ARC’s GoHighLevel environment and related operational processes.

Personnel Training: Train ARC personnel on proper CRM usage, pipeline management, client documentation, opportunity updates, notes, tasks, workflows, calendars, communications, and departmental procedures. Reinforce consistent use of GoHighLevel as ARC’s central operational system of record.



Operational Excellence:

The Operations Specialist will work closely with ARC leadership to identify unnecessary manual processes and convert appropriate functions into standardized, measurable, and automated workflows.

The position should continually evaluate ARC’s operating environment using the principle:

Lead → Qualification → Consultation → Agreement/Application → Operations → Service/Funding → Follow-Up → Cross-Sell → Referral → Repeat Client

title: Recruitment Appointment Setter | Remote
description:
Recruitment Appointment Setter | Remote



Full-Time | Independent Contractor | US Hours





We’re looking for a full-time Recruitment Appointment Setter to join our remote team, supporting multiple clients across the United States.



This is a hybrid calling and recruitment administration role. You’ll speak with candidates, schedule interviews, manage follow-ups and candidate records, and support different stages of the recruitment process.



Some candidates will have applied directly for a position, while others will have been matched with an opportunity based on their profile. You’ll need to confidently introduce opportunities, create interest, handle questions or objections, and guide suitable candidates toward an interview.



This is a long-term opportunity, and we’re looking for someone who wants to become a consistent and dependable part of the team. Reliability is extremely important to us — we need someone we can count on to show up consistently, take ownership of their responsibilities, and maintain a high standard of work day after day.



As you develop, you may work across different parts of the recruitment pipeline or take ownership of the full candidate process for assigned clients, including communicating directly with clients and implementing their instructions and updates.





What You’ll Be Doing



Calling applicants and candidates matched with relevant opportunities

Conducting initial screening conversations

Introducing roles, building interest, and handling candidate objections

Booking and coordinating interviews

Following up with candidates by phone, SMS, and

Managing candidate records and updating CRM systems accurately

Supporting different stages of the recruitment pipeline

Handling scheduling, data entry, and recruitment administration

Communicating directly with US clients and implementing their instructions

Managing multiple candidates, clients, tasks, and priorities

Working toward daily and weekly performance targets





What We’re Looking For



Previous experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, sales, recruitment, or a similar phone-based role

Excellent spoken and written English

Clear, natural, and confident communication on the phone

High energy and the ability to build rapport quickly

Strong listening skills and the ability to respond naturally rather than simply reading from a script

Confidence handling questions and objections

Excellent attention to detail

Strong organisation and the ability to multitask effectively

Ability to understand and follow detailed instructions accurately

Professional communication skills for working directly with US clients

Strong computer literacy and confidence learning new systems

Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities

Coachable and able to apply feedback quickly

Highly reliable and consistent in both attendance and quality of work

Looking for a stable, long-term position and committed to growing with the team

Reliable internet and consistent availability during US working hours





Compensation



$200 USD per week | 40 hours per week, including a Saturday shift



Weekly performance bonuses are available after successfully completing the probation period.



This is a full-time independent contractor position.







To Be Considered



Please submit:



1. Your CV



2. A 1–2 minute voice recording created specifically for this application, answering both questions:



1. What interests you most about this position, and why do you think you would be good at a role combining candidate calls with recruitment administration?



2. Imagine you’re speaking with a candidate during an initial screening call. When you offer them an interview, they say:



“I’m not sure. I’ve applied for quite a few jobs and I don’t really know if I’m interested anymore.”



How would you respond and try to encourage them to move forward with the interview?



Please answer naturally in your own words. We want to hear your personality, energy, and communication style.



Generic or previously recorded introductions will not be considered.







Recruitment Process



Our recruitment process consists of:



1. Initial screening call — a brief conversation to assess communication skills and initial suitability.



2. First Zoom interview & practical assessment — learn more about the role and complete practical exercises based on the work you would actually be doing.



3. Second Zoom interview — a final conversation to discuss your experience, assessment, and overall suitability.



4. Final hiring decision







Ready to Apply?



If you’re a confident communicator who enjoys working with people, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and take on more responsibility, we’d love to hear from you.



Submit your CV and voice recording to apply. We’re reviewing applications as they arrive, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Virtual Assistant - US Cleaning Co, AI-Savvy, 9-5 EST
description:
READ THIS FIRST



This is our FIRST hire. There is no existing admin to shadow and no training department. You will be the only person besides the owners touching the daily operation.



If you want a role where someone hands you a task list every morning, this is not it. If you want to OWN the admin function of a growing US business and build the systems yourself, keep reading.



We are Clever Cleaners, a residential cleaning company in South Florida. Customers book cleanings, cleaners go clean them, and a hundred small things have to happen correctly in between. Your job is to make sure every one of those things happens without the owners having to chase it.



SCHEDULE: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM US Eastern (9:00 PM - 5:00 AM Manila). Weekends OFF.

PAY: $5/hour, 40 hours/week. Paid via Wise, semi-monthly.

TRIAL: Paid 30-day trial, then 30/60/90-day reviews before permanent. Performance review and raise conversation at 6 months.



------------------------------



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



CUSTOMER SERVICE AND COMMUNICATION

- Answer customer calls, texts, and
s during EST business hours

- Respond to inbound leads fast - our target is under 15 minutes during business hours

- Send quotes and follow up on quotes that have not been answered

- Confirm every job with both the customer and the cleaner

- Handle quality complaints: apologize properly, schedule the redo, escalate to the owners when a refund is on the table

- Request reviews after completed jobs and follow up on reputation

- Re-engage past customers and keep recurring customers on the calendar



SCHEDULING AND CLEANER COORDINATION

- Build and maintain the daily and weekly schedule

- SAME-DAY CANCELLATIONS - rebook the customer and find replacement coverage for the cleaner

- CLEANER NO-SHOWS - run the escalation protocol, find coverage, notify the customer before they notice

- Track cleaner availability, territory coverage, and gaps in recurring schedules

- Send cleaners job details, access instructions, and special customer requests

- Manage entry codes, lockbox info, and key handoffs - securely, documented, never in a group chat



OPERATIONS AND ADMIN

- Keep the CRM, scheduling system, and spreadsheets accurate and current

- Support new cleaner onboarding: collect paperwork, track documents, chase what is missing

- Collect and file before/after photos and completed job checklists

- Basic invoicing and payment follow-up

- Maintain task lists, follow-up queues, and internal records

- WRITE AND MAINTAIN OUR SOPs so the process lives in a document, not in your head



OUR TOOLS

- CRM and
: Loops

- Phone and texting: Quo

- Plus Google Workspace and spreadsheets daily



You do not need prior experience in Loops or Quo specifically. You need to be the kind of person who learns a new tool in a day and then documents it for the next person.



------------------------------



AI AND TECH PROFICIENCY - REQUIRED



This is not a "nice to have." Do not apply if this section does not describe you.



- You use an AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) HANDS-ON, DAILY - drafting customer replies, summarizing long threads, cleaning up spreadsheets

- You write clear prompts and you CHECK THE OUTPUT before it reaches a customer. Our messages must never sound AI-written. AI is your drafting tool, not your voice

- You are comfortable with automation / workflow tools (Zapier, Make, or similar) and can build or fix a simple automation

- You can write an SOP that another person could follow without asking you questions

- You learn new software quickly - we will not be able to hand-hold you through it



------------------------------



EXPERIENCE BAR



- 2+ YEARS as a VA or admin for a US-BASED SERVICE BUSINESS (home services, trades, cleaning, HVAC, landscaping, property management - anything with crews and schedules)

- You have been THE ONLY ADMIN somewhere before, or you are ready to be

- You have OWNED A FUNCTION END TO END - not just completed tasks someone else assigned you

- Excellent written and spoken English, neutral accent, confident on the phone with US customers

- SPANISH IS A PLUS, NOT A REQUIREMENT. Strong English is what matters. Several of our cleaners speak Spanish, so even basic conversational Spanish is useful. If you have any, say so honestly in your application



------------------------------



SKILLS TEST (part of hiring - paid)



Everyone who reaches the final round does a live working session:



1. MOCK UPSET CUSTOMER TEXT - the cleaner missed the baseboards and the customer is angry. Write the reply.

2. DOUBLE-BOOKED SCHEDULE CONFLICT - two jobs, one cleaner, both customers expecting 10 AM. Solve it.

3. AI-ASSISTED DATA CLEANUP - a messy customer spreadsheet. Clean it, and show us how you used AI to do it.



We are grading judgment, not speed.



------------------------------



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (how you will be measured)



- Inbound lead response time under 15 minutes during business hours

- 100% of next-day jobs confirmed with both customer and cleaner 24 hours ahead

- ZERO UNSTAFFED JOBS - every scheduled job has a confirmed cleaner

- 90%+ monthly retention of recurring customers

- Every quote followed up within the agreed window

- SOPs written and current for every process you own



------------------------------



AUTHORITY LIMITS



Clear boundaries so you never have to guess:



- You CANNOT issue discounts, refunds, or credits above a set dollar amount without owner approval

- You CANNOT set, negotiate, or discuss cleaner pay with anyone

- You CANNOT make hiring or firing decisions

- You CANNOT commit to service outside our standard scheduling windows without approval



Everything else inside your function, you run.



------------------------------



REQUIREMENTS AND TERMS



SETUP YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE

- Reliable computer (not a phone-only setup)

- Stable primary internet, minimum 25 Mbps, plus a BACKUP CONNECTION (second ISP or mobile data)

- BACKUP POWER - UPS or battery, enough to finish a call and hand off cleanly

- Quiet, private workspace - no background noise during customer calls

- Quality noise-cancelling headset



TERMS

- Independent contractor, $5/hour, 40 hours/week

- Paid via Wise, semi-monthly

- Paid 30-day trial, then 30/60/90-day reviews before permanent

- Performance review and raise conversation at 6 months

- We follow the US HOLIDAY CALENDAR, not the PH calendar. Discussed and planned in advance

- BACKGROUND CHECK, NDA, AND CONFIDENTIALITY AGREEMENT REQUIRED. You will hold customer home addresses, entry codes, and lockbox information. This is non-negotiable and we take it seriously

- You may not work for a competing cleaning or home-service company while working with us



------------------------------



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH TAKING



- You are hire #1. The systems you build are the systems this company runs on

- Direct access to the owners - no middle management, no bureaucracy

- Weekends genuinely off, on a US-hours schedule

- Long-term role. We are building a team, and the person who owns admin well is first in line to own operations

- Raise reviewed at 6 months based on the targets above, not on how long you have been here

- We actually want you using AI. Most clients are afraid of it. We are not



------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip these steps are deleted without reading. This is the first test.



1. Start your message with: CLEVER - [your first name]



2. Answer in your own words, briefly:

   - Describe one process you documented yourself and what problem it solved

   - Tell me about a time you were the only admin and something broke. What did you do?

   - What AI tool do you use daily, and what is one specific thing you used it for last week?

   - Do you speak any Spanish? Rate yourself honestly: none / basic / conversational / fluent



3. Attach a 60-90 SECOND VOICE RECORDING introducing yourself in English. Phone work is part of this role



4. Include your OnlineJobs.ph DISC and IQ test results



5. Confirm you can work 9 AM - 5 PM US Eastern time



DO NOT APPLY IF: you are juggling multiple clients and this would be a side gig, you need a daytime PH schedule, you have never worked with a US business, or you have no hands-on AI experience.
