description:
BRAZIISLAND – WEBSITE MANAGER & DIGITAL MARKETING VIRTUAL ASSISTANT



BraziIsland is a Miami-based luxury lifestyle, yacht charter, and VIP concierge company. We are looking for a skilled, reliable, and creative Virtual Assistant to help manage and grow our online presence.



This is not just a basic VA position. We are looking for someone who understands websites, digital marketing, social media, online sales, and how to help a luxury brand grow.



Responsibilities:



• Maintain and regularly update the BraziIsland website

• Add and update yacht charters, exotic cars, villas, jet skis, VIP services, packages, pricing, photos, and descriptions

• Create new website pages and landing pages when needed

• Make sure the website looks professional and works correctly on desktop and mobile

• Help maintain online booking, inquiry, payment, and contact systems

• Assist with Stripe and other website integrations

• Perform basic website troubleshooting and fixes

• Improve website SEO and Google visibility

• Monitor website traffic, leads, and conversions

• Help manage Instagram and other social media platforms

• Create and schedule social media content

• Create basic graphics using Canva or similar software

• Assist with
 and SMS marketing campaigns

• Organize customer leads and help maintain our CRM/database

• Research new digital marketing opportunities

• Help automate repetitive business processes

• Work directly with management on new digital projects and ideas



Ideal Candidate:



• Strong English communication skills

• Experienced with website management

• Knowledge of WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, or similar website platforms

• Comfortable learning and working with AI website-building tools

• Experience with digital marketing and social media

• Basic understanding of SEO

• Experience with Canva or other design software

• Familiar with CRM and lead-management systems

• Comfortable working with Google Workspace

• Detail-oriented and able to work independently

• Fast learner and good problem solver

• Reliable internet connection

• Comfortable working with a fast-moving U.S.-based company



Experience working with luxury brands, yacht companies, travel, hospitality, nightlife, car rentals, concierge companies, or similar businesses is a major plus.



About BraziIsland



Our services include yacht charters, yacht parties, jet ski rentals, exotic car rentals, chauffeur services, private villas, private jet charters, VIP nightlife experiences, bottle service, catering packages, yacht experiences, and luxury concierge services.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term part of the BraziIsland team. As the company grows, there will be opportunities for additional responsibilities and growth.



TO APPLY:



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous website/digital marketing experience

3. Links to websites or projects you have worked on

4. Your experience with social media and digital marketing

5. The website platforms and software you know how to use

6. Your availability and preferred working hours

7. Your expected monthly salary

8. Start your application with the word “ISLAND” so we know you read the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone creative, dependable, ambitious, and ready to help build a major luxury lifestyle brand.

title: Property Management & Guest Relations – Long-Term Position
description:
We’re looking for a friendly, organized, and dependable person to join our property management team for the  long term



We provide short-term and medium-term housing for professionals, primarily renting private rooms. You’ll help with the day-to-day communication and coordination that keeps everything running smoothly.



What You’ll Do



* Respond to prospective and current tenants

* Help screen and set up new tenants

* Coordinate move-ins and answer tenant questions

* Schedule maintenance and follow up on issues

* Keep track of open items and make sure things get done

* Occasionally answer or make phone calls



Most communication is through text and online messaging.



Who We’re Looking For



Experience is not required—we’re happy to train the right person.



What matters most to us is that you’re naturally good with people. We’re looking for someone friendly, easy to talk to, emotionally intelligent, and able to communicate well with different personalities.



If you have good judgment, stay calm when problems come up, enjoy helping people, and feel like you’d do well in hospitality, we’d love to hear from you—even if you’ve never worked in property management before.



We’re hoping to find someone who wants a  stable, long-term position and can grow with us over time.



How to Apply



Please send a short introduction along with a voice recording.



For the recording, don’t just tell us about your work experience—we’d rather hear about you. Tell us a little about yourself, what you enjoy doing, what you do for fun, your interests, etc. Just speak naturally so we can get to know you a little.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Video Editor (Fast Turnaround / Simple Commentary Style)
description:
Job Type: Contract / Freelance (Ongoing)



Rate: $1.50 per video minute (Final length of the video)



Turnaround Time: Strict 12-hour deadline from the time raw footage is provided.



About the Role:

We are looking for a reliable, efficient video editor to handle a new, streamlined video editing tier for our channel. The content is primarily political/news commentary featuring a single speaker talking directly to the camera. We need clean, fast-paced edits delivered quickly.



Requirements & Style:

Simple & Clean: No heavy motion graphics or complex animations required.



Pacing: Tighten up the commentary. Cut out long breaths, pauses, "ums," and dead air to keep the viewer engaged.



B-Roll & Visuals: Insert relevant static elements when mentioned by the host (e.g., screenshots of news articles, social media posts/tweets, maps, or short news clips).



Text On-Screen: Lower thirds for speaker names or occasional text highlights for key emphasis.



Audio: Clean audio, balanced sound levels, and optional subtle background music if needed.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR



We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.

We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.

This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide





Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)




 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases





UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly





Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action





Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof





VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure





Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds





Make the problem feel real and urgent





Show the product clearly and persuasively





Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention





Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok





Communicate benefits quickly and clearly





Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof





Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase





You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands





Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them





Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative





Can create multiple ad variations quickly





Know how to follow references without copying them blindly





Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow





Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused





Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast





Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good





We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation





ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover





Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video





At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use





 you also have experience with:

Meta/Facebook ad creatives





Short-form paid social videos





Long-form VSLs or sales videos





Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing





Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools





Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen





Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts





Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield





Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs





Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references





Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles





Creating variations of winning ads for further testing





Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs





Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios





Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized





Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance





Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations





WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience





Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives





The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue





Clear creative direction and fast feedback





Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time





We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Media Buyer / GoHighLevel Specialist
description:
Job title

Meta Media Buyer + GoHighLevel Specialist — US Home-Services Ads (Remote, Pacific Hours)



Type of work

Full Time · Remote



Salary

$1,500 USD/month to start *(applicants also tell you their own number, so you



can post it as "from $1,500")*



Hours per week

48 — Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM US Pacific



Skills required

 Ads ·
 Advertising · Lead Generation · GoHighLevel · CRM ·



Marketing Automation · Data Analysis · English Writing



THE POST

**Run the Meta ads for a US marketing agency — and own the GoHighLevel build



behind them.**



We are deCRUZ Construction Marketing. We work with remodelers, roofers,



landscapers, ADU and custom-home builders across the United States. We film



their job sites, cut the footage into ads, run the campaigns, and send them



homeowners who want the work done. Our clients judge us on one number: what a



qualified lead costs.



This is two jobs in one, and we want both. You run the ad accounts, and you



build and maintain the CRM that catches every lead they produce.



What you will actually do — the ads

Check every live account every working day. Pause what is over the cost-per-lead threshold, scale what is winning, and write down what you changed and why.

Launch new clients from zero: Business Manager, ad account, pixel and conversion events, payment method, audiences, first campaign.

Build instant forms, including the conditional logic that screens out people outside the client's service area.

Rotate creative before it fatigues — and ask for new creative early enough that the client still has time to film it.

When performance drops, run the recovery sequence: statics from the client's own photos, then a fresh angle, then a new shoot.

Match budget to geography. A small budget covers a city, not a county, and part of the job is telling a client honestly when their target area is too wide for what they are spending.

What you will actually do — the CRM

Own GoHighLevel for every client: pipelines and stages, instant-form field mapping, calendars, and the follow-up automations that get a new lead answered in minutes.

Fix a broken automation the day it breaks, not at the weekly review.

Make sure every lead lands in the CRM within seconds and is visible to the whole team.

What we are looking for

You have run Meta lead-generation campaigns you were personally accountable for — not boosted posts. In your video, tell us the cost per lead you hit, on what budget, for what offer.

You have built in GoHighLevel, or in a CRM close enough that you will pick it up inside a week: pipelines, forms, calendars, automations.

You act early. You would rather kill a creative a day too soon than a week too late.

You can explain a dip to a non-technical contractor without hiding behind jargon.

Clear written English. You will write notes that clients read.

You can work 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Pacific, Monday to Saturday.

How we work — read this before you apply

Full-time, remote. 48 tracked hours a week, Monday to Saturday: 8 hours a day plus a 1-hour unpaid lunch, inside 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Pacific. Those hours are not negotiable.

Time is tracked in Time Doctor for all working hours. Your pay is measured against it. If a day is missed, you can make those hours up on a Sunday and keep the pay — agreed in advance.

Paid monthly on the 5th. Your invoice opens in our dashboard on the 4th.

Every part of the job has a written SOP, and you are trained on each one before you run it alone.

You report to the project manager. Changes to a client's ads come from the project manager, not from the client directly.

30-day trial period at the start.

A bonus structure tied to client results is being finalised and will be added in writing once it is set.

How to apply

Apply here: 



You will need:



The short form on that page.

Your résumé as a PDF.

A short video (2–3 minutes): who you are, and one ad account you ran — the offer, the budget, the cost per lead you reached, and what you changed to get there.

Applications without a video are not reviewed. Do not message us on

title: Social Media Outreach / Talent Coordinator for a Viral Pet Influencer Brand
description:
We're looking for a detail oriented virtual assistant to manage brand outreach for Zaza, widely considered one of the most famous dogs on the planet, with over forty seven million Instagram views in the last one hundred eighty days and fifty nine million
 views in the last twenty eight days, both fully organic. We want to go after everything: airlines, hotels, travel itineraries, and major brand deals, since Zaza is a genuine global phenomenon with fans across the US, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. You'll research pet, travel, airline, hospitality, and lifestyle companies that would be a good fit for a sponsorship or partnership, find the direct
 of the actual marketing or partnerships contact rather than a generic form, and send personalized outreach based on a template we'll give you. You'll track every
 sent and every reply in a shared spreadsheet, and you'll be comfortable following up multiple times, politely but persistently, until you get a real answer rather than letting a brand go quiet after one
.



Requirements: excellent written English, some past experience with social media outreach, influencer marketing, or sales style
ing, comfortable using Gmail and spreadsheets, reliable internet, your own phone number for verification, and a genuinely persistent, thick skinned personality who won't give up after one no-reply.



Hours and pay: part time to start, roughly thirty hours a week, with pay based on experience.



How to apply: send a video of yourself, no more than sixty seconds, directly to WhatsApp at plus
, explaining one specific brand you'd pitch Zaza to and why, and what the subject line of that
 would be. Generic applications and copy paste messages will be ignored immediately. Only serious candidates who follow these exact instructions will be considered.

, no linkedin, no DMs

You cant do 7am to 4pm Philippine time Mon to Fri

150 dials a day sounds like a lot

No backup internet or no backup power

You wont record a video

You want a locked in long term job straight away. This starts as a trial



Put KOOKABURRA as the first word in your subject line. If its not there I dont read it.



What the job is



You ring Australian air conditioning and refrigeration businesses. Small operators, one to five vans. Blokes who pick up the phone standing on a roof with a drill going.



You dont sell anything. You get them to agree to 20 minutes with our sales guy and you book it in his calendar before you hang up. Thats it.



Script is already written and its already closed us clients. Your job is to run it 150 times a day and not get rattled.



Some of them will be rude. A lot will hang up on you. One or two a week will tell you where to go. If that bothers you dont apply.



The trial. Read this bit twice



This starts as a 4 week paid trial. Not unpaid, not half pay while you learn. Full money from day one.



How it works:



4 weeks full time, paid weekly, full $225

You need 8 real meetings in those 4 weeks. Thats 2 a week

A meeting only counts once our sales guy says it was a real aircon or refrigeration business, the actual owner, and a proper conversation. Book junk to hit your numbers and we'll pick it up in the first week

We sit down at the end of week 4 and go through it. You'll know how youre tracking from week 2 because I'll tell you. No ghosting

Hit the 8 and you go onto an ongoing contract. Written, covering your pay, your hours and your notice

Miss it badly and we shake hands. You keep every dollar you earned



Either way you get paid the full 4 weeks. Im not after free calling off anyone.



Pay



USD $225 a week to start. Paid weekly, on time, you wont have to chase me for it.



Your base is your base. I dont claw it back if you have a slow week, and I dont gate it behind a quota. Same money good week or bad.



Once youre through the trial and actually converting, commissions come in on top. I dont pay commission to someone still finding their feet, so dont ask about it in week one. Prove you can book real meetings that turn into clients and youll get paid for it properly.



Freelance contractor, not employment.



Hours



Every other cold calling job on here is US hours so you work nights. This ones Australian hours. 7am to 4pm your time. Youre finished before dinner.



Australia goes to daylight saving on 4 Oct and your start moves to 6am. Work out now if thats alright with you.



After the trial



Month 2 is 12 meetings. Month 3 is 16. After that 20 to 22, which is about one a day.



Thats also when commission kicks in. Book meetings that turn into paying clients and you get paid on top of your base. The better you get the more you earn, and theres no cap on it.



Beat the ladder early and I move you up early. Were growing and Id rather grow whoevers already here than start again with someone new.



Who Im after



Someone whos cold called trades. Roofing, solar, HVAC, plumbing, pest control, construction, landscaping. US, UK or Aussie market.



Someone an Australian tradie can understand straight away on a phone line. Not on a video call with a decent mic. On the phone, first go, no second chance.



Someone whos been sworn at and just rang the next number.



2 years minimum on outbound phones. Quiet room. No noise, no family in the background, no roosters.



And you stick to the rules. Australia has laws about when we can call and what we have to say. I'll train you on them. You follow them every single call or youre finished that day.



Who we are



Forge HQ Pty Ltd. Australian company. We get customers for 
 and refrigeration businesses through
 and Instagram ads. Small team, we move quick, no politics, everyone gets paid on time.



How to apply



Im busy so keep it short. Dot points only. Anything long winded I wont read.



KOOKABURRA as the first word in your subject line

Your Loom link

Last industry you cold called, and the objection you got the most. Give it to me word for word and what you said back

Your average dials a day and meetings a week



Thats it. Four lines. Dont send me a cover letter.



The Loom. 2 minutes max



Part 1. Read the script below out loud like its a real call. Dont read it flat, sell it.



Read this out loud like youre on a real call to a tradesman in Australia. Youre not being judged on your accent. Youre being judged on whether an Aussie tradie would understand you straight away and keep listening. Pause where it says PAUSE. Count three seconds. Dont fill the silence.



1



"Hey, how are you going. It's [YOUR NAME] calling from Forge. Are you busy on the tools at the moment, or have you got a spare 30 seconds?"



"Quick heads up, this is a cold call. It's a well researched one and I won't waste your time. You can tell me to get lost, or you can give me 30 seconds to tell you why I called."



2



"I just wanted to give you a quick call and see if you could take on three to five more of the right jobs coming in every week."



3



"When you're flat out, the phone rings and you're knee deep in a job, what normally happens to that call?"



PAUSE



"And when you do call them back, how often has the job already gone to someone else?"



PAUSE



"Across a busy week, how many do you think actually slip through before you get back to them? A few as in two or three, or closer to ten?"



PAUSE



"Okay, so three thousand dollars each. What's that, roughly six thousand a week? Twenty five a month?"



PAUSE



"Is this something you're actually doing anything about at the moment?"



4



"Perfect. I'll lock that in and send it through now."



"I've just sent that through. Can you quickly check your
 for me? Sometimes these things land in spam."



"Great. Just hit accept on that so it's locked into both our calendars."



"And mate, just so neither of us wastes our time, I'm pretty stacked with calls around then. Outside of the zombie apocalypse, is there any reason you wouldn't be able to make Tuesday at 2pm?"



Part 2. No script, nothing prepared. Tell me about the last time someone swore at you or hung up on you. What did you say next and what happened.



Closing this in 48 hours or when Ive got enough good ones. If this is you, apply today. If youre still thinking about it, its not you.

title: Video editor
description:
Video Editor (Full Time, Long Term) - UK Video Production Company



Salary: $700 USD per month

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm UK time. You manage your own breaks inside that window

Type: Full time, exclusive



About us



1Word Productions is a video production and content agency based in Manchester, UK. We produce short form social content, brand films and podcast content for clients across aesthetics, recruitment, sport and professional services. Past work includes PUMA, Sky and UFC.







We are looking for one editor to join the team long term and become the person we trust with our client edits.



Your working hours in Philippine time



We work to UK time, and the UK clocks change twice a year. Your hours in Philippine time will shift by one hour when that happens. Here is exactly what that looks like:



 UK time Philippine time

UK summer (late March to late October) 8am to 4pm 3pm to 11pm

UK winter (late October to late March) 8am to 4pm 4pm to 12am



That is the only change. Same days, same length of shift, just a one hour move twice a year. This is an afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift. Please make sure you are happy with both sets of hours before applying.



What you'll be doing



Editing short form vertical content for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

Cutting longer form pieces including brand films, podcasts and case study videos

Working from written editing briefs supplied by our team

Subtitles, captions, basic motion graphics, colour and audio clean up

Delivering to deadline and to the brief, with revisions handled quickly and without fuss



Sending a short daily progress report at the start and at the end of every shift. This is mandatory and covers what you finished, what you're mid way through, and anything blocking you



Requirements



Adobe Premiere Pro as your main editing software. This is not negotiable. We work in Premiere and you need to be fast and confident in it.

Applicants must have there own adobe subscription. 



Able to work 8am to 4pm UK time, five days a week, every week, across both the summer and winter schedules above



No other clients or freelance work while you are with us. This is a full time role, not a side project



Strong written English. You need to read an editing brief and understand exactly what is being asked

Willing to ask questions. If something in a brief is unclear, we want you to flag it before you start, not deliver something that misses the mark



Reliable internet and a computer that can handle 4K footage in Premiere without grinding to a halt

Comfortable with cloud file transfer (
, Google Drive, Dropbox)



Nice to have:



After Effects for titles and simple motion graphics

Photoshop for thumbnails

Experience editing for paid social ads

An eye for pacing, music choice and hook structure in short form



What we offer



Steady full time work with one company rather than chasing clients

Clear briefs and a team that gives proper feedback

Long term position with room to grow as we take on more retainers

Paid on time, every month via wise payments.



How to apply:



Send the following:



Your top 5 best edits. Send 5 edits as direct video links (Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube unlisted or Vimeo). Do not send a link to a portfolio website. Any application with either will be disqualified.Long form or short form both accepted



A short note telling us which of those edits you are most proud of and why.



Start the first line of your application with the word PREMIERE so we know you read this properly



PLEASE NOTE THERE WILL BE A TRIAL EDIT DURING THE HIRING PROCESS.

title: Virtual Assistant - Residential Real Estate
Growth Marketing Manager
description:
Job Overview:



FenceUSA is a family-owned, but high-growth,  fence and deck installation company operating across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Deleware. Our mission is clear: we are scaling to become the largest and most dominant fence and deck installation company in the Northeast. We are an unapologetically sales and marketing-first organization. Right now, our growth engine is already running hot:

* We spend heavily on Meta Ads and Google Ads.

* We leverage GoHighLevel (GHL) to immediately capture, track, nurture, and route those leads into booked consultations for our outside sales reps, who close the deals on-site.



Now, we need a true Growth Marketing Manager to work directly with the business owner, Nick Amechi, to take this entire machine to the next level. If you have studied Alex Hormozi ($100M Offers, $100M Leads), know how to edit direct-response video creative, and can build/optimize conversion funnels that drive real pipeline revenue, this is your arena.







What You’ll Be Doing:

* **Lead Nurture & Pipeline Velocity:** Build, tweak, and manage GoHighLevel workflows, automated SMS/email sequences, and AI booking agents to turn cold calculator leads into confirmed outside sales appointments.

* **Direct-Response Video Editing:** Cut and produce high-retention video creatives (CapCut, Premiere Pro, etc.) using raw customer testimonials, talking heads, job-site before/afters, and Hormozi-style hooks and captions for Meta Ads.

* **Paid Ads Management & Optimization:** Collaborate directly on managing and scaling high-budget Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns targeting homeowners across our service areas.

* **Tracking & Data Integrity:** Monitor GHL dashboards, ad metrics, booking rates, and show-up rates to identify bottlenecks in the pipeline and fix them immediately.







Who You Are:



***A True Hormozi Disciple:** You understand $100 Million Offers, $100 Million Leads, and $100 Million Money Models.

***GHL Power User:** You can navigate GoHighLevel—custom fields, webhooks, trigger links, landing page builders, workflows, and pipeline automations.

***Sharp Direct-Response Editor:** You understand the critical first 3 seconds of an ad. You know how to edit for retention, pacing, and action.

***Hands-On Operator:** You thrive working side-by-side with an active, fast-moving owner. You don’t need your hand held; you execute, test, report results, and iterate quickly.

***Exceptional English:** Seamless written and spoken communication skills.







Why Join FenceUSA?



* **Work Directly With the Owner:** No bureaucracy or layers of middle management. You’ll be partnering directly with an owner who lives and breathes marketing and growth.

* **Massive Growth Opportunity:** We are expanding rapidly. We reward speed, high performance, and real results with long-term stability and compensation growth.

* **High-Standard Culture:** We don’t settle for average. If you love winning, fast execution, and being part of a team determined to lead the entire region, you will thrive here.







Why Work With Us?



***Stable Full-Time Hours:* Guaranteed 40 hours per week during fixed US Eastern business hours.

***Long-Term Role:*** A stable position with room to grow alongside a fast-moving US team.







Hours & Compensation

***8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST), Monday through Friday. Full time.

***40 hours per week.

***$7 - $15 per hour (depending on experience)

To be considered, your application must include:



* A Google Drive video link (2 minutes max) introducing yourself, outlining why you would be a great fit for this role and what you can bring to the table.



Applications without a voice or video recording will not be reviewed.

title: UGC & VSL Video Editor with Strong AI Video Skills
description:
You started as a video editor. You know Premiere, CapCut, or DaVinci inside out, and you've cut plenty of ads. Then AI video tools arrived, and instead of ignoring them you made them part of how you work. That combination is exactly what we need.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the health supplement niche. Paid social is one of our main growth channels, so for us video creative is one of the biggest drivers of the business, not just "content". We're hiring a full-time (40 hours per week) AI video maker and editor to produce high-performing ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



THE EDITING SIDE

You'll take scripts, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, and turn them into polished ads ready for testing:

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos that grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits showing the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits built from reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos structured around education and direct response

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



THE AI SIDE

When there's no footage to work with, you generate it yourself:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools. Occasional use doesn't count, and neither does just experimenting.



WE'D ALSO LIKE TO SEE

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives in your portfolio

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Strong captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

- As a bonus, previous work in the health supplement niche



HOW WE JUDGE AN EDIT

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action. We are not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We want someone fluent in direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative. Every ad should:

- Stop people in the first 1 to 3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



Creative that sells doesn't mean ugly or low quality. It means every editing choice supports the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



YOU'RE THE RIGHT PERSON IF YOU

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



TO APPLY, PLEASE FILL IN THIS GOOGLE FORM:

title: Building an Empire using a Laptop | Personal Assistant & Outreach Specialist Needed
description:
Hey! I’m a 25-year-old solo entrepreneur building a massive affiliate network of sellers, buyers, and partners across the world using my laptop. It’s called Wiredspace.

------------------

HOW THE BUSINESS WORKS

Our job is to match Sellers with Buyers through the internet.

------------------

We secure sellers by reaching out to them and offering them buyers in exchange for a commission—this is like an affiliate program. Then we target ideal buyers and recommend them to the Sellers (via
, website contact forms, WhatsApp, etc.).



We can recommend the Seller directly to the Buyer:

Sellers < - Wiredspace - > Buyers



Or indirectly—through a “Partner”:

Sellers < - Wiredspace - > Partners - > Buyers



A partner is someone who already has access to Buyers, refers those Buyers to the Seller, and earns a commission on referrals. This is like an affiliate partner.

------------------

WHAT WE MATCH:

We deal with everything. From high-ticket assets like luxury real estate, yachts, and private jets, to marketing agencies, video production, freelance/home services, courses, paintings, and general goods. We can basically sell anything, anywhere, to anyone.

------------------

DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES

#1 Send messages all day to Buyers, Sellers, and Partners, 

and maintain ongoing communication (via Gmail, website contact forms, WhatsApp, etc.). Sending messages all day is KEY and the thing I need help with the most.



#2 Be my personal assistant, and execute daily relevant tasks such as:

Writing messages

Searching for Buyers, Sellers, and Partners

Setting appointments

Helping me organize everything (Google Sheets, to-dos, calendar)

And help me build matches

------------------

I will give clear, simple, and doable instructions and guide you through everything.



I can provide the copy, targets, and everything so that you focus strictly on sending messages—but I prefer someone who wants to learn the process of creating a match between a Buyer and a Seller / Partner from start to finish, so that you can create matches independently and understand the process.

------------------

WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR (SKILLS & ATTITUDE)

MAIN SKILL: Ability to consistently send 100+ messages/emails daily and follow up. If you can send more, please tell me your maximum number. (Important. the more, the merrier)



TECH LITERACY: 

Comfortable using Gmail, WhatsApp, Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Calendar), and basic AI tools to write messages/search.



MINDSET: Ambitious, open-minded, highly organized, and curious to experiment.



WORK DETAILS & COMPENSATION

PAY: $5 / hour

HOURS: 4 hours per day (20 hours per week, for now)

TRIAL PERIOD: 1-week trial (5 days)



COMMISSION UPSIDE: 

In addition to your base pay, you will receive performance commissions on sales we close. Because of the vast range of products we handle, your commissions could range from $50 if we sell a basic website to $1,000 if we sell a house together. Anything is possible, and our success is completely up to us.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY!)

To show that you read this post and can follow simple instructions, answer these in your response:

1. Set your application subject line to: Wiredspace Laptop Assistant: [Your Name]

2. Briefly tell me about your experience with sending messages, outreach, or admin tasks.

3. Name any tools (like ChatGPT, Google Sheets) you use to speed up your work.

4. Confirm that you can do a 1-day trial.



Thanks!

Simon

title: Advanced Excel, Event Budgeting and Proposal Support
description:
Virtual Assistant – Advanced Excel, Event Budgeting & Proposal Support

About the Position

Corporate Dimensions, LTD. (CDL) is a U.S. based meetings, events, tradeshow, and production agency. We are seeking a highly organized and detail oriented Virtual Assistant with advanced Excel skills to support our team with event budgets, vendor proposals, food and beverage menus, and client-ready documents.

This is not a basic data-entry position. The ideal candidate must be comfortable working with detailed pricing, performing complex calculations, reviewing proposals carefully, and presenting information accurately in established CDL templates.

Experience in the hospitality, meetings, events, travel, hotel, or production industries is strongly preferred.

Primary Responsibilities

Event Budgeting and Excel

• Review hotel, venue, audio visual, production, entertainment, décor, branding, transportation, and other event-related proposals.

• Extract all pricing, fees, terms, and financial details from proposals, contracts, menus, and vendor documents.

• Enter pricing into CDL’s existing Excel budget template using the correct categories and formatting.

• Build and verify formulas for quantities, unit costs, number of event days, attendance, service charges, taxes, VAT, commissions, and totals.

• Work with pricing in both U.S. dollars and international currencies, including euros, British pounds, Swedish kronor, and other currencies.

• Convert international pricing into U.S. dollars using the exchange rate provided or a current, properly documented exchange rate.

• Clearly record the currency exchange rate and date used for each conversion.

• Correctly calculate VAT, sales tax, service charges, administrative fees, gratuities, and other applicable charges.

• Understand when fees or taxes are compounded and calculate them in the correct order.

• Compare vendor proposals and prepare clear cost comparisons.

• Identify missing pricing, calculation discrepancies, unclear charges, and potential errors before information is shared with our clients.

• Maintain consistent formatting, formulas, and naming conventions throughout each budget.

• Update budgets as revised proposals and attendance numbers are received.

Menu Formatting and Client Documents

• Review hotel and venue food and beverage menus.

• Transfer menu selections and pricing into CDL’s Microsoft Word menu template.

• Follow CDL’s preferred layout, fonts, headings, spacing, colors, and formatting.

• Organize menus by event date, function, meal period, or reception.

• Include relevant pricing, service charges, taxes, dietary notes, minimums, and other important details.

• Correct spelling, capitalization, punctuation, and formatting inconsistencies.

• Create polished, professional, client-ready documents that require minimal revision.

• Convert final documents to PDF when requested.

Vendor Research and Sourcing

• Research qualified event vendors in cities throughout the United States and internationally.

• Source vendors for services such as audio visual, production, entertainment, décor, photography, transportation, team-building activities, event rentals, printing, fabrication, and branded experiences.

• Gather company information, capabilities, pricing, availability, reviews, and contact details.

• Prepare organized vendor comparison summaries in Excel or Word.

• Draft clear and professional requests for proposals or pricing.

• Track outreach, responses, follow-up dates, and outstanding information.

• Follow up professionally with vendors when directed.

Required Skills

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

• Strong command of formulas, including calculations using percentages, multiple fees, taxes, VAT, markups, and currency conversions.

• Ability to work confidently with formulas such as SUM, SUMIF/SUMIFS, IF, IFERROR, XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, ROUND, and other relevant functions.

• Experience creating and maintaining organized workbooks with multiple worksheets.

• Ability to audit formulas and identify calculation errors.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including templates, styles, tables, headers, footers, page breaks, and document formatting.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong online research and vendor-sourcing skills.

• Ability to interpret detailed proposals, menus, contracts, and pricing documents.

• Ability to follow established templates and instructions precisely.

• Strong organizational, file-management, and time-management skills.

• Reliable internet connection and dependable computer.

• Ability to handle confidential company, client, and financial information.

Preferred Experience

• Previous experience supporting an event management, hospitality, travel, hotel, production, or destination management company.

• Experience building or updating event budgets.

• Familiarity with hotel food and beverage pricing, service charges, gratuities, administrative fees, and taxes.

• Experience working with international pricing, VAT, and foreign currency conversions.

• Experience comparing vendor proposals and preparing client-facing documents.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Outlook, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat, and cloud-based file-sharing systems.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

• Produce accurate budgets with dependable formulas.

• Carefully review all source documents instead of simply copying numbers.

• Recognize missing information and ask thoughtful questions.

• Catch inconsistencies before documents reach the client.

• Follow CDL templates and formatting standards consistently.

• Meet deadlines and communicate early if clarification is needed.

• Keep files, versions, calculations, and supporting documents well organized.

• Take ownership of assignments from initial review through final quality control.

Work Schedule

This is a remote position. Candidates must be available for regular communication and should be able to provide some working-hour overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone. Please include your normal working hours and availability in your application.

Skills Assessment

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid skills assessment. The assessment may include:

• Reviewing a sample venue or hotel proposal.

• Entering pricing into an Excel budget template.

• Calculating service charges, taxes, VAT, and currency conversions.

• Checking formulas and identifying pricing discrepancies.

• Formatting a sample food and beverage menu in Microsoft Word.

• Researching and comparing several event vendors.

Accuracy, judgment, organization, formatting, and attention to detail will all be evaluated.

How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience.

2. Your level of proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.

3. Details about any experience with event budgets, hotel proposals, food and beverage menus, VAT, taxes, or international currencies.

4. Your normal working hours and availability for U.S. Eastern Time overlap.

5. Your desired hourly rate or monthly salary.

6. The words “CDL Budget Specialist” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete job description.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, highly accurate, proactive, and interested in building a long-term working relationship with our team.

• Analysing performance and identifying patterns across topics, hooks, formats, and platforms

• Turning performance insights into concrete changes to future content

• Coordinating with copywriting, design, animation, video, and R&D

• Reviewing content before publication and maintaining quality standards

• Identifying opportunities to improve reach, engagement, audience growth, and content distribution

• Improving the systems and processes behind our social media operation

• You will operate independently and be expected to improve the function, not just execute within it.



Strategic Impact

1) Content Performance

We produce a high volume of educational content.



We need someone constantly asking:

• Which topics are outperforming?

• Which hooks consistently work?

• Which formats are losing attention?

• What makes people save, share, comment, or follow?

• Which ideas perform differently across platforms?

• Which posts deserve to become videos, newsletters, or follow-up content?

• What should we stop doing?



The goal is to create a structured feedback loop between:



What we publish → what performs → what we create next



Performance analysis should influence the content pipeline, rather than exist as a report that nobody acts on.



2) Social Strategy

Different platforms reward different behaviours.



You will help determine:

• What we should publish

• Where we should publish it

• How content should change between platforms

• Which formats deserve more investment

• How frequently we should publish

• How existing content can be repurposed intelligently

• Where new opportunities are emerging



You should be able to move beyond:



“This post performed well.”



And instead explain:



“This topic, hook, and format consistently performs with this audience, so we should test these three variations next.”



3) Content Operations

A single social post can move through several stages:



Research → Copy → Design/Animation → Review → Publishing → Performance Analysis



You will help make that process run smoothly.



This includes:

• Maintaining visibility over upcoming content

• Making sure posts are ready before publishing deadlines

• Coordinating dependencies between people and deliverables

• Flagging bottlenecks early

• Improving briefing and handoff processes

• Ensuring the right content is being prioritised

• Maintaining publishing consistency without sacrificing quality



The goal is less friction, fewer last-minute problems, and better output.



4) Platform Growth

You will take ownership of improving our presence across platforms such as:

• LinkedIn

• X

• Instagram

• TikTok

• YouTube / YouTube Shorts



That does not mean blindly optimising for follower count.



We care about building the right audience and creating content people genuinely find useful.



You should understand how platform mechanics, audience behaviour, content format, and creative decisions affect distribution.



5) Content Quality

Growth cannot come at the expense of the brand.



Our content needs to remain:

• Educational

• Accurate

• Clear

• Visually strong

• Useful to the audience

• Consistent with our positioning



You will be expected to develop strong judgement around what is ready to publish and what still needs work.



That may mean reviewing:

• Hooks

• Captions

• Carousels

• Infographics

• Short-form video concepts

• Thumbnails

• Platform-specific variations



You do not need to personally create every asset.



But you need to know what good looks like.



What You’ll Do

1) Social Strategy & Planning

• Own and maintain the social content calendar

• Translate broader company priorities into social plans

• Recommend content themes, formats, and platform strategies

• Identify opportunities to repurpose successful content

• Develop platform-specific approaches rather than simply reposting identical content everywhere

• Help prioritise which ideas enter production



2) Performance Analysis

• Monitor performance across platforms

• Analyse hooks, topics, formats, creatives, and captions

• Identify recurring patterns rather than reacting to individual viral posts

• Compare performance against historical benchmarks

• Track competitor and niche activity

• Produce clear recommendations from the data

• Turn insights into experiments for future content



3) Content & Publishing Operations

• Coordinate the social publishing pipeline

• Make sure content moves through production on time

• Schedule and publish content where appropriate

• Maintain quality control before posts go live

• Flag missing assets, blockers, or delays early

• Keep calendars, statuses, and documentation accurate



4) Collaboration

You will work closely with:

• Copywriters

• Designers and illustrators

• Animators

• Video creators

• Founders



You should be able to give clear feedback such as:



“The topic is strong, but the opening frame is too abstract.”



rather than:



“Can we make this more engaging?”



We value feedback that helps people make better decisions.



5) Experimentation & Growth

Examples of initiatives we value:

• Testing different hook structures

• Comparing short vs longer captions

• Testing carousel structures

• Testing video opening sequences

• Identifying recurring high-performing topic categories

• Developing systems for repurposing successful content

• Improving publishing cadence

• Finding ways to extend the lifespan of high-performing posts

• Testing new platforms or formats

• Using AI to accelerate ideation, analysis, repurposing, and social operations



We want structured experimentation, not random changes based on intuition.



What Success Looks Like

In the first 30–90 days

You:

• Understand our audience, content, platforms, and existing workflow

• Take ownership of the social calendar and publishing operation

• Establish clear visibility over social performance

• Identify the strongest and weakest parts of our current strategy

• Recommend several concrete improvements

• Begin running structured content experiments

• Reduce the amount of day-to-day oversight needed from founders



By 6–12 months

• Performance insights consistently influence content decisions

• Social planning is proactive rather than reactive

• Publishing operations run reliably without constant oversight

• Successful content patterns are documented and reused

• Platform strategies are clearer and more differentiated

• Content experiments run continuously

• Social audience and distribution continue growing

• The social function operates with greater structure and independence



You’ll Thrive Here If You…

• Think in patterns, not isolated posts

• Are both creative and analytical

• Constantly ask why something performed

• Have strong taste and content judgement

• Understand that good social strategy starts with good content

• Enjoy testing hypotheses

• Can turn analytics into clear decisions

• Are highly organised

• Can manage multiple content streams simultaneously

• Communicate clearly in writing

• Raise issues early rather than waiting for someone to notice

• Are comfortable challenging assumptions using evidence

• Prefer improving the system rather than simply completing tasks

• Can operate independently without needing constant direction



Requirements

• Strong English, native or near-native fluency

• 5+ years of experience in social media, content marketing, digital media, audience development, or similar

• Demonstrated experience owning social media strategy

• Strong understanding of social content and platform dynamics

• Strong analytical ability

• Experience using performance data to influence content decisions

• Excellent organisational and project-management skills

• Strong written communication

• Experience collaborating with creative teams

• Comfortable working remotely with async collaboration

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of outcomes



Bonus

• Experience managing large social accounts

• Experience with educational, technology, media, or creator businesses

• Experience growing LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube audiences

• Experience with short-form video

• Experience managing or mentoring junior social team members

• Experience working with designers, animators, and copywriters

• Experience with paid or sponsored content and brand partnerships

• Experience developing social reporting systems

• Strong AI fluency and experience integrating AI into content workflows



How We Work

We are remote-first and async-friendly.



We operate in 2-week sprints, with clear priorities and defined deliverables for each cycle.



Work is planned, visible, and tracked; not managed through DMs.



Tools we use

• Jira for sprint planning, tickets, and task tracking

• Confluence for documentation, standards, and knowledge sharing

• Google Docs for drafting, outlining, and collaborative editing

• Slack for day-to-day communication and quick alignment



You’ll collaborate closely with founders and the wider content team, but you’re expected to drive your area forward independently.



We value:

• Clear tickets and documented decisions

• Strong first drafts

• Raising issues early rather than working in silence

• Improving processes when you see friction

• Thoughtful experimentation

• Clear reasoning behind decisions

• We protect deep work, avoid unnecessary meetings, and prefer written clarity over verbal ambiguity.



Culture matters to us.



We invest in occasional virtual team bonding sessions and informal catch-ups because we believe strong working relationships improve output quality and trust.



This is a structured environment; but one where initiative and ownership are expected, not micromanaged.



Compensation



This role is budgeted at market rates for the Philippines.



To keep things efficient, please include in your application your expected annual PHP salary/rate.



Hiring Process

We aim to keep the process rigorous but efficient:



1. Application review + portfolio/work samples



2. Short interview: focused on content judgement, strategy, analytical thinking, and ownership rather than generic Q&A



3. Paid social strategy exercise: using realistic content and performance data to simulate how we would work together



4. Final conversation + offer



How to Apply



Please send:

1. Your resume / CV

2. Links to social accounts or brands you have managed

3. 2–3 examples of content or campaigns you personally influenced

4. A short response (max 400 words):

Tell us about a social account, content strategy, or content system you materially improved. Please explain:

    a. What was happening before?

    b. What did the data tell you?

    c. What did you change?

    d. Why did you make that change?

    e. What improved as a result?



Where possible, include specific numbers or evidence rather than only describing the work.

title: Video Editor for Meta Ads
description:
We're looking for a video editor to create and edit short-form videos for Meta Ads. The work includes editing raw footage, adding captions, refining pacing, and preparing final ad-ready videos. You should be comfortable working with existing content and improving it for ad performance. This is a part-time at least 20-30 hours per week (will likely convert to full-time if you execute well), ongoing role for someone who can deliver polished, engaging videos consistently.



Our app is an ad-free animated streaming app for kids ages 2–12. We're hiring a full-time video editor to cut short-form ads for Meta and TikTok.



You'll work from existing assets — animated show clips, app screen recordings, and UGC from parent creators — and turn them into ad-ready videos. A typical week is 15–25 deliverables, mostly hook and format variations on concepts that are already testing well. If you execute well, we have the capacity to massively scale volume & work with you full-time.



This is performance editing, not brand film. You'll see the metrics on everything you cut, and the job is to make the first two seconds work. We need 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5 versions of most creatives, with burned-in captions.



Requirements: 2+ years editing direct-response social ads with results you can point to, fluency in Premiere or CapCut plus basic After Effects, 24-hour turnaround on revisions, and 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern time.



Because we make children's content, all music and SFX must be licensed or royalty-free, and no third-party characters or IP can appear in anything you cut.



Start with one test edit. If it goes well, we move to an ongoing contract.

**Payment:** Biweekly via Wise

**Position:** Long-Term Remote Position

**Start Date:** Immediately



## About the Position



HSA is hiring a creative and dependable **Media Graphic Designer** for a long-term position creating social media graphics, marketing content, short-form videos, and Reels.



We have established branding standards and templates. You must be able to follow these guidelines accurately while still creating fresh, professional, eye-catching content that appeals to consumers.



This position requires more than basic Canva skills. You must understand **professional graphic design, branding, color theory, typography, composition, consumer-focused design, video editing, and AI-assisted creative tools.**



## Required Software & Skills



You **must have working knowledge and experience with:**



* **Adobe Photoshop**

* **Adobe Illustrator**

* **CapCut**

* **AI design and content-creation tools**

* Graphic design and image editing

* Video editing

* Reels and short-form video creation

* Social media content creation

* Branding and brand consistency

* Color theory and color combinations

* Typography and visual hierarchy

* Layout and composition

* Product-focused marketing graphics

* Following established branding templates precisely



You should understand how to use AI tools to improve productivity and assist with creative workflows while still being able to recognize and correct inaccurate or poor-quality AI-generated content.



## Responsibilities



You will create and edit:



* Social media graphics

* Product advertisements

* Promotional graphics

* Reels and short-form videos

* Product videos

* Video clips with transitions, text, music, and effects

* Branded marketing materials

* Content adapted for different social media platforms



You will be expected to work from existing HSA branding templates and maintain the correct **logos, fonts, colors, layouts, proportions, and overall brand identity**.



Attention to detail is extremely important.



## Hours & Growth



This position starts with a training period:



**First 4 weeks:** Up to 20 hours per week

**After approximately 60 days:** Up to 30 hours per week

**After approximately 90 days:** Up to 40 hours per week



Hours may increase sooner if training is completed early and you demonstrate the required skill level, reliability, productivity, and ability to follow our branding standards.



This is intended to be a **long-term position**, not a temporary freelance project.



## Compensation



Starting pay is **$3.00 USD per hour**.



Payments are made **biweekly through Wise**.



All working hours must be documented through the company's approved **time-proof/time-tracking system**.



## Additional Requirements



You must:

* Use required time-tracking software

* Have reliable internet access

* Communicate consistently

* Follow written and visual instructions carefully

* Meet deadlines

* Accept feedback and make revisions

* Maintain confidentiality

* Be interested in a long-term position



## How to Apply

1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience.

2. **Your graphic design portfolio.**

3. **Examples of social media graphics you personally created.**

9. Your experience following established brand guidelines and templates.

10. Your current weekly availability.

11. Confirmation that you are comfortable starting at **$3.00 USD per hour for up to 20 hours per week during training**.

12. Confirmation that you can receive **biweekly payments through Wise**.



**Please do not apply without sending examples of your work or a portfolio.**



To show that you read the complete job posting, include the words **“BRAND TEMPLATE”** in your application.



We are looking for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, dependable, comfortable with modern AI-assisted design workflows, and interested in growing into a **full-time, long-term role with HSA**.

Schedule: 20–40 hours per week

Payment: Biweekly via Wise

Position: Long-Term Remote Position

Start Date: Immediately



About the Position



HSA is looking for a highly skilled E-Commerce Product Photo & Graphic Designer to join our team long-term.



This position focuses on transforming product photos, vector artwork, and digital product files into professional, realistic, eye-catching e-commerce images and lifestyle scenes.



You will create product imagery for platforms including:



* Etsy

* Amazon

* TikTok

* Temu

* Shopify

* Social media and digital advertising



This is not an entry-level graphic design position. You must have strong photo-editing and compositing skills and understand how to create realistic product imagery designed to attract online shoppers while accurately representing the actual product.



What You Will Do



Your primary responsibility will be creating and editing e-commerce product images.



Projects may include:



* Converting basic product photos into professional lifestyle images

* Placing products realistically into indoor and outdoor environments

* Converting vector artwork into realistic product lifestyle images

* Creating realistic product mockups from Adobe Illustrator/vector files

* Removing and replacing backgrounds

* Correcting lighting, shadows, perspective, and reflections

* Cleaning and enhancing product photography

* Creating close-up and alternate-angle product images

* Creating marketplace-ready product images

* Using AI tools to create and enhance realistic lifestyle environments

* Combining traditional Photoshop editing with AI-generated elements

* Creating product comparison and feature graphics

* Creating branded e-commerce infographics

* Resizing and adapting images for different marketplaces

* Maintaining accurate product proportions, colors, artwork, text, and design details

* Following established branding templates precisely



A major part of this position is understanding how to use AI as a professional design tool without allowing AI to incorrectly alter the actual product being advertised.



Required Design Skills



You must be highly skilled in:



* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Illustrator

* AI image-generation and photo-editing tools

* Advanced photo manipulation

* Photo compositing

* Background replacement

* Object masking and selection

* Vector graphics

* Smart Objects

* Layers and layer masks

* Perspective and distortion

* Lighting and realistic shadows

* Color correction

* Product retouching

* Image cleanup

* Resolution and image quality

* Realistic product placement

* Scaling and proportion

* Typography

* Color theory

* Branding and brand consistency

* E-commerce product presentation



Video editing experience is a plus, particularly experience creating product videos, Reels, and short-form social media content.



AI Experience



You must be comfortable working with modern AI image-generation and photo-editing tools.



We are specifically looking for designers who understand how to combine AI tools with professional graphic-design software.



AI should enhance your workflow, not replace your graphic-design skills.



You must be able to recognize common AI errors and manually correct them using Photoshop or Illustrator.



E-Commerce Experience



Previous experience creating product images for Etsy, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Temu, Shopify, or similar e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.



You should understand that e-commerce product imagery must be both visually attractive and accurate to the actual product being sold.



You must be able to follow detailed instructions and preserve important product characteristics when creating lifestyle images.



Hours & Training



This position begins with a training period so you can learn our products, branding standards, image requirements, and workflow.



* First 4 weeks: Up to 20 hours per week

* After approximately 60 days: Up to 30 hours per week

* After approximately 90 days: Up to 40 hours per week

* Hours may increase sooner if training is completed early and your skill level and performance meet our requirements



After 90 days salary review 



This is intended to become a full-time, long-term position for the right person.



Compensation



Starting pay is $3.00 USD per hour.



Payment is made biweekly through Wise.



All working hours must be documented using the company's approved time-proof/time-tracking system.



Additional Requirements



The selected candidate must:



* Sign an NDA/confidentiality agreement

* Use required time-tracking/time-proof software

* Have reliable internet access

* Follow detailed instructions carefully

* Follow established branding templates

* Maintain consistent product and brand appearance

* Meet deadlines

* Communicate consistently

* Accept feedback and make revisions

* Maintain confidentiality

* Be interested in a long-term position



Portfolio Required



Please do not apply without a portfolio and examples of your actual work.



We especially want to see examples demonstrating your ability to turn a basic product image or vector file into a professional lifestyle or e-commerce image.



Please send:



* Your graphic design portfolio

* Examples of product photo editing you personally completed

* Before-and-after examples of your product editing

* Examples of products you placed into realistic lifestyle scenes

* Examples demonstrating your Photoshop skills

* Examples demonstrating your Adobe Illustrator/vector skills

* Examples of AI-assisted product photography or lifestyle images

* Examples of e-commerce images created for Etsy, Amazon, TikTok, Temu, Shopify, or similar platforms

* A list of the AI image and design tools you currently use

* Your current weekly availability

* Confirmation that you are comfortable starting at $3.00 USD per hour for up to 20 hours per week during training

* Confirmation that you can receive biweekly payments through Wise



If you have video-editing experience, please also include examples of product videos, Reels, or short-form content you have created.



To show that you read the entire job posting, include the words “LIFESTYLE IMAGE” in your application.



We are looking for a skilled graphic designer, not someone who relies entirely on templates or AI-generated images. You should be able to take a simple product photo or vector file and transform it into polished, realistic, professional e-commerce imagery while maintaining the accuracy of the original product.



Position available to start immediately.

description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR



We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.

We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.

This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds





Make the problem feel real and urgent





Show the product clearly and persuasively





Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention





Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok





Communicate benefits quickly and clearly





Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof





Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase





You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands





Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them





Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative





Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused





Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast





Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good





We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation





ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover





Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video





At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use





 you also have experience with:

Meta/Facebook ad creatives





Short-form paid social videos





Long-form VSLs or sales videos





Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing





Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools





Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen





Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts





Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield





Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

E-Commerce Manager - Shopify Plus

Fifty Thousand Products. One Massive Digital Opportunity.



USA Roller Chain & Sprockets is a fast-growing, family-owned power transmission distributor headquartered in Clermont, Florida, and we have been powering American industry since 2001. We sell power transmission products to customers throughout the United States and around the world. Our Shopify Plus website contains more than 50,000 products and supports a growing volume of B2B demand. We are looking for a hands-on e-commerce professional who can keep this complex digital engine organized, optimized, and moving forward.







Our core values: 



Integrity - Innovation - Commitment - Respect - Empathy -Striving for Excellence







USA Roller Chain & Sprockets is seeking a technically capable and detail-oriented E-Commerce Manager to oversee the daily operation and continued development of its Shopify Plus website. This is not a "set it and forget it" website. With more than 50,000 products, thousands of collections, technical resources, and frequent updates, the platform is constantly evolving. You will manage product data, improve site organization, support front-end updates, monitor performance, and coordinate with internal leadership and external development partners.







The ideal candidate combines hands-on Shopify expertise with strong catalog-management, analytical, SEO, and project-coordination skills. Manage and maintain the company's Shopify Plus storefront

Perform regular website updates, configurations, and quality checks

Maintain a catalog containing more than 50,000 products

Complete bulk updates to titles, descriptions, tags, prices, images, and attributes

Organize products into accurate, scalable collections and categories

Improve site navigation, filtering, search, and product discovery

Add new products and update existing product information

Maintain consistent product taxonomy and data standards

Identify and correct broken links, inaccurate content, and website errors

Make light front-end changes using HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid

Support new Shopify features, applications, integrations, and improvements

Coordinate projects with external developers, agencies, and marketing partners

Translate business needs into clear technical tasks

Support technical and on-page SEO improvements

Support promotions, campaigns, product spotlights, and new content

Help bring more e-commerce capabilities and institutional knowledge in-house

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid

Comfortable coordinating with developers and external agencies

Strong written and verbal English communication skills sufficient to collaborate with U.S.-based colleagues, vendors, and partners. 

Able to work independently and manage competing priorities

Reliable internet connection and availability during agreed working hours
