While not strictly required, having these safeguards is strongly preferred. 







Compensation



Full-time, remote position

Pay: $18-$25 per hour, depending on experience and location





Why USA Roller Chain & Sprockets?



This is not another small Shopify store with a few dozen products, and nothing left to build. You will work on a large, active B2B platform with more than 50,000 products, ongoing development needs, strong organic visibility, and real revenue impact. title: Amazon Product Sourcing VA
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Product Sourcer to help us grow and scale our UK Amazon FBA business. The main focus of the role is sourcing profitable products in the UK marketplace, primarily via Online Arbitrage.



WE HAVE THE CAPITAL READY TO SPEND. WHAT WE NEED IS MORE HIGH-QUALITY LEADS. That is the whole job, and it is why we are only looking for proven UK OA sourcers this time. If you are new to sourcing or have only worked the US market, this role is not for you.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE SAME LEADS EVERYONE ELSE BUYS. Deal lists, 
 feeds and the top page of the scanning tools are seen by hundreds of sellers on the same day and the margin is gone within hours. We want a sourcer who can MANUFACTURE THEIR OWN DISCOUNT (stacking codes, clearance, discounts and anything else to make profitable products, price matches, multi-buy and bundle offers, newsletter and app-only promotions) and who can FIND LOW-KEY LEADS that never appear on a shared list: quiet retailers, deep category pages, seasonal clearance, brands with no third-party sellers yet. If you can take a shelf price that shows 5% ROI and turn it into a 25% buy, you are who we want.



The role includes an UNCAPPED BONUS based on the spend on leads you provide. The more we buy from your leads, the more you earn. Our top performing sourcers regularly earn an extra $400+ per month on top of salary, and there is no ceiling. FOR A PROVEN, ABSOLUTE TOP PERFORMER, THE BASE SALARY IS NEGOTIABLE. Show us your track record and we will talk.



The ideal candidate is self-motivated, hungry, and looking for a long-term position with space to grow. We ask that only candidates with real experience of Online Arbitrage product sourcing in the UK marketplace apply.



WHAT AN A-CLASS SOURCER LOOKS LIKE TO US:

- Consistently delivers leads we actually buy, not long lists of borderline ones

- Manufactures margin: knows every legitimate way to get a UK retailer's price down (code stacking, cashback sites, discounted gift cards, loyalty schemes, price matching, multi-buys, app and newsletter codes etc) and builds that into the lead before submitting it

- Finds low-key leads through methods the shared tools and deal lists do not surface: manual retailer digging, storefront and reverse sourcing, deep category and clearance pages, brands with no third-party sellers, seasonal and regional stock

- Uses a wide range of sourcing methods and keeps finding new ones (retailer clearance and promotions, brand and category scanning, Keepa Product Finder)

- Reads a Keepa chart properly: real sales velocity, the real sell price, Buy Box behaviour, etc

- Checks gating, IP risk, variations and VAT before submitting, so leads arrive clean

- Knows UK retailers and discount routes that most sourcing VAs do not



EXPERIENCE REQUESTED (please include details of your experience against each point in your application):

- 12+ months experience in OA sourcing for the UK market specifically

- Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, SellerAmp SAS and Keepa

- Experience in a variety of different sourcing methods for OA (and wholesale or Amazon-to-Amazon if applicable) - list every sourcing method you have used, step by step

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Understanding of UK VAT and UK FBA fees in profit calculations



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Product research and analysis in SAS and Keepa

- Finding your own leads from UK retailers and suppliers using your full range of methods

- Verifying, prioritising and re-checking leads passed to you by the team before they are bought

- Inputting leads into our leads database in the required format, with your reasoning

- Flagging replenishable winners



WHAT WE OFFER:

- $4000 / month starting base salary + uncapped performance bonus paid on spend from your leads

- Flexible working hours (40 hours per week, work when suits you, with at least a one hour crossover with UK 9am-5pm for communication)

- Salary reviewed regularly and increased based on contribution and performance; base negotiable for a proven top performer

- Career development: we are expanding our team of VAs and will be promoting internally for managers and purchasers

- Long-term, stable role with a growing UK business



REQUIREMENTS:

- Full-time: 40 hours a week

- You will use timeproof software to demonstrate you are working effectively during contracted hours

- You will work for us and only us; you may not source for other e-commerce sellers at the same time

- Every lead you submit is checked. Padded or copied lead sheets end the trial.

- Include the words "BIG CHEESE" in your application subject. Applications without it are ignored. This is to make sure you have read the post.



TO APPLY:

Respond with the subject line above and include ALL of the following. Applications missing any of these are not read:



1. A brief description of why you are the best candidate and how you can help us grow.

2. Every sourcing method you use, step by step, in your own words. Which retailers, which discount and cashback routes, which Keepa filters, how you stack them. "I use Keepa and SAS" is not an answer.

3. How you manufacture discount. Give us a real example of a deal where the shelf price did not work and you built the margin yourself: which codes, cashback, gift card or loyalty discounts you stacked, in what order, and what the final buy price and ROI came to. Legitimate, publicly available discounts only.

4. 2-3 real UK product leads you have found in the last 7 days that did NOT come from a deal list, 
 feed or the top page of a scanning tool: retailer purchase link, Amazon link, buy price including delivery and any discount applied, sell price, ROI, net profit after VAT and fees, estimated monthly sales, SAS and Keepa screenshots, how you found it, and a short description of why it is a good lead. This is mandatory, not optional, and it carries the most weight in our decision. Leads we recognise from public lists count against you.

5. Your track record: for your last one or two UK clients, roughly how much did they spend per month on your leads, and what ROI did those leads return? Do you have your old lead sheet for us to see example leads?



If you have a CV, portfolio or anything else that demonstrates why we should hire you, include it. Shortlisted candidates get a short video call and a paid two-week trial working real leads.

title: YouTube Team (Transcription, Quality Control, Description Writer)
description:
Positions Available:

Video Review Quality Control (1 position available)

We launch hundreds of ‘How To’ YouTube episodes every month across our various client's channels. We are in need of an additional team member to help with quality control. Your main role will be to review the completed video and check for editing errors, spelling errors, out of place content, etc. 



The ideal candidate needs to have meticulous attention to detail, a habit of consistency and can handle the weight of people relying on you. Experience in quality control or video editing or a keen eye will really be helpful, as you will be the one putting the stamp of approval on each video before our clients or the public sees it.



Description Writer  (1 position available)

As a description writer, you will join our YouTube team. When the editing team is finished with things on their side, the YouTube team takes over with a variety of tasks, including writing the description. You’ll start with the specific template we use for the corresponding channel, and then customize it with a 1 or 2 paragraph summary of the video content, followed by a specific time-stamped “table of contents” called chapters. We’ll teach you how to do this. 



The ideal candidate needs to have mastery over English writing and grammar. The writing projects won’t be overly complex, but everything needs to be written in a way that sounds native English. The first part of the introduction needs to be written in a compelling way, to create curiosity in the viewer compelling them to watch the episode. 



Transcription, Cards, Endscreens & Chapter TimeStamps (2 positions available)

YouTube transcriptions are vital to the success of our YouTube strategy. Today, instead of using keyword tags to index a video for search, YouTube uses the transcription and knows what the video is about. YouTube will automatically transcribe the video, and your job will be to comb through it adding capitalization, punctuation, and correct spelling errors. You will also take note of “Chapters” throughout the video and provide that information to our description writers.



The ideal candidate for this position needs to be able to endure repetitive tasks with a close attention to detail. You need to be advanced in English spelling and writing. The keyword strategy we use will ensure our clients say the right words within the video, and you will ensure those words are spelled correctly in the transcription. A history of reliability when working solo is a great advantage.

• Help with campaign and budget adjustments

• Research search terms, products, competitors, and opportunities

• Help create and test ad copy

• Prepare performance reports and summaries

• Make recommendations based on data

• Learn and improve our Google Ads processes



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Basic to intermediate Google Ads knowledge

• Understanding of ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, CVR, and conversion tracking

• Comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets

• Strong attention to detail

• Good written English

• Ability to follow processes and instructions

• Willingness to learn and improve

• Reliable communication



Bonus if you have experience with:

• Performance Max

• Google Shopping

• Search campaigns

• Merchant Center

• GA4

• Shopify

• Looker Studio

• Ecommerce advertising



PERSONALITY MATTERS



We're looking for someone curious, analytical, proactive, and motivated to get better.



You don't need to be an expert when you start.



We want someone who doesn't just look at a number and report it, but wants to understand why it changed and what could be done about it.



If you enjoy figuring things out, researching problems, and learning from people who have more experience than you, you'll probably enjoy this role.



WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR



This probably isn't a good fit if you:

• Don't enjoy working with numbers

• Need constant supervision

• Don't like asking questions or learning new things

• Are careless with budgets or account changes

• Only want to follow instructions without understanding the reason behind them

• Aren't interested in ecommerce or performance marketing

• Are looking for short-term freelance work



SCHEDULE



Full-time, 40 hours/week

Monday to Friday

Remote



You'll work with an international team and join 3 team calls per week for updates, feedback, and collaboration.



COMPENSATION

₱30,000/month starting salary



Salary can increase based on performance, knowledge, reliability, and growth within the role.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. What experience do you have with Google Ads?

2. Which Google Ads campaign types have you worked with?

3. Have you worked with ecommerce brands? If yes, tell us briefly about your experience.

4. What do ROAS, CPA, CPC, and CVR mean?

5. If a Google Ads campaign suddenly drops in performance, what would you check first?

6. Are you looking for a full-time, long-term role?



IMPORTANT



Start your application with the word Google on the first line.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



TRIAL TASK



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a small paid trial task.



The task will help us evaluate your analytical thinking, Google Ads knowledge, attention to detail, and ability to explain your reasoning.



GROWTH PATH



Junior Media Buyer → Media Buyer → Senior Media Buyer



As you grow, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of larger accounts, budgets, strategy, and client results.



We don't promise promotions or timelines. Growth depends on your performance, skills, and ability to take ownership.

If you're motivated to become genuinely good at Google Ads and want to work on real ecommerce accounts, we'd love to hear from you.

title: YouTube Video Editor – Long-Form + Shorts | Part-Time
description:
Video Editor, YouTube Long Form and Short Form



About Years Younger



Years Younger is a movement, mobility, strength, and performance longevity brand helping active adults stay strong, mobile, capable, confident, and adventurous.



We are actively growing our YouTube channel and are looking for a skilled, experienced video editor who can turn educational talking head, movement, breathwork, mobility, and wellness content into polished videos that hold attention and feel professional.



This is primarily a video editing position.



I am not looking for someone who simply knows how to cut clips together. I am looking for an editor with strong visual judgment who understands pacing, storytelling, B roll, music, hooks, viewer retention, and, equally important, when not to add unnecessary effects.



What You Will Be Editing



You may work on:



• Long form YouTube videos, including educational and talking head content

• Movement, mobility, exercise, and breathwork videos

• YouTube Shorts and vertical social videos

• Strong opening sequences and hooks

• B roll sequences that visually reinforce what the speaker is teaching

• Captions, text, graphics, and motion elements when appropriate

• Music and sound that support the tone without overpowering the content

• Long form content repurposed into high quality short form clips



You will also be responsible for reviewing your own work before submitting it and correcting obvious issues with cuts, audio, text, spelling, graphics, pacing, cropping, and exports.



Quality control is part of the editing job, not something that should happen only after revisions are requested.



The Editor We Are Looking For



You should have:



• At least 4 years of professional video editing experience

• A strong portfolio demonstrating long form editing ability

• Experience editing talking head, educational, podcast, coaching, wellness, fitness, or similar content

• Strong B roll selection and placement skills

• An understanding of pacing and viewer retention

• The ability to create engaging intros without making the entire video feel overproduced

• Good judgment around music, graphics, captions, transitions, and effects

• The ability to follow an established brand while bringing your own creative ideas

• Strong attention to detail and quality control

• The ability to accept feedback and make revisions accurately

• Excellent communication and deadline management

• The ability to work independently without requiring constant direction



Being able to make a video more interesting without making it unnecessarily busy is particularly important for this role.



Editing Software



You should be highly proficient with at least one professional editing platform, preferably:



Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut.



Experience with After Effects or motion graphics is a plus.



CapCut experience is useful because we also produce short form content.



Descript experience is helpful but not required. A strong editor can be trained on the portions of Descript we use.



Schedule and Compensation



This is a remote, ongoing part time position.



*Starting pay: $6 USD per hour

*Expected workload: approximately 12 to 15 hours per week



Hours may grow over time as the YouTube channel and business expand.



You do not need to work entirely during U.S. business hours, but you must have reliable communication overlap during Pacific Time working hours.



My normal working day ends at approximately *4:00 PM Pacific Time (Los Angeles)*, so questions, problems, file access issues, and deadline concerns need to be communicated early rather than late in the evening.



Communication Expectations



Communication is an important part of this position and will also be evaluated during the hiring process and paid test.



During your agreed working days, you are expected to acknowledge direct work messages, questions, file access issues, revision requests, or deadline related communication within 8 hours.



You do not need to have the complete answer within 8 hours. A short acknowledgment is sufficient, for example:



“Received, thank you. I’ll review this and update you by 2:00 PM PT.”



“I received the files and everything is opening correctly. I’ll follow up after I review them.”



“I saw your message. I need some time to investigate this and will update you during my next work block.”



If a problem could affect a deadline, you are expected to communicate it as soon as you become aware of it rather than waiting until the deadline approaches.



Last minute extension requests or discovering at the end of a project that an assignment cannot be completed will not be a good fit for this role.



How to Apply



Please include all of the following in your application:



1. Your video editing portfolio.



2. Links to two of your strongest long form edits.



3. A link to one of your strongest short form edits.



4. For each example, briefly explain exactly what you personally did on the video, such as first pass editing, B roll, graphics, animation, color, audio, captions, thumbnail, or complete edit.



5. Choose one of the long form videos you submitted and give me one specific timestamp where you made an editing decision you are particularly proud of. Tell me what you did there and why you made that choice.



6. Tell me how many years you have worked professionally as a video editor.



7. Tell me which editing programs you currently use.



8. Tell me your current or normal hourly rate.



9. Tell me whether you currently have another job or regular clients and approximately how many hours per week you are committed elsewhere.



10. Give me your normal weekly working schedule, including your working days and hours, shown in both your local time and Pacific Time.



11. Specifically tell me what hours you would normally be available for communication between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM Pacific Time.



12. Briefly explain how you approach B roll selection and pacing in a talking head YouTube video.



13. Briefly explain how you d
 when to use music, graphics, text, transitions, and effects versus when to keep an edit simple.



Important Application Instructions



Please read these carefully.



Start with the number 12. Subtract 9, then add 2.



Use the final answer as the number of Apply Points you use when submitting your application.



Do not write the answer to the math problem here simply because it appears in the job posting. Calculate it yourself and use that number of Apply Points.



Also, somewhere in your response to the question about B roll selection and pacing, naturally use the word younger.



Please do not simply write “younger” by itself or add it as an unrelated sentence. It should be used naturally within your response.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.



Strong candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing test before a final hiring decision is made.



Thank you.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Remote (Philippines) | Full-time | Start ASAP



This is not an administrative role. As Staud Media scales past founder-led operations, we need someone who can take ownership of how the company runs, not just execute within a function.



Staud Media is a modern educational media group creating in-depth newsletters, social content, and video across specialised niches. You'll work directly with the founders to remove operational friction, build systems that scale, and own people, process, and business operations end to end.



What you'll own:

• Business operations: processes, SOPs, bottlenecks, cross-team coordination

• People operations: hiring, onboarding, payroll, benefits, employee administration

• Philippines entity operations: coordinating with legal, accounting, and payroll providers

• Team development: coaching, onboarding, internal training

• Vendor and admin management



First 90 days: take ownership of recurring operational tasks and identify the company's biggest bottlenecks.



You'll thrive here if you think in systems, take ownership without being asked, and move comfortably between hands on execution and higher level process design.



Requirements: 5+ years in operations, people ops, or business ops, with experience owning processes independently and working directly with senior leadership.



Full role details, success milestones, and application instructions below. 



The Role



Operations supports every specialty in the company.



This role includes:

• Improving internal processes and workflows

• Managing day-to-day people and business operations

• Coordinating hiring, onboarding, payroll, benefits, and employee administration

• Supporting the setup and ongoing operation of our Philippine entity and workforce

• Helping team members improve how they plan, communicate, prioritise, and execute

• Building and maintaining company documentation, policies, and SOPs

• Coordinating projects and initiatives that span multiple teams

• Managing external providers and operational vendors

• Identifying bottlenecks and turning recurring problems into repeatable systems

• Helping the founders move operational responsibilities out of their day-to-day workload



You will operate independently and be expected to improve the function, not just execute within it.



Strategic Impact



Stronger Company Operations

As the company grows, informal processes stop scaling.



This role ensures that recurring work has clear systems, owners, documentation, and expectations.



That includes:

• Improving workflows between specialties

• Reducing unnecessary manual work

• Clarifying responsibilities and handoffs

• Creating repeatable processes

• Making important operational information easier to find

• Ensuring recurring tasks happen without founder intervention



The goal is a company that becomes more organised as it grows, not more complicated.



People Development & Team Performance

Operations is not only about systems.



A large part of this role is helping people work more effectively within those systems.



You'll help:

• Improve onboarding

• Identify development areas across the team

• Create individual development plans where useful

• Train team members on internal processes and tools

• Coach team members on planning, ownership, communication, prioritisation, and execution

• Introduce lightweight performance and feedback processes

• Work with functional leads to identify skill gaps

• Build internal training and documentation



You are not expected to be the technical expert in every specialty.



Functional leaders will continue to own craft-specific development, while Operations helps strengthen how people work, collaborate, and grow within the company.



People Operations

As our team grows, we want the employee experience to become more structured.



This includes:

• Hiring coordination

• Employment documentation

• Onboarding and offboarding

• Leave and employee records

• Payroll coordination

• Employee benefits

• Performance cycles

• Policies and employee documentation

• Supporting employee questions

• Working with external HR, legal, accounting, and payroll providers



You will help create a strong operational foundation for the team rather than allowing people processes to develop reactively.



Philippines Operations

A significant part of our team is based in the Philippines, and we are building a stronger long-term employment structure there.



You will help coordinate this work alongside external legal, accounting, payroll, and corporate-services providers.



This may include:

• Supporting Philippine entity setup

• Coordinating payroll and employee benefits

• Supporting SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, HMO, and other employee administration

• Maintaining employment documentation

• Tracking compliance and renewal requirements

• Coordinating with accountants, payroll providers, lawyers, and corporate secretaries

• Helping transition team members into full-time employment arrangements

• Building scalable processes as the Philippine team grows



You do not need to personally be the company's lawyer or accountant.



You do need to be capable of owning the process, coordinating specialists, asking the right questions, and making sure things get completed correctly.



Founder Leverage

A successful Operations function should reduce how many routine operational decisions require founder involvement.



You'll gradually take ownership of areas such as:

• Operational follow-ups

• Internal coordination

• Vendor management

• Hiring administration

• People operations

• Company documentation

• Recurring administrative processes

• Process improvement

• Cross-functional initiatives



The goal is not simply to take tasks from the founders.



It is to turn recurring founder tasks into systems that no longer need to depend on them.



What You'll Do



Business Operations

• Own recurring operational processes

• Identify and resolve bottlenecks

• Improve workflows between teams

• Coordinate operational projects

• Maintain company processes and SOPs

• Track important deadlines and recurring obligations

• Manage company tools, subscriptions, and vendors

• Improve operational visibility across the business



People Operations

• Coordinate hiring and candidate processes

• Manage onboarding and offboarding

• Maintain employee records

• Coordinate payroll, leave, and benefits

• Help create company policies and employee documentation

• Support performance and development processes

• Answer or route routine employee operational questions



Team Development

Examples of initiatives we value:

• Improving new-hire onboarding

• Building role-specific onboarding plans

• Creating development plans with team members

• Running internal workshops

• Improving how the team uses Jira, Confluence, Slack, and other systems

• Coaching team members on ownership and communication

• Helping managers improve feedback and performance conversations

• Creating reusable internal training resources



Process & Systems Improvement

When you notice something happening repeatedly, we expect you to ask:



Should this become a system?



Examples include:

• Turning recurring founder instructions into SOPs

• Automating repetitive administrative work

• Improving project handoffs

• Creating templates for recurring workflows

• Improving documentation

• Clarifying ownership

• Reducing unnecessary meetings

• Making operational information easier to find



Philippines Operations

• Coordinate with external legal and accounting providers

• Support entity and employer administration

• Coordinate payroll and employee benefits

• Maintain compliance calendars

• Support employment documentation

• Coordinate HMO and statutory benefit administration

• Help establish scalable local HR processes

Act as an operational point of contact for Philippine employees



Vendor & Administrative Management

• Manage relationships with external providers

• Gather and compare quotes

• Coordinate contracts and renewals

• Monitor recurring company expenses

• Organise operational documentation

• Follow up outstanding actions

• Make sure vendors deliver against agreed expectations



What Success Looks Like



In the first 30–90 days

• You understand how the company currently operates.

• You take ownership of key recurring operational tasks.

• You identify the largest operational bottlenecks.

• You begin documenting and improving important processes.

• People know where to go for operational questions.

• Founders begin spending less time coordinating routine operations.



By 6–12 months

• Core people and business operations run consistently without founder intervention.

• Hiring, onboarding, payroll, benefits, and employee administration are structured.

• Our Philippine operations have clear ownership and reliable external-provider coordination.

• Important company processes are documented and actively followed.

• Team members receive more structured onboarding, feedback, and development support.

• Cross-functional projects have clearer ownership and fewer operational bottlenecks.

• The Operations function operates with increasing independence.



You'll Thrive Here If You…

• Naturally notice when a process could be improved

• Think in systems rather than isolated tasks

• Are highly organised without becoming bureaucratic

• Enjoy making other people's work easier

• Are comfortable managing many different workstreams

• Can move between detailed execution and higher-level thinking

• Follow through without needing repeated reminders

• Communicate clearly and proactively

• Enjoy coaching and developing people

• Know when to solve something yourself and when to involve a specialist

• Are comfortable respectfully challenging inefficient ways of working

• Prefer preventing operational problems rather than repeatedly fixing them

• Can create structure without slowing a fast-moving company down



Requirements



• 5+ years in operations, people operations, business operations, HR operations, project operations, or a similar role

• Experience owning operational processes independently

• Strong written and spoken English

• Strong project and stakeholder management

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

• Experience creating and improving SOPs and internal processes

• Experience coordinating hiring, onboarding, or employee operations

• Comfortable working directly with senior leaders/founders

• Comfortable managing external vendors and professional-service providers

• Strong judgment and problem-solving ability

• Comfortable working remotely with async collaboration



Bonus

• Experience in a startup, scale-up, media, technology, or remote-first company

• Experience working for an Australian, US, UK, or other international company

• Experience managing Philippine employment operations

• Experience coordinating payroll, HMO, SSS, PhilHealth, or Pag-IBIG administration

• Experience helping establish or operate a Philippine entity

• Experience in Learning & Development or employee coaching

• Experience implementing performance-management frameworks

• Experience managing HRIS, payroll, or people systems

• Experience managing distributed teams

• Experience introducing automation or AI into operational workflows



How We Work



We are remote-first and async-friendly.



We operate in 2-week sprints, with clear priorities and defined deliverables for each cycle.



Work is planned, visible, and tracked; not managed through DMs.



Tools we use

• Jira for sprint planning, tickets, and task tracking

• Confluence for documentation, standards, and knowledge sharing

• Google Docs for drafting, outlining, and collaborative editing

• Slack for day-to-day communication and quick alignment



You’ll collaborate closely with founders and the wider content team, but you’re expected to drive your area forward independently.



We value:

• Clear tickets and documented decisions

• Strong first drafts

• Raising issues early rather than working in silence

• Improving processes when you see friction

• Thoughtful experimentation

• Clear reasoning behind decisions

• We protect deep work, avoid unnecessary meetings, and prefer written clarity over verbal ambiguity.



Culture matters to us.



We invest in occasional virtual team bonding sessions and informal catch-ups because we believe strong working relationships improve output quality and trust.



This is a structured environment; but one where initiative and ownership are expected, not micromanaged.



Compensation



This role is budgeted at market rates for the Philippines.



To keep things efficient, please include in your application your expected annual PHP salary/rate.



Hiring Process



We aim to keep the process rigorous but efficient:



1. Application review: 

     • We'll look for examples of ownership, process improvement, people development, and cross-functional coordination.



2. Short interview: 

    • Focused on operational judgment, systems thinking, communication, and how you work with people.

    • We'll discuss real situations rather than generic interview questions.



3. Paid operations exercise: 

    • You'll be given a realistic operational problem with incomplete information. 

    • We want to see how you:

         • identify the underlying problem

         • d
 what information you still need

         • prioritise what should be fixed first

         • clarify ownership

         • design a practical process

         • communicate the change

         • get people to actually adopt it

         • d
 how you would measure whether it worked



4. Final conversation + offer:

    • focused on leadership style, judgment, expectations, and how you would approach the role in your first few months.



We care more about how you diagnose and improve a messy system than producing a polished presentation.



A strong solution should not depend on you personally chasing people forever.



We want to see whether you can turn a recurring problem into a system that continues to work after the initial intervention.



How to Apply



Please send:

1. Your resume / CV

2. A short introduction explaining why this role interests you

3. A short response (max 500 words):

Tell us about an operational problem you noticed and took ownership of. Please cover:

    a.  What was happening?

    b.  How did you realise there was a problem?

    c.  Was fixing it already part of your responsibilities, or did you take the initiative yourself?

    d. How did you work out the root cause?

    e. What did you change?

    f. How did you get other people to adopt the change?

    g. Did anyone initially resist or disagree? How did you handle that?

    h. What improved as a result?

    i. Did the process continue working without you having to constantly manage it?



4. A second short response (max 500 words):

Tell us about a time you helped someone else become better at their job. This could involve onboarding, coaching, feedback, training, improving someone's workflow, or helping them take more ownership.

Please explain:

    a. What did they need help with?

    b. How did you identify the gap?

    c. What did you do?

    d. How did their behaviour or performance change afterward?

title: Agentic RAG Engineer – AI Education Project | Short-Term Remote

title: Social Media Community Manager (Comments, DMs, Engagement) - US Brand
description:
HeartStamp is a US greeting card and gifting brand. We are hiring one full-time contractor to own everything that comes back to us on social: comments, DMs, mentions, reviews, and group conversations. You are not making the content. You are the voice replying to it, and the voice showing up in other people's comment sections.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Reply to comments and DMs across Instagram, TikTok,
, Pinterest, Reddit, X, and YouTube

- Answer first-line customer questions and route order or billing issues to the right person

- Comment early and in our voice on posts from the creators and communities our customers already follow, and build our follow lists

- Use our card art and animated GIFs as comment assets where it fits naturally, never as a sales pitch

- Help grow our own community spaces and show up helpfully in groups we do not own

- Report weekly on what people are saying, what is working, and what the product team should know



WHAT WE NEED

- 2+ years managing community, engagement, or social customer care for a consumer brand

- Near-native written English. You will be writing publicly for a US audience, on your own, many times a day

- Strong knowledge of American pop culture and internet humor: celebrity and entertainment news, fashion, music, reality TV, 
s, and trends. Most of our customers are in their 20s, 30s, and 40s

- You can write a funny reply, not just a safe one

- Real hands-on platform knowledge, especially TikTok, Instagram, and
 Groups

- Experience with at least one social or care tool (Sprout, Hootsuite, Later, Agorapulse, Zendesk, Gorgias, or similar)

SCHEDULE

- Approx 45 hours per week

- At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (GMT -4)  (11am to 3pm EST)

- Someone who needs a script for every situation

TERMS

This is an independent contractor role paid monthly in USD. No 13th month pay or benefits. Performance review at 90 days.



TIMELINE Applications close Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 11:59pm EST. Start date is Monday, August 17, 2026. We move fast on purpose, so please apply only if that start date works for you.



TO APPLY

 social media handles would also be great. Any samples of your work would be awesome. Be prepared to provide minimum of 2 senior level references that you reported to .
